/*
  Warnings:

  - You are about to drop the column `createdAt` on the `User` table. All the data in the column will be lost.

*/
-- RedefineTables
PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=ON;
PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;
CREATE TABLE "new_User" (
    "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "username" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "passwordHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "fullName" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "department" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staff',
    "wardId" INTEGER
);
INSERT INTO "new_User" ("department", "fullName", "id", "passwordHash", "role", "username", "wardId") SELECT "department", "fullName", "id", "passwordHash", "role", "username", "wardId" FROM "User";
DROP TABLE "User";
ALTER TABLE "new_User" RENAME TO "User";
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_username_key" ON "User"("username");
PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=OFF;

=================== ./prisma/schema.prisma ===================
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Ward {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name      String
  capacity  Int
  patients  Patient[]
  employees Employee[]
}

model Patient {
  id                  Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  name                String
  dob                 DateTime?
  gender              String?
  nationalId          String?      @unique
  admissionDate       DateTime     @default(now())
  wardId              Int?
  ward                Ward?        @relation(fields: [wardId], references: [id])
  status              String       @default("admitted")
  attendingDoctor     String?
  updatedAt           DateTime     @updatedAt

  diagnosis           String?
  symptoms            String?
  phone               String?
  bloodGroup          String?

  finalDiagnosis      String?
  treatmentSummary    String?
  outcome             String?
  dischargeDate       DateTime?
  dischargeNotes      String?
  dischargedBy        String?
  nextReviewDate      DateTime?
  reviewDepartment    String?
  patientInstructions String?

  causeOfDeath        String?

  statusLogs          StatusLog[]
}

model StatusLog {
  id         Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  patientId  Int
  patient    Patient  @relation(fields: [patientId], references: [id])
  oldStatus  String
  newStatus  String
  changedBy  String
  timestamp  DateTime @default(now())
}

model Employee {
  id                Int                @id @default(autoincrement())
  name              String
  department        String
  role              String?
  wardId            Int?
  ward              Ward?              @relation(fields: [wardId], references: [id])
  status            String             @default("active")
  hireDate          DateTime           @default(now())
  terminationDate   DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime           @updatedAt
  statusLogs        EmployeeStatusLog[]
  disciplinaryCases DisciplinaryCase[]
  movements         EmployeeMovement[]
}

model EmployeeStatusLog {
  id         Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  employeeId Int
  employee   Employee @relation(fields: [employeeId], references: [id])
  oldStatus  String
  newStatus  String
  changedBy  String
  timestamp  DateTime @default(now())
}

model EmployeeMovement {
  id                 Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  employeeId         Int
  employee           Employee @relation(fields: [employeeId], references: [id])

  movementType       String

  fromDepartment     String?
  fromWardId         Int?
  toDepartment       String?
  toWardId           Int?

  plannedDate        DateTime?
  actualDate         DateTime?
  yearsOfService     Int?
  pensionNotes       String?

  resignationDate    DateTime?
  lastWorkingDay     DateTime?
  noticePeriodDays   Int?
  reason             String?
  exitInterviewDone  Boolean  @default(false)
  eligibleForRehire  Boolean?

  effectiveDate      DateTime?
  notes              String?
  approvedBy         String?

  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt
}

model EstablishmentTarget {
  id            Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  department    String   @unique
  minHeadcount  Int      @default(0)
  maxHeadcount  Int?
  notes         String?
  updatedBy     String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
}

model OrderRequest {
  id                    Int                       @id @default(autoincrement())
  requestingDepartment  String
  originatorDepartment  String?
  requestingBy          String
  itemName              String
  quantity              Int
  reason                String
  status                String                    @default("pending")
  urgency               String?                   @default("normal")

function pickEmployeeStatus() {
  const r = Math.random();
  if (r < 0.85) return 'active';
  if (r < 0.93) return 'on_leave';
  if (r < 0.97) return 'sick';
  return 'terminated';
}

function pickDisciplinaryStatus(dayAge) {
  const r = Math.random();
  if (dayAge <= 7) {
    if (r < 0.6) return 'open';
    if (r < 0.9) return 'under_investigation';
    return 'resolved';
  }
  if (dayAge <= 30) {
    if (r < 0.2) return 'open';
    if (r < 0.55) return 'under_investigation';
    if (r < 0.9) return 'resolved';
    return 'dismissed';
  }
  if (r < 0.75) return 'resolved';
  if (r < 0.95) return 'dismissed';
  return 'under_investigation';
}

function pickDisciplinaryAction(status) {
  if (status === 'resolved') {
    return pick(['Verbal warning','Written warning','Final written warning','Suspension','Demotion','Termination','Counselling']);
  }
  if (status === 'dismissed') {
    return pick(['No action','Counselling']);
  }
  return null;
}

// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function pick(arr) {
  return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
}

function randomDateWithinDays(daysAgo, hourStart = 6, hourEnd = 22) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - daysAgo);
  const hours = hourStart + Math.floor(Math.random() * (hourEnd - hourStart));
  const minutes = Math.floor(Math.random() * 60);
  const seconds = Math.floor(Math.random() * 60);
  d.setHours(hours, minutes, seconds, 0);
  return d;
}

// For "loaded today" records — clamp to today at a random hour between 8am-6pm.
function todayAtHour(hourStart = 8, hourEnd = 18) {
  const d = new Date();
  const hours = hourStart + Math.floor(Math.random() * (hourEnd - hourStart));
  const minutes = Math.floor(Math.random() * 60);
  const seconds = Math.floor(Math.random() * 60);
  d.setHours(hours, minutes, seconds, 0);
  return d;
}

function dateOffsetDays(offset) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset);
  return d;
}

function generateNationalId() {
  const part1 = String(Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * 90));
  const part2 = String(Math.floor(1000000 + Math.random() * 9000000));
  const part3 = String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26));
  const part4 = String(Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * 90));
  return part1 + '-' + part2 + '-' + part3 + part4;
}

function pickPatientStatus(dayAge) {
  const r = Math.random();
  if (dayAge <= 7) {
    if (r < 0.5) return 'admitted';
    if (r < 0.9) return 'treatment';
    if (r < 0.95) return 'discharged';
    return 'deceased';
  }
  if (dayAge <= 30) {
    if (r < 0.25) return 'admitted';
    if (r < 0.55) return 'treatment';
    if (r < 0.92) return 'discharged';
    return 'deceased';
  }
  if (dayAge <= 60) {
    if (r < 0.1) return 'treatment';
    if (r < 0.92) return 'discharged';
    return 'deceased';
  }
  if (r < 0.9) return 'discharged';
  return 'deceased';
}

          movementData.lastWorkingDay = lastDay;

          movementData.exitInterviewDone = Math.random() < 0.6;
          movementData.eligibleForRehire = Math.random() < 0.7;
        }

          await prisma.employeeMovement.create({ data: movementData });

    let projectCount = 0;
    let updateCount = 0;

    for (const sample of PROJECT_SAMPLES) {
      try {
        const lastPhase = sample.phases[sample.phases.length - 1];
        const currentStatus = lastPhase.status;

        const project = await prisma.project.create({
          data: {
            name: sample.name,
            description: sample.description,
            department: sample.department,
            projectHead: sample.projectHead,
            status: currentStatus,
            startDate: dateOffsetDays(-sample.startOffsetDays),
            targetDate: dateOffsetDays(sample.targetOffsetDays),
            obstacleReason: currentStatus === 'pending' ? lastPhase.obstacleReason : null,
            createdBy: sample.createdBy,
            createdAt: dateOffsetDays(-sample.startOffsetDays),
            updatedAt: dateOffsetDays(-lastPhase.offsetDays),
          },
        });
        projectCount++;

        for (const phase of sample.phases) {
          await prisma.projectUpdate.create({
            data: {
              projectId: project.id,
              note: phase.note,
              statusAtUpdate: phase.status,
              obstacleReason: phase.status === 'pending' ? phase.obstacleReason : null,
              actionTaken: phase.actionTaken || null,
              updatedBy: sample.projectHead,
              timestamp: dateOffsetDays(-phase.offsetDays),
            },
          });
          updateCount++;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('  Skipped one project:', e.message);
      }
    }

    // Post-pass: force a "today" update on the first 3 ongoing projects
    // so the Live Board "projects this week" widget is always populated.
    const ongoingProjects = await prisma.project.findMany({
      where: { status: 'ongoing' },
      take: 3,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    for (const proj of ongoingProjects) {
      const todayStamp = todayAtHour(8, 12);
      await prisma.projectUpdate.create({
        data: {
          projectId: proj.id,
          note: 'Daily progress update: work continues as scheduled.',
          statusAtUpdate: 'ongoing',
          obstacleReason: null,
          actionTaken: 'Routine progress logged today',
          updatedBy: proj.projectHead,
          timestamp: todayStamp,
        },
      });
      await prisma.project.update({
        where: { id: proj.id },
        data: { updatedAt: todayStamp },
      });
      updateCount++;
    }
    console.log('  Added today updates to ' + ongoingProjects.length + ' ongoing projects');
    console.log('  Created ' + projectCount + ' projects with ' + updateCount + ' phase updates');

    // Summary.
    console.log('');
    console.log('Database seeded successfully.');
    console.log('');

    const totalPatients       = await prisma.patient.count();
    const totalEmployees      = await prisma.employee.count();
    const totalUsers          = await prisma.user.count();
    const totalCases          = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.count();
    const totalMovements      = await prisma.employeeMovement.count();
    const totalTargets        = await prisma.establishmentTarget.count();
    const totalProjects       = await prisma.project.count();
    const totalProjectUpdates = await prisma.projectUpdate.count();

    console.log('Totals:');
    console.log('  Patients: '              + totalPatients);
    console.log('  Employees: '             + totalEmployees);
    console.log('  Users: '                 + totalUsers);
    console.log('  Disciplinary cases: '    + totalCases);
    console.log('  Movements: '             + totalMovements);
    console.log('  Establishment targets: ' + totalTargets);
    console.log('  Projects: '              + totalProjects);
    console.log('  Project updates: '       + totalProjectUpdates);
    console.log('');

    const patientStatuses = ['admitted', 'treatment', 'discharged', 'deceased'];
    console.log('Patient status breakdown:');
    for (const s of patientStatuses) {
      const count = await prisma.patient.count({ where: { status: s } });
      console.log('  ' + s + ': ' + count);
    }
    console.log('');

    const empStatuses = ['active', 'on_leave', 'sick', 'terminated'];
    console.log('Employee status breakdown:');
    for (const s of empStatuses) {
      const count = await prisma.employee.count({ where: { status: s } });
      console.log('  ' + s + ': ' + count);
    }
    console.log('');

    const discStatuses = ['open', 'under_investigation', 'resolved', 'dismissed'];
    console.log('Disciplinary status breakdown:');
    for (const s of discStatuses) {
      const count = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.count({ where: { status: s } });
      console.log('  ' + s + ': ' + count);
    }
    console.log('');

    const projStatuses = ['ongoing', 'pending', 'completed'];
    console.log('Project status breakdown:');
    for (const s of projStatuses) {
      const count = await prisma.project.count({ where: { status: s } });
      console.log('  ' + s + ': ' + count);
    }
    console.log('');

    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
    sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);
    const recentUpdates = await prisma.projectUpdate.findMany({
      where: { timestamp: { gte: sevenDaysAgo } },
      select: { projectId: true },
      distinct: ['projectId'],
    });
    console.log('Projects with activity in last 7 days: ' + recentUpdates.length + ' / ' + totalProjects);
    console.log('');

    console.log('Test credentials:');
    console.log('  Nurses:      nurse1 / nurse123');
    console.log('  Nurses:      nurse2 / nurse123');
    console.log('  IT:          it1 / it123');
    console.log('  IT:          it2 / it123');
    console.log('  Procurement: procurement1 / proc123');
    console.log('  Procurement: procurement2 / proc123');
    console.log('  Stores:      stores1 / store123');
    console.log('  Stores:      stores2 / store123');
    console.log('  HR:          hr1 / hr123');
    console.log('  HR:          hr2 / hr123');
    console.log('  Super Admin: Admin / (your configured password)');
    console.log('');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('');
    console.error('Error:', e.message);
    console.error(e);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main()
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

let deferredPrompt;

window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  deferredPrompt = e;
});

async function installApp() {
  if (deferredPrompt) {
    // Show the native install prompt (Desktop or Home Screen shortcut)
    deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    console.log(`User response to the install prompt: ${outcome}`);
    deferredPrompt = null;
  } else {
    // Browser blocked it (HTTP issue) -> Show the custom instructions modal
    document.getElementById('installModal').classList.add('active');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// THEME
// ============================================================
function initTheme() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem("mushamumwe_theme") || "light";
  applyTheme(saved);
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
  const next = current === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
  applyTheme(next);
  localStorage.setItem("mushamumwe_theme", next);
}

function applyTheme(theme) {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  const icon = document.getElementById("themeIcon");
  if (icon) icon.textContent = theme === "light" ? "DARK" : "LIGHT";
}

async function loadBoardSettings() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/api/settings/public");
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();
    const title = document.getElementById("boardTitle");
    if (title) title.textContent = (data.hospitalName || "Hospital").toUpperCase() + " - LIVE BOARD";
    document.title = (data.hospitalName || "Hospital") + " - Live Board";
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// UTILS
// ============================================================
function fmtTime(iso) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}

function fmtDateShort(d) {
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
}

function toInputDate(d) {
  const dt = d instanceof Date ? d : new Date(d);
  const yyyy = dt.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(dt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const dd = String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return yyyy + "-" + mm + "-" + dd;
}

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
}

// ============================================================
// WIDGET STATE
// ============================================================
const widgetState = {
  patients: { range: "today", from: null, to: null },
  tender: { range: "today", from: null, to: null },
  disc: { range: "today", from: null, to: null },
  est: { range: "today", from: null, to: null },
  projects: { range: "today", from: null, to: null },
};

function computeRange(preset, customFrom, customTo) {
  const now = new Date();
  let from, to;

  if (preset === "today") {
    from = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    to = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
  } else if (preset === "week") {
    const day = now.getDay();
    const sunday = new Date(now);
    sunday.setDate(now.getDate() - day);
    from = new Date(sunday.getFullYear(), sunday.getMonth(), sunday.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    to = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
  } else if (preset === "month") {
    from = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    to = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
  } else if (preset === "custom") {
    if (customFrom) {
      from = new Date(customFrom);
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else {
      from = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (customTo) {
      to = new Date(customTo);
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else {
      to = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
    }
  }

  return { from, to };
}

function loadWidgetStateFromStorage() {
  try {
    ["patients", "tender", "disc", "est", "projects"].forEach(type => {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("mushamumwe_widget_" + type);
      if (raw) widgetState[type] = JSON.parse(raw);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load widget state:", e);
  }
}

function saveWidgetState(type) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem("mushamumwe_widget_" + type, JSON.stringify(widgetState[type]));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to save widget state:", e);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// WIDGET LOADERS
// ============================================================
async function loadTodaySummary() {
  try {
    const state = widgetState.patients;
    const { from, to } = computeRange(state.range, state.from, state.to);
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("from", toInputDate(from));
    params.set("to", toInputDate(to));

    const res = await fetch("/api/patients/today-summary?" + params);
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById("todayAdmitted").textContent = data.admittedToday ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("todayDischarged").textContent = data.dischargedToday ?? "-";
    const followups = data.followUpsDueToday || 0;
    document.getElementById('todayFollowups').textContent = followups;
    const followupWidget = document.getElementById('followupWidget');
    if (followups > 0) {
      document.getElementById('todayFollowups').style.color = '#dc2626';
      followupWidget.style.background = 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08)';
      followupWidget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2)';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('todayFollowups').style.color = 'var(--primary)';
      followupWidget.style.background = 'transparent';
      followupWidget.style.border = 'none';
    }
    document.getElementById("todayDeaths").textContent = data.deathsToday ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("patientsCaption").textContent = fmtDateShort(from) + " - " + fmtDateShort(to);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load today summary:", e);
  }
}

async function loadTenderActivity() {
  try {
    const state = widgetState.tender;
    const { from, to } = computeRange(state.range, state.from, state.to);
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("from", toInputDate(from));
    params.set("to", toInputDate(to));

    const res = await fetch("/api/orders/summary-public?" + params);
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById("tenderPending").textContent = data.pending ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("tenderAwaiting").textContent = data.awaitingQuotation ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("tenderOrdered").textContent = data.ordered ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("tenderReceived").textContent = data.received ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("tenderCaption").textContent = fmtDateShort(from) + " - " + fmtDateShort(to);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load tender activity:", e);
  }
}

async function loadDisciplinarySummary() {
  try {
    const state = widgetState.disc;
    const { from, to } = computeRange(state.range, state.from, state.to);
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("from", toInputDate(from));
    params.set("to", toInputDate(to));

    const res = await fetch("/api/disciplinary/summary-public?" + params);
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById("discOpen").textContent = data.byStatus.open || 0;
    document.getElementById("discInvestigation").textContent = data.byStatus.under_investigation || 0;
    document.getElementById("discResolved").textContent = data.byStatus.resolved || 0;
    document.getElementById("discDismissed").textContent = data.byStatus.dismissed || 0;
    document.getElementById("discTotal").textContent = data.total || 0;
    document.getElementById("discCaption").textContent = fmtDateShort(from) + " - " + fmtDateShort(to);

    const list = document.getElementById("discRecentList");
    if (!data.recent || data.recent.length === 0) {
      list.innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="font-size:11px; text-align:center; padding:8px;">No cases in this range</p>';
    } else {
      list.innerHTML = data.recent.map(c => {
        const statusLabel = c.status === "under_investigation" ? "INVESTIGATING" : c.status.toUpperCase();
        const statusClass = "badge-disc-" + c.status;
        const daysAgo = Math.floor((new Date() - new Date(c.reportedDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const daysLabel = daysAgo === 0 ? "today" : daysAgo === 1 ? "1 day ago" : daysAgo + " days ago";
        return '<div class="disc-recent-item">' +
          '<div class="disc-recent-head">' +
          '<span class="disc-recent-case">' + escapeHtml(c.caseNumber) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="badge ' + statusClass + '" style="font-size:9px; padding:2px 8px;">' + statusLabel + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="disc-recent-body">' +
          '<span>' + escapeHtml(c.offenseType) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="disc-recent-days">' + daysLabel + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '</div>';
      }).join("");
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load disciplinary summary:", e);
  }
}

async function loadEstablishmentSummary() {
  try {
    const state = widgetState.est;
    const { from, to } = computeRange(state.range, state.from, state.to);
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("from", toInputDate(from));
    params.set("to", toInputDate(to));

    const sumRes = await fetch("/api/establishment/summary-public?" + params);
    const headRes = await fetch("/api/establishment/headcount-public");
    if (!sumRes.ok) return;
    const summary = await sumRes.json();

    document.getElementById("estTransfers").textContent = summary.transfers ?? 0;
    document.getElementById("estRetirements").textContent = summary.retirements ?? 0;
    document.getElementById("estResignations").textContent = summary.resignations ?? 0;
    document.getElementById("estUnderstaffed").textContent = summary.understaffed ?? 0;
    document.getElementById("estOverstaffed").textContent = summary.overstaffed ?? 0;
    document.getElementById("estCaption").textContent = fmtDateShort(from) + " - " + fmtDateShort(to);

    if (headRes.ok) {
      const headcount = await headRes.json();
      const atRisk = headcount.filter(d => d.status === "understaffed" || d.status === "overstaffed");
      const list = document.getElementById("estDeptList");
      if (atRisk.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="font-size:11px; text-align:center; padding:8px;">All departments within target</p>';
      } else {
        list.innerHTML = atRisk.slice(0, 5).map(d => {
          const statusLabel = d.status === "understaffed" ? "UNDER" : "OVER";
          const statusClass = d.status === "understaffed" ? "badge-rejected" : "badge-awaiting_quotation";
          const targetText = d.max ? d.current + "/" + d.min + "-" + d.max : d.current + "/min " + d.min;
          return '<div class="disc-recent-item">' +
            '<div class="disc-recent-head">' +
            '<span class="disc-recent-case">' + escapeHtml(d.department) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="badge ' + statusClass + '" style="font-size:9px; padding:2px 8px;">' + statusLabel + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="disc-recent-body">' +
            '<span>Current / Target</span>' +
            '<span class="disc-recent-days">' + targetText + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }).join("");
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load establishment summary:", e);
  }
}

async function loadProjectsSummary() {
  try {
    const state = widgetState.projects;
    const { from, to } = computeRange(state.range, state.from, state.to);
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("from", toInputDate(from));
    params.set("to", toInputDate(to));

    const res = await fetch("/api/projects/summary-public?" + params);
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById("projectsOngoing").textContent = (data.byStatus && data.byStatus.ongoing) || 0;
    document.getElementById("projectsPending").textContent = (data.byStatus && data.byStatus.pending) || 0;
    document.getElementById("projectsCompleted").textContent = (data.byStatus && data.byStatus.completed) || 0;
    document.getElementById("projectsCaption").textContent = fmtDateShort(from) + " - " + fmtDateShort(to);

    const blockedList = document.getElementById("projectsBlockedList");
    const blockedCount = document.getElementById("projectsBlockedCount");
    const blocked = data.blocked || [];

    blockedCount.textContent = blocked.length;

    if (blocked.length === 0) {
      blockedList.innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="font-size:11px; text-align:center; padding:8px;">No blocked projects</p>';
    } else {
      blockedList.innerHTML = blocked.map(p => {
        return '<div class="disc-recent-item" style="border-left:3px solid #dc2626;">' +
          '<div class="disc-recent-head">' +
          '<span class="disc-recent-case">' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="badge badge-rejected" style="font-size:9px; padding:2px 8px;">BLOCKED</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="disc-recent-body">' +
          '<span>' + escapeHtml(p.department) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="disc-recent-days">Head: ' + escapeHtml(p.projectHead || '-') + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="margin-top:6px; font-size:11px; color:#991b1b;">' +
          '<strong>Reason:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.obstacleReason || 'Not stated') +
          '</div>' +
          '</div>';
      }).join("");
    }

    const list = document.getElementById("projectsRecentList");
    if (!data.recent || data.recent.length === 0) {
      list.innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="font-size:11px; text-align:center; padding:8px;">No project activity</p>';
    } else {
      list.innerHTML = data.recent.map(p => {
        const statusClass = p.status === "ongoing" ? "badge-approved" : p.status === "pending" ? "badge-rejected" : "badge-received";
        const daysAgo = Math.floor((new Date() - new Date(p.updatedAt)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const daysLabel = daysAgo === 0 ? "today" : daysAgo === 1 ? "1 day ago" : daysAgo + " days ago";
        const obstacleLine = (p.status === "pending" && p.obstacleReason)
          ? '<div class="disc-recent-body" style="color:#dc2626; margin-top:4px;"><span>Reason:</span><span class="disc-recent-days">' + escapeHtml(p.obstacleReason) + '</span></div>'
          : '';
        return '<div class="disc-recent-item">' +
          '<div class="disc-recent-head">' +
          '<span class="disc-recent-case">' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="badge ' + statusClass + '" style="font-size:9px; padding:2px 8px;">' + p.status.toUpperCase() + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="disc-recent-body">' +
          '<span>' + escapeHtml(p.department) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="disc-recent-days">' + daysLabel + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          obstacleLine +
          '</div>';
      }).join("");
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load projects summary:", e);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// WIDGET CONTROLS
// ============================================================
function setWidgetRange(type, range) {
  widgetState[type].range = range;
  saveWidgetState(type);

  const rangeEl = document.getElementById(type + "Range");
  if (rangeEl) {
    rangeEl.querySelectorAll(".range-btn").forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.range === range);
    });
  }

  const customEl = document.getElementById(type + "Custom");
  if (customEl) {
    customEl.style.display = range === "custom" ? "flex" : "none";
  }

  reloadWidget(type);
}

function onCustomDateChange(type) {
  const fromEl = document.getElementById(type + "From");
  const toEl = document.getElementById(type + "To");
  widgetState[type].from = fromEl?.value || null;
  widgetState[type].to = toEl?.value || null;
  saveWidgetState(type);
  reloadWidget(type);
}

function reloadWidget(type) {
  if (type === "patients") loadTodaySummary();
  else if (type === "tender") loadTenderActivity();
  else if (type === "disc") loadDisciplinarySummary();
  else if (type === "est") loadEstablishmentSummary();
  else if (type === "projects") loadProjectsSummary();
}

function restoreWidgetUI() {
  ["patients", "tender", "disc", "est", "projects"].forEach(type => {
    const state = widgetState[type];
    const rangeEl = document.getElementById(type + "Range");
    if (rangeEl) {
      rangeEl.querySelectorAll(".range-btn").forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.range === state.range);
      });
    }
    const customEl = document.getElementById(type + "Custom");
    if (customEl) {
      customEl.style.display = state.range === "custom" ? "flex" : "none";
    }
    if (state.range === "custom") {
      const fromEl = document.getElementById(type + "From");
      const toEl = document.getElementById(type + "To");
      if (fromEl && state.from) fromEl.value = state.from;
      if (toEl && state.to) toEl.value = state.to;
    }
  });
}

// ============================================================
// PATIENT SUMMARY
// ============================================================
async function loadPatientSummary() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/api/patients/summary");
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("summary fetch failed");
    const summary = await res.json();

    const c = summary.counts;
    const p = summary.percentages;

    document.getElementById("countAdmitted").textContent = c.admitted;
    document.getElementById("countTreatment").textContent = c.treatment;
    document.getElementById("countDischarged").textContent = c.discharged;
    document.getElementById("countDeceased").textContent = c.deceased;

    document.getElementById("pctAdmitted").textContent = p.admitted + "%";
    document.getElementById("pctTreatment").textContent = p.treatment + "%";
    document.getElementById("pctDischarged").textContent = p.discharged + "%";
    document.getElementById("pctDeceased").textContent = p.deceased + "%";

    document.getElementById("totalCount").textContent = summary.total + " total";

    document.getElementById("segA").style.width = p.admitted + "%";
    document.getElementById("segT").style.width = p.treatment + "%";
    document.getElementById("segD").style.width = p.discharged + "%";
    document.getElementById("segX").style.width = p.deceased + "%";

    document.getElementById("syncText").textContent = "SYNCED";
    document.getElementById("apiTarget").textContent = "Connected - " + window.location.host;
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById("syncText").textContent = "OFFLINE";
    document.getElementById("apiTarget").textContent = "Could not reach API - check server";
    console.error("Failed to load patient summary:", err);
  }
}

// GENERIC DETAIL MODAL

let currentDetailRequest = null;

const MODAL_TITLES = {
  patients: {
    admitted: "Admitted Patients",
    treatment: "Patients In Treatment",
    discharged: "Discharged Patients",
    followups: "Follow-ups Due Today",
    deceased: "Deceased Patients",
  },
  tenders: {
    pending: "Pending Tenders",
    awaiting_quotation: "Tenders Awaiting Quote",
    ordered: "Ordered Tenders",
    received: "Received Tenders",
  },
  discipline: {
    open: "Open Cases",
    under_investigation: "Cases Under Investigation",
    resolved: "Resolved Cases",
    dismissed: "Dismissed Cases",
    total: "All Cases",
  },
  establishment: {
    transfer: "Recent Transfers",
    retirement: "Recent Retirements",
    resignation: "Recent Resignations",
    understaffed: "Understaffed Departments",
    overstaffed: "Overstaffed Departments",
  },
  projects: {
    ongoing: "Ongoing Projects",
    pending: "Blocked Projects",
    completed: "Completed Projects",
  },
};

const DETAIL_ENDPOINTS = {
  patients: "/api/patients/detail-public",
  tenders: "/api/orders/detail-public",
  discipline: "/api/disciplinary/detail-public",
  establishment: "/api/establishment/detail-public",
  projects: "/api/projects/detail-public",
};

const WIDGET_STATE_KEY = {
  patients: "patients",
  tenders: "tender",
  discipline: "disc",
  establishment: "est",
  projects: "projects",
};

async function openDetailModal(source, category) {
  currentDetailRequest = { source, category };

  const title = (MODAL_TITLES[source] && MODAL_TITLES[source][category]) || "Details";
  document.getElementById("detailModalTitle").textContent = title;
  document.getElementById("detailModalCount").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("detailModalList").innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="text-align:center; padding:16px;">Loading...</p>';

  document.getElementById("detailModalBackdrop").classList.add("active");
  document.getElementById("detailModal").classList.add("active");

  try {
    const state = widgetState[WIDGET_STATE_KEY[source]];
    const { from, to } = computeRange(state.range, state.from, state.to);
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("category", category);
    params.set("from", toInputDate(from));
    params.set("to", toInputDate(to));

    const url = DETAIL_ENDPOINTS[source] + "?" + params.toString();
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load details");
    const rows = await res.json();

    renderDetailRows(source, category, rows);
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById("detailModalList").innerHTML =
      '<p class="error" style="text-align:center; padding:16px;">' + escapeHtml(e.message) + '</p>';
  }
}

function renderDetailRows(source, category, rows) {
  const list = document.getElementById("detailModalList");
  const count = document.getElementById("detailModalCount");
  count.textContent = "(" + rows.length + ")";

  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="patient-modal-empty">No records in this category</div>';
    return;
  }

  if (source === "patients") {
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(p => {
      const wardName = p.ward ? p.ward.name : "-";
      const time = fmtTime(p.updatedAt);
      return '<div class="patient-modal-item">' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-case">Case #' + p.id + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-ward">' + escapeHtml(wardName) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">' + time + '</span>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join("");
    return;
  }

  if (source === "tenders") {
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(t => {
      const dept = t.originatorDepartment || t.requestingDepartment || "-";
      const time = fmtTime(t.createdAt);
      return '<div class="patient-modal-item">' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-case">#' + t.id + ' ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-ward">' + escapeHtml(dept) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">' + time + '</span>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join("");
    return;
  }

  if (source === "discipline") {
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(c => {
      const dept = c.employee ? c.employee.department : "-";
      const reported = fmtDateShort(new Date(c.reportedDate));
      return '<div class="patient-modal-item">' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-case">' + escapeHtml(c.caseNumber) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-ward">' + escapeHtml(dept) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">' + escapeHtml(c.offenseType) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">' + reported + '</span>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join("");
    return;
  }

  if (source === "establishment") {
    if (category === "understaffed" || category === "overstaffed") {
      list.innerHTML = rows.map(d => {
        const targetText = d.max ? d.min + "-" + d.max : "min " + d.min;
        return '<div class="patient-modal-item">' +
          '<span class="patient-modal-item-case">' + escapeHtml(d.department) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="patient-modal-item-ward">Current: ' + d.current + '</span>' +
          '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">Target: ' + escapeHtml(targetText) + '</span>' +
          '</div>';
      }).join("");
      return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(m => {
      const date = m.effectiveDate || m.createdAt;
      let detail = "";
      if (m.movementType === "transfer") {
        detail = (m.fromDepartment || "?") + " to " + (m.toDepartment || "?");
      } else if (m.reason) {
        detail = m.reason;
      }
      return '<div class="patient-modal-item">' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-case">' + escapeHtml(detail) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-ward">' + escapeHtml(m.employee ? m.employee.department : "-") + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">' + fmtDateShort(new Date(date)) + '</span>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join("");
    return;
  }

  if (source === "projects") {
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(p => {
      const updated = fmtDateShort(new Date(p.updatedAt));
      const obstacleLine = (p.status === "pending" && p.obstacleReason)
        ? '<div style="margin-top:8px; padding:8px 12px; background:#fef2f2; border-left:3px solid #dc2626; border-radius:4px; font-size:12px; color:#991b1b;">' +
          '<strong>Blocked reason:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.obstacleReason) +
          '</div>'
        : '';

      return '<div class="patient-modal-item" style="flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; padding:14px;">' +
        '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:10px;">' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-case">' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">' + updated + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:6px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-ward">' + escapeHtml(p.department) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="patient-modal-item-time">Head: ' + escapeHtml(p.projectHead || '-') + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        obstacleLine +
        '</div>';
    }).join("");
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = '<div class="patient-modal-empty">Unsupported category</div>';
}

function closeDetailModal() {
  currentDetailRequest = null;
  document.getElementById("detailModalBackdrop").classList.remove("active");
  document.getElementById("detailModal").classList.remove("active");
}

async function loadEmployeeSummary() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/api/employees/summary", {
      headers: AUTH_TOKEN ? { Authorization: "Bearer " + AUTH_TOKEN } : {},
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load employee summary");
    const summary = await res.json();

    document.getElementById("staffOnDuty").textContent = summary.active || 0;
    document.getElementById("staffOnLeave").textContent = summary.on_leave || 0;
    document.getElementById("staffSick").textContent = summary.sick || 0;
    document.getElementById("staffTotal").textContent = (summary.total - summary.terminated) || 0;

    if (summary.byDepartment && summary.byDepartment.length > 0) {
      document.getElementById("deptList").innerHTML = summary.byDepartment
        .map((d) => "<p>" + d.department + ": <strong>" + d.count + "</strong></p>")
        .join("");
    } else {
      document.getElementById("deptList").innerHTML = "<p>No department data available</p>";
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load employee summary:", e);
    document.getElementById("deptList").innerHTML = "<p>Failed to load data</p>";
  }
}

function toggleEmployeeView() {
  document.getElementById("deptBreakdown").classList.toggle("active");
}

// ============================================================
// SOCKET
// ============================================================
const socket = io({
  transports: ["websocket", "polling"],
  reconnection: true,
  reconnectionAttempts: Infinity,
  reconnectionDelay: 1000,
  reconnectionDelayMax: 10000,
  randomizationFactor: 0.5,
  timeout: 20000,
});

socket.on("connect", () => {
  console.log("Socket connected");
  document.getElementById("syncText").textContent = "CONNECTED";

  // Delay initial load 800ms so the WebSocket handshake completes
  // before the fetch burst competes for bandwidth.
  setTimeout(refreshAllWidgets, 800);
});

socket.on("disconnect", (reason) => {
  console.log("Socket disconnected:", reason);
  document.getElementById("syncText").textContent = "DISCONNECTED";
});

socket.on("reconnect_attempt", (attempt) => {
  document.getElementById("syncText").textContent = "RECONNECTING " + attempt;
});

socket.on("reconnect_failed", () => {
  document.getElementById("syncText").textContent = "OFFLINE";
});

socket.on("patient:updated", (payload) => {
  showToast("Case #" + payload.id + " - " + String(payload.status).toUpperCase());
  loadPatientSummary();
  loadTodaySummary();
});

socket.on("patient:created", (payload) => {
  showToast("New patient registered: Case #" + payload.id);
  loadPatientSummary();
  loadTodaySummary();
});

socket.on("employee:updated", () => {
  loadEmployeeSummary();
  loadEstablishmentSummary();
});

socket.on("employee:created", (payload) => {
  showToast("New employee added: " + payload.name);
  loadEmployeeSummary();
});

socket.on("establishment:updated", () => {
  loadEstablishmentSummary();
});

socket.on("inventory:updated", () => {
  showToast("Inventory updated");
});

socket.on("order:updated", () => {
  showToast("Order status updated");
  loadTenderActivity();
});

socket.on("order:created", () => {
  showToast("New tender submitted");
  loadTenderActivity();
});

socket.on("disciplinary:created", () => {
  showToast("New disciplinary case filed");
  loadDisciplinarySummary();
});

socket.on("disciplinary:updated", () => {
  showToast("Disciplinary case updated");
  loadDisciplinarySummary();
});

socket.on("project:created", () => {
  showToast("New project created");
  loadProjectsSummary();
});

socket.on("project:updated", () => {
  showToast("Project updated");
  loadProjectsSummary();
});

socket.on("project:deleted", () => {
  showToast("Project deleted");
  loadProjectsSummary();
});

// ============================================================
// FALLBACK REFRESH — only when socket is dead
// ============================================================
setInterval(() => {
  const state = document.getElementById("syncText").textContent;
  if (state === "OFFLINE" || state === "DISCONNECTED" || state.startsWith("RECONNECTING")) {
    refreshAllWidgets();
  }
}, 60000);

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    const modal = document.getElementById("detailModal");
    if (modal && modal.classList.contains("active")) {
      closeDetailModal();
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById("deptBreakdown").classList.remove("active");
  }
  if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") {
    refreshAllWidgets();
    showToast("Manual refresh triggered");
  }
  if (e.key === "t" || e.key === "T") {
    toggleEmployeeView();
  }
});

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
  if (!document.hidden) {
    refreshAllWidgets();
  }
});

const socket = io();
let currentUser = null;
let currentDeptKey = null;
let currentDeptName = null;

function token() { return localStorage.getItem('token'); }

const DEPT_MAP = {

async function loadSystemSettings() {

    const res = await fetch('/api/settings/public');
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();
    systemSettings = {
      hospitalName: data.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital',
      hospitalSubtitle: data.hospitalSubtitle || 'Department Dashboard',
      contactPhone: data.contactPhone || '',
      contactAddress: data.contactAddress || '',

    console.error('Failed to load settings:', e);
  }
}

  if (subtitle) subtitle.textContent = systemSettings.hospitalSubtitle;
  document.title = systemSettings.hospitalName + ' - Dashboard';
}

// ============================================================
// URL SYNC

function setURL(path, replace = false) {
  try {
    if (replace) {
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', path);
    } else {
      window.history.pushState({}, '', path);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Could not update URL:', e);
  }
}

function getDeptFromURL() {
  const path = window.location.pathname;
  return URL_TO_DEPT[path] || null;
}

// ============================================================
// AUTH
// ============================================================
async function login() {
  const dept = document.getElementById('department').value;
  const username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('password').value;

  const isSuperAdminAttempt = username === 'Admin';

  if (!username || !password) {
    return showLoginError('Username and password required');
  }

  if (!isSuperAdminAttempt && !dept) {
    return showLoginError('Please select a department');
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ username, password, department: dept }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Login failed');

    localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
    currentUser = data.user;
    currentDeptName = data.user.department;
    currentDeptKey = DEPT_MAP[currentDeptName]?.key;

    await loadPortal(currentDeptName);
  } catch (e) {
    showLoginError(e.message);
  }
}

function updateLoginButton() {
  const dept = document.getElementById('department').value;
  const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
  if (btn) btn.disabled = !dept;
}

function showLoginError(msg) {
  const el = document.getElementById('loginError');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.style.display = 'block';
}

async function loadPortal(deptName) {
  const dept = DEPT_MAP[deptName];
  if (!dept) return showLoginError('Unknown department');

  try {
    const htmlRes = await fetch(dept.fragment);
    if (!htmlRes.ok) throw new Error('Could not load ' + dept.fragment);
    const html = await htmlRes.text();
    document.getElementById('portalContainer').innerHTML = html;

    await loadScript(dept.script);
    await loadScript('js/projects.js');

    document.getElementById('login').style.display = 'none';

    // Show the user's name and buttons
    const userWrap = document.getElementById('headerUser');
    userWrap.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    document.getElementById('headerUserLabel').textContent =
      currentUser.fullName + ' (' + currentDeptName + ')';

    const btnOwnPwd = document.getElementById('btnOwnPwd');
    const btnBackHome = document.getElementById('btnBackHome');
    const btnDashboard = document.getElementById('btnDashboard');

    if (currentDeptName === 'SuperAdmin') {
      btnOwnPwd.style.display = 'none';
      btnBackHome.style.display = 'inline-block';
      if (btnDashboard) btnDashboard.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      btnOwnPwd.style.display = 'inline-block';
      btnBackHome.style.display = 'none';
      if (btnDashboard) btnDashboard.style.display = 'inline-block';
    }

    setURL(dept.url);

    const initFn = window['init_' + dept.key];
    if (typeof initFn === 'function') await initFn();

    if (typeof window.init_projects === 'function') {
      await window.init_projects();
    } else {
      console.warn('Projects module not loaded correctly.');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    showLoginError(e.message);
  }
}

function loadScript(src) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (document.querySelector('script[src="' + src + '"]')) return resolve();
    const s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = src;
    s.onload = resolve;
    s.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load ' + src));
    document.body.appendChild(s);
  });
}

function logout() {
  localStorage.removeItem('token');
  window.location.href = '/dashboard';
}

    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('ownPwdModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');

  document.getElementById('ownNewPwd').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ownPwdMessage').innerHTML = '';
}

async function changeOwnPassword() {
  const currentPassword = document.getElementById('ownCurrentPwd').value;
  const newPassword = document.getElementById('ownNewPwd').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('ownPwdMessage');

  if (!currentPassword || !newPassword) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Both fields required</div>';
    return;
  }
  if (newPassword.length < 6) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Minimum 6 characters</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/change-password', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ currentPassword, newPassword }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed');
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Password updated</div>';
    setTimeout(closeOwnPasswordModal, 1200);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

async function openSettingsModal() {
  if (currentDeptName !== 'SuperAdmin') return;

  document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('settingsMessage').innerHTML = '';

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/settings/admin', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load settings');
    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById('settingsHospitalName').value = data.hospital_name || '';
    document.getElementById('settingsSubtitle').value = data.hospital_subtitle || '';
    document.getElementById('settingsPhone').value = data.contact_phone || '';
    document.getElementById('settingsAddress').value = data.contact_address || '';
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('settingsMessage').innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

function closeSettingsModal() {
  document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
}

async function saveSystemSettings() {
  const msg = document.getElementById('settingsMessage');
  const payload = {
    hospital_name: document.getElementById('settingsHospitalName').value.trim(),
    hospital_subtitle: document.getElementById('settingsSubtitle').value.trim(),
    contact_phone: document.getElementById('settingsPhone').value.trim(),
    contact_address: document.getElementById('settingsAddress').value.trim(),
  };

  if (!payload.hospital_name) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Hospital name is required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/settings/admin', {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed');

    systemSettings.hospitalName = payload.hospital_name;
    systemSettings.hospitalSubtitle = payload.hospital_subtitle;
    systemSettings.contactPhone = payload.contact_phone;
    systemSettings.contactAddress = payload.contact_address;
    applySettingsToShell();

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Settings saved</div>';
    setTimeout(closeSettingsModal, 1000);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// SHARED HELPERS
// ============================================================
function statusBadge(status) {
  const map = {
    pending: 'badge-pending',
    approved: 'badge-approved',
    rejected: 'badge-rejected',
    awaiting_quotation: 'badge-awaiting_quotation',
    ordered: 'badge-ordered',
    received: 'badge-received',
    in_storage: 'badge-received',
  };
  const cls = map[status] || 'badge-pending';
  return '<span class="badge ' + cls + '">' + String(status).toUpperCase().replace('_', ' ') + '</span>';
}

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c =>
    ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return '-';
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-GB');
}

function fmtDateTime(d) {
  if (!d) return '-';
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString('en-GB');
}

function toInputDate(d) {
  const dt = d instanceof Date ? d : new Date(d);
  const yyyy = dt.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(dt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return yyyy + '-' + mm + '-' + dd;
}

function printContent(html) {
  const area = document.getElementById('printArea');
  if (!area) { console.error('printArea element not found'); return; }
  area.innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => {
    window.print();
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', function clear() {
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', clear);
      area.innerHTML = '';
    });
  }, 200);
}

// ============================================================
// SOCKET DISPATCH
// ============================================================
function _dispatch(event, handler) {
  socket.on(event, (p) => {
    if (!token()) return;
    handler(p);
  });
}

_dispatch('patient:updated',       (p) => window.onPatientUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('patient:created',       (p) => window.onPatientCreated?.(p));
_dispatch('order:updated',         (p) => window.onOrderUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('order:created',         (p) => window.onOrderCreated?.(p));
_dispatch('inventory:updated',     (p) => window.onInventoryUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('employee:updated',      (p) => window.onEmployeeUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('establishment:updated', (p) => window.onEstablishmentUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('disciplinary:created',  (p) => window.onDisciplinaryUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('disciplinary:updated',  (p) => window.onDisciplinaryUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('project:created',       (p) => window.onProjectUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('project:updated',       (p) => window.onProjectUpdated?.(p));
_dispatch('project:deleted',       (p) => window.onProjectUpdated?.(p));

// ============================================================
// AUTO-LOGIN FROM URL
// ============================================================
async function tryAutoLogin() {
  const t = token();
  if (!t) return false;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/me', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return false;
    const user = await res.json();
    currentUser = user;
    currentDeptName = user.department;
    currentDeptKey = DEPT_MAP[currentDeptName]?.key;
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// INIT
// ============================================================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
  loadSystemSettings();
  updateLoginButton();

  const pwd = document.getElementById('password');
  if (pwd) {
    pwd.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        login();
      }
    });
  }

  const urlDept = getDeptFromURL();
  if (urlDept) {
    const ok = await tryAutoLogin();
    if (ok) {
      const targetDept = (urlDept === currentUser.department || currentUser.department === 'SuperAdmin')
        ? urlDept
        : currentUser.department;
      await loadPortal(targetDept);
    }
  }
});

let deferredPrompt;

window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  deferredPrompt = e;
});

async function installApp() {
  if (deferredPrompt) {
    deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    console.log(`User response to the install prompt: ${outcome}`);
    deferredPrompt = null;
  } else {
    document.getElementById('installModal').classList.add('active');
  }
}
// ============================================================
// GLOBAL AUTO-WRAPPER FOR TABLES (CAP AT 9 ROWS)
// ============================================================
function applySmartTableScroll() {
  // Find all tables that aren't already wrapped
  document.querySelectorAll('table.data-table').forEach(table => {
    if (table.parentElement.classList.contains('smart-table-wrap')) return;

    // Create the wrapper
    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'smart-table-wrap';
    wrapper.style.maxHeight = '300px'; // ~5 rows
    wrapper.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
    wrapper.style.border = '1.5px solid var(--border-soft)';
    wrapper.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-sm)';
    wrapper.style.marginBottom = '12px';

    // Insert the wrapper before the table and move the table into it
    table.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, table);
    wrapper.appendChild(table);

    // Make the header sticky
    const thead = table.querySelector('thead');
    if (thead) {
      thead.style.position = 'sticky';
      thead.style.top = '0';
      thead.style.zIndex = '10';
      thead.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
        th.style.background = 'var(--surface-alt)';
        th.style.boxShadow = '0 1px 0 var(--border)';
      });
    }
  });
}

// Run this automatically whenever new data is loaded into the DOM
const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
  applySmartTableScroll();
});
observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

// ============================================================
// GLOBAL THEME TOGGLE
// ============================================================
function applyTheme(theme) {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
  localStorage.setItem('mushamumwe_theme', theme);
  
  const btn = document.getElementById('themeToggleBtn');
  if (btn) {
    btn.textContent = theme === 'light' ? '🌙 Dark' : '☀️ Light';
  }
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'light';
  const next = current === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
  applyTheme(next);
}

// Run immediately to prevent flash of wrong theme
(function initTheme() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('mushamumwe_theme') || 'light';
  applyTheme(saved);
})();

async function init_hr() {
  await loadWards();
  await runStaffSearch();
  await loadStaffingSummary();
  await loadMyTenders();

  await loadDisciplinaryMetadata();
  await loadDisciplinarySummary();
  await runDisciplinarySearch();
  await populateEmployeeDropdown();
  wireDisciplinaryUpload();

  await loadEstablishmentSummary();
  await loadEstablishmentMetadata();
  await runEstMovementSearch();
  await populateEstDropdowns();
  loadHeadcountSettings();

  window.onEmployeeUpdated = () => {
    runStaffSearch();
    loadStaffingSummary();
  };
  window.onOrderUpdated = (payload) => {
    const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();
    const sub = String(payload && payload.department || '').toLowerCase();
    const orig = String(payload && payload.originator || '').toLowerCase();
    if (sub === myDept || orig === myDept) loadMyTenders();
  };
  window.onDisciplinaryUpdated = () => {
    loadDisciplinarySummary();
    runDisciplinarySearch();
  };
  window.onEstablishmentUpdated = () => {
    loadEstablishmentSummary();
    runEstMovementSearch();
    loadHeadcountSettings();
  };
}

async function loadWards() {
  const res = await fetch('/api/wards', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
  if (!res.ok) return;
  const wards = await res.json();

  const empWard = document.getElementById('hr-empWard');
  if (empWard) {
    empWard.innerHTML = '<option value="">None</option>' +
      wards.map(w => '<option value="' + w.id + '">' + escapeHtml(w.name) + '</option>').join('');
  }

  const transferWard = document.getElementById('estTransferToWard');
  if (transferWard) {
    transferWard.innerHTML = '<option value="">None</option>' +
      wards.map(w => '<option value="' + w.id + '">' + escapeHtml(w.name) + '</option>').join('');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// STAFF SEARCH AND ROSTER
// ============================================================
function debouncedStaffSearch() {
  clearTimeout(staffSearchTimer);
  staffSearchTimer = setTimeout(runStaffSearch, 300);
}

function toggleAdvancedStaffFilters() {
  const el = document.getElementById('hr-advancedFilters');
  el.style.display = el.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
}

async function runStaffSearch() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('hr-empSearchBox').value.trim();
  const department = document.getElementById('hr-filterDept').value;
  const status = document.getElementById('hr-filterStatus').value;
  const role = document.getElementById('hr-filterRole').value.trim();
  const from = document.getElementById('hr-filterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('hr-filterTo').value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (department && department !== 'all') params.set('department', department);
  if (status && status !== 'all') params.set('status', status);
  if (role) params.set('role', role);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/employees?' + params, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load staff');
    allEmployees = await res.json();
    renderStaffRoster();
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('hr-empRosterTable').innerHTML =
      '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

function clearStaffFilters() {
  document.getElementById('hr-empSearchBox').value = '';
  document.getElementById('hr-filterDept').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('hr-filterStatus').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('hr-filterRole').value = '';
  document.getElementById('hr-filterFrom').value = '';
  document.getElementById('hr-filterTo').value = '';
  runStaffSearch();
}

function renderStaffRoster() {
  const el = document.getElementById('hr-empRosterTable');

  if (allEmployees.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No staff found</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table">' +
    '<thead><tr>' +
    '<th>Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Role</th><th>Ward</th><th>Status</th><th>Action</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
    allEmployees.map(e => {
      const wardName = e.ward ? e.ward.name : '-';
      const cls = {
        active: 'status-ok',
        on_leave: 'status-low',
        sick: 'status-critical',
        terminated: 'status-terminated',
        retired: 'status-terminated',
        resigned: 'status-terminated',
      }[e.status] || 'status-ok';

      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.name) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.department) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.role || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(wardName) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="status-pill ' + cls + '">' + escapeHtml(e.status) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><button class="pill-btn" onclick="openEmpModal(' + e.id + ', \'' +
        e.name.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\', \'' + e.status + '\')">Update</button></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('') +
    '</tbody></table>';
}

// ============================================================
// ADD EMPLOYEE
// ============================================================
async function addEmployee() {
  const name = document.getElementById('hr-empName').value.trim();
  const department = document.getElementById('hr-empDept').value;
  const role = document.getElementById('hr-empRole').value.trim();
  const wardId = document.getElementById('hr-empWard').value;
  const hireDate = document.getElementById('hr-empHireDate').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('hr-empAddMessage');

  if (!name || !hireDate) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Name and hire date required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/employees', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name, department, role,
        wardId: wardId ? parseInt(wardId) : null,
        hireDate,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Employee hired</div>';
    document.getElementById('hr-empName').value = '';
    document.getElementById('hr-empRole').value = '';
    document.getElementById('hr-empHireDate').value = '';
    await runStaffSearch();
    await loadStaffingSummary();
    await populateEmployeeDropdown();
    await populateEstDropdowns();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

function openEmpModal(id, name, status) {
  selectedEmployeeId = id;
  document.getElementById('modalEmpName').textContent = name;
  document.getElementById('empStatusSelect').value = status;
  document.getElementById('empStatusModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

function closeEmpModal() {
  document.getElementById('empStatusModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
  selectedEmployeeId = null;
}

async function updateEmployeeStatus() {
  const status = document.getElementById('empStatusSelect').value;
  if (!selectedEmployeeId) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/employees/' + selectedEmployeeId + '/status', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Update failed');
    closeEmpModal();
    await runStaffSearch();
    await loadStaffingSummary();
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

async function loadStaffingSummary() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/employees/summary', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const s = await res.json();

    document.getElementById('hr-empOnDuty').textContent = s.active || 0;
    document.getElementById('hr-empOnLeave').textContent = s.on_leave || 0;
    document.getElementById('hr-empSick').textContent = s.sick || 0;
    document.getElementById('hr-empTerminated').textContent = s.terminated || 0;
    document.getElementById('hr-empTotal').textContent = s.total || 0;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

// PRINT - STAFF ROSTER
// ============================================================
function printStaffRoster() {
  if (allEmployees.length === 0) {
    alert('No employees to print. Adjust filters.');
    return;
  }

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const phone = systemSettings.contactPhone || '';
  const address = systemSettings.contactAddress || '';
  const now = new Date();

  const filterParts = [];
  const search = document.getElementById('hr-empSearchBox').value.trim();
  const department = document.getElementById('hr-filterDept').value;
  const status = document.getElementById('hr-filterStatus').value;
  const role = document.getElementById('hr-filterRole').value.trim();
  const from = document.getElementById('hr-filterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('hr-filterTo').value;

  if (search) filterParts.push('Search="' + search + '"');
  if (department && department !== 'all') filterParts.push('Department=' + department);
  if (status && status !== 'all') filterParts.push('Status=' + status);
  if (role) filterParts.push('Role="' + role + '"');
  if (from) filterParts.push('Hired From=' + from);
  if (to) filterParts.push('Hired To=' + to);

  const filterLine = filterParts.length > 0
    ? 'Filters: ' + filterParts.join(', ')
    : 'Filters: none (all employees)';

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header">';
  html += '<h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1>';
  html += '<h2>Staff Roster</h2>';
  html += '</div>';

  if (phone || address) {
    html += '<div class="print-contact">';
    if (address) html += '<p>' + escapeHtml(address) + '</p>';
    if (phone) html += '<p>Tel: ' + escapeHtml(phone) + '</p>';
    html += '</div>';
  }

  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Total Employees:</strong> ' + allEmployees.length + '</p>';
  html += '<p><strong>Report Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '<p style="grid-column: span 2;"><strong>' + escapeHtml(filterLine) + '</strong></p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<table class="print-table">';
  html += '<thead><tr>';
  html += '<th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Role</th><th>Ward</th><th>Status</th><th>Hired</th>';
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  allEmployees.forEach((e, i) => {
    const wardName = e.ward ? e.ward.name : '-';
    const hireDate = e.hireDate ? fmtDate(e.hireDate) : '-';
    html += '<tr>';
    html += '<td>' + (i + 1) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.name) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.department) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.role || '-') + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(wardName) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(e.status) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + hireDate + '</td>';
    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table>';
  html += '<div class="print-footer">';
  html += escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now);
  html += '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => window.print(), 200);
}

// ============================================================
// TENDERS - SUBMIT
// ============================================================
async function submitTenderRequest(deptKey) {
  const originatorDepartment = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqOriginator') ?
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqOriginator').value : currentDeptName;
  const itemName = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqItemName').value.trim();
  const quantity = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqQuantity').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqReason').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-requestMessage');

  if (!itemName || !quantity || !reason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">All fields required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/request', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ itemName, quantity: parseInt(quantity), reason, originatorDepartment }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Request submitted</div>';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqItemName').value = '';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqQuantity').value = '';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqReason').value = '';
    await loadMyTenders();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// TENDERS - TRACKER
// ============================================================
async function loadMyTenders() {
  const res = await fetch('/api/orders/my', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
  if (!res.ok) return;
  allTenders = await res.json();
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function setTenderFilter(btn) {
  const parent = btn.closest('.filter-bar');
  if (parent) {
    parent.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  }
  btn.classList.add('active');
  tenderFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function filterTenders() { renderTenderTracker(); }

function renderTenderTracker() {
  const el = document.getElementById('hr-tenderTrackerList');
  const q = (document.getElementById('hr-tenderSearch') ?
    document.getElementById('hr-tenderSearch').value : '').toLowerCase();

  let list = allTenders;
  if (tenderFilter !== 'all') list = list.filter(t => t.status === tenderFilter);
  if (q) list = list.filter(t => String(t.itemName).toLowerCase().includes(q));

  if (list.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No tenders</div>';
    return;
  }

  const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();

  el.innerHTML = list.map(t => {
    const submitter = t.requestingDepartment || '';
    const originator = t.originatorDepartment || submitter;
    const submittedByMe = String(submitter).toLowerCase() === myDept;
    const submittedForMe = String(originator).toLowerCase() === myDept;

    let meta = 'Requested by: ' + escapeHtml(submitter);
    if (!submittedByMe && submittedForMe) {
      meta = 'Requested FOR your department by ' + escapeHtml(submitter);
    } else if (submittedByMe && originator.toLowerCase() !== submitter.toLowerCase()) {
      meta = 'Submitted by you FOR ' + escapeHtml(originator);
    }

    return '<div class="tender-card">' +
      '<div class="tender-head">' +
      '<div>' +
      '<strong>#' + t.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</strong>' +
      '<div class="muted">' + meta + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div>' + statusBadge(t.status) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="tender-body"><p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.reason) + '</p></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

// PRINT - MY TENDERS
// ============================================================
function printMyTenders() {
  if (!allTenders || allTenders.length === 0) {
    alert('No tenders to print.');
    return;
  }

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const phone = systemSettings.contactPhone || '';
  const address = systemSettings.contactAddress || '';
  const now = new Date();

  const filterParts = [];
  const q = (document.getElementById('hr-tenderSearch') ?
    document.getElementById('hr-tenderSearch').value : '').trim();
  if (tenderFilter && tenderFilter !== 'all') filterParts.push('Status=' + tenderFilter);
  if (q) filterParts.push('Search="' + q + '"');
  const filterLine = filterParts.length > 0 ? 'Filters: ' + filterParts.join(', ') : 'Filters: none';

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header">';
  html += '<h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1>';
  html += '<h2>My Department Tenders - ' + escapeHtml(currentDeptName || '') + '</h2>';
  html += '</div>';

  if (phone || address) {
    html += '<div class="print-contact">';
    if (address) html += '<p>' + escapeHtml(address) + '</p>';
    if (phone) html += '<p>Tel: ' + escapeHtml(phone) + '</p>';
    html += '</div>';
  }

  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Total:</strong> ' + allTenders.length + '</p>';
  html += '<p><strong>Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '<p style="grid-column: span 2;"><strong>' + escapeHtml(filterLine) + '</strong></p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<table class="print-table">';
  html += '<thead><tr>';
  html += '<th>#</th><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Reason</th><th>Status</th><th>Requested By</th><th>Date</th>';
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  allTenders.forEach((t, i) => {
    const statusLabel = String(t.status || '').replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
    html += '<tr>';
    html += '<td>' + (i + 1) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(t.itemName || '') + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + t.quantity + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(t.reason || '') + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(statusLabel) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(t.requestingBy || '') + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + fmtDate(t.createdAt) + '</td>';
    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table>';
  html += '<div class="print-footer">';
  html += escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now);
  html += '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => window.print(), 200);
}
