async function loadDisciplinaryMetadata() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary/metadata', {

      newOffenseSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose offense --</option>' +
        disciplinaryMetadata.offenses.map(o => '<option value="' + escapeHtml(o) + '">' + escapeHtml(o) + '</option>').join('');

    if (editActionSel) {
      editActionSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- None --</option>' +
        disciplinaryMetadata.actions.map(a => '<option value="' + escapeHtml(a) + '">' + escapeHtml(a) + '</option>').join('');

    console.error(e);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// LABOUR RELATIONS - SEARCH AND RENDER
// ============================================================
function debouncedDisciplinarySearch() {
  clearTimeout(discSearchTimer);
  discSearchTimer = setTimeout(runDisciplinarySearch, 300);
}

async function runDisciplinarySearch() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('discSearchBox').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('discFilterStatus').value;
  const offense = document.getElementById('discFilterOffense').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('discFilterDept').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('discFilterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('discFilterTo').value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (status && status !== 'all') params.set('status', status);
  if (offense && offense !== 'all') params.set('offense', offense);
  if (department && department !== 'all') params.set('department', department);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary?' + params, {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load cases');
    allDisciplinaryCases = await res.json();
    renderDisciplinaryCases();
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('discCaseList').innerHTML = '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

function clearDisciplinaryFilters() {
  document.getElementById('discSearchBox').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discFilterStatus').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('discFilterOffense').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('discFilterDept').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('discFilterFrom').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discFilterTo').value = '';
  runDisciplinarySearch();
}

function disciplinaryStatusBadge(status) {
  const cls = 'badge-disc-' + status;
  const labels = {
    open: 'OPEN',
    under_investigation: 'INVESTIGATING',
    resolved: 'RESOLVED',
    dismissed: 'DISMISSED',
  };
  return '<span class="badge ' + cls + '">' + (labels[status] || status.toUpperCase()) + '</span>';
}

function renderDisciplinaryCases() {
  const el = document.getElementById('discCaseList');

  if (allDisciplinaryCases.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No disciplinary cases on record</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table">' +
    '<thead><tr>' +
    '<th>Case #</th><th>Employee</th><th>Dept</th><th>Offense</th>' +
    '<th>Status</th><th>Reported</th><th>Action</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
    allDisciplinaryCases.map(c => {
      const empName = c.employee ? c.employee.name : '-';
      const empDept = c.employee ? c.employee.department : '-';
      const reported = c.reportedDate ? fmtDate(c.reportedDate) : '-';

      return '<tr>' +
        '<td><strong>' + escapeHtml(c.caseNumber) + '</strong></td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(empName) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(empDept) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(c.offenseType) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + disciplinaryStatusBadge(c.status) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + reported + '</td>' +
        '<td><button class="pill-btn" onclick="openDisciplinaryDetail(' + c.id + ')">Open</button></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('') +
    '</tbody></table>';
}

// ============================================================
// PRINT - LABOUR RELATIONS CASES
// ============================================================
function printDisciplinaryCases() {
  if (!allDisciplinaryCases || allDisciplinaryCases.length === 0) {
    alert('No disciplinary cases to print. Adjust filters.');
    return;
  }

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const phone = systemSettings.contactPhone || '';
  const address = systemSettings.contactAddress || '';
  const now = new Date();

  const filterParts = [];
  const search = document.getElementById('discSearchBox').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('discFilterStatus').value;
  const offense = document.getElementById('discFilterOffense').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('discFilterDept').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('discFilterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('discFilterTo').value;

  if (search) filterParts.push('Search="' + search + '"');
  if (status && status !== 'all') filterParts.push('Status=' + status.replace('_', ' '));
  if (offense && offense !== 'all') filterParts.push('Offense=' + offense);
  if (department && department !== 'all') filterParts.push('Department=' + department);
  if (from) filterParts.push('From=' + from);
  if (to) filterParts.push('To=' + to);

  const filterLine = filterParts.length > 0
    ? 'Filters: ' + filterParts.join(', ')
    : 'Filters: none (all cases)';

  const statusCounts = { open: 0, under_investigation: 0, resolved: 0, dismissed: 0 };
  allDisciplinaryCases.forEach(c => {
    statusCounts[c.status] = (statusCounts[c.status] || 0) + 1;
  });

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header">';
  html += '<h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1>';
  html += '<h2>Labour Relations - Disciplinary Cases</h2>';
  html += '</div>';

  if (phone || address) {
    html += '<div class="print-contact">';
    if (address) html += '<p>' + escapeHtml(address) + '</p>';
    if (phone) html += '<p>Tel: ' + escapeHtml(phone) + '</p>';
    html += '</div>';
  }

  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Total Cases:</strong> ' + allDisciplinaryCases.length + '</p>';
  html += '<p><strong>Report Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '<p style="grid-column: span 2;"><strong>' + escapeHtml(filterLine) + '</strong></p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<div class="print-section">';
  html += '<h3>Status Summary</h3>';
  html += '<p><strong>Open:</strong> ' + statusCounts.open +
          ' &nbsp;&nbsp; <strong>Under Investigation:</strong> ' + statusCounts.under_investigation +
          ' &nbsp;&nbsp; <strong>Resolved:</strong> ' + statusCounts.resolved +
          ' &nbsp;&nbsp; <strong>Dismissed:</strong> ' + statusCounts.dismissed +
          '</p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<table class="print-table">';
  html += '<thead><tr>';
  html += '<th>#</th>';
  html += '<th>Case #</th>';
  html += '<th>Employee</th>';
  html += '<th>Dept</th>';
  html += '<th>Offense</th>';
  html += '<th>Status</th>';
  html += '<th>Reported</th>';
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  allDisciplinaryCases.forEach((c, i) => {
    const empName = c.employee ? c.employee.name : '-';
    const empDept = c.employee ? c.employee.department : '-';
    const reported = c.reportedDate ? fmtDate(c.reportedDate) : '-';
    const statusLabel = (c.status || '').replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();

    html += '<tr>';
    html += '<td>' + (i + 1) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(c.caseNumber || '') + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(empName) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(empDept) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(c.offenseType || '') + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(statusLabel) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + reported + '</td>';
    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table>';
  html += '<div class="print-footer">';
  html += escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now);
  html += '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => window.print(), 200);
}

function openDisciplinaryNewModal() {
  document.getElementById('discNewEmployee').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discNewOffense').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discNewDescription').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discNewReportedBy').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discNewReportedDate').value = toInputDate(new Date());
  document.getElementById('discNewWitnesses').value = '';
  document.getElementById('discNewMessage').innerHTML = '';

  document.getElementById('disciplinaryNewModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

  document.getElementById('disciplinaryNewModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
}

async function submitNewDisciplinaryCase() {
  const msg = document.getElementById('discNewMessage');
  const employeeId = document.getElementById('discNewEmployee').value;
  const offenseType = document.getElementById('discNewOffense').value;
  const description = document.getElementById('discNewDescription').value.trim();
  const reportedBy = document.getElementById('discNewReportedBy').value.trim();
  const reportedDate = document.getElementById('discNewReportedDate').value;
  const witnesses = document.getElementById('discNewWitnesses').value.trim();

  if (!employeeId || !offenseType || !description || !reportedBy || !reportedDate) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">All required fields must be filled</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ employeeId, offenseType, description, reportedBy, reportedDate, witnesses }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Case ' + data.caseNumber + ' filed</div>';
    setTimeout(() => {
      closeDisciplinaryNewModal();
      loadDisciplinarySummary();
      runDisciplinarySearch();
    }, 900);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// LABOUR RELATIONS - DETAIL MODAL
// ============================================================
async function openDisciplinaryDetail(caseId) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary/' + caseId, {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load case');
    const c = await res.json();

    currentOpenCaseId = caseId;

    document.getElementById('discDetailTitle').textContent = c.caseNumber;
    document.getElementById('discDetailMeta').textContent =
      (c.employee ? c.employee.name + ' - ' + c.employee.department : '') +
      (c.employee && c.employee.role ? ' - ' + c.employee.role : '');

    document.getElementById('discDetailStatusRow').innerHTML =
      disciplinaryStatusBadge(c.status) +
      (c.closedBy ? '<span class="muted" style="margin-left:10px;">Closed by ' + escapeHtml(c.closedBy) + ' on ' + fmtDate(c.closedDate) + '</span>' : '') +
      (c.reopenedBy ? '<span class="muted" style="margin-left:10px;">Reopened by ' + escapeHtml(c.reopenedBy) + ' on ' + fmtDate(c.reopenedDate) + '</span>' : '');

    document.getElementById('discDetailOffense').textContent = c.offenseType;
    document.getElementById('discDetailDescription').textContent = c.description;
    document.getElementById('discDetailReportedBy').textContent = c.reportedBy;
    document.getElementById('discDetailReportedDate').textContent = fmtDate(c.reportedDate);
    document.getElementById('discDetailWitnesses').textContent = c.witnesses || 'None';

    document.getElementById('discEditAction').value = c.actionTaken || '';
    document.getElementById('discEditHearingDate').value = c.hearingDate ? toInputDate(new Date(c.hearingDate)) : '';
    document.getElementById('discEditActionDetails').value = c.actionDetails || '';
    document.getElementById('discEditHearingNotes').value = c.hearingNotes || '';
    document.getElementById('discEditEffectiveDate').value = c.effectiveDate ? toInputDate(new Date(c.effectiveDate)) : '';
    document.getElementById('discEditDuration').value = c.durationDays || '';
    document.getElementById('discEditOutcome').value = c.outcome || '';

    renderAttachments(c.attachments || []);
    renderCaseTimeline(c.statusLogs || []);

    const isClosed = c.status === 'resolved' || c.status === 'dismissed';
    document.getElementById('discSaveDetailsBtn').style.display = isClosed ? 'none' : 'inline-block';
    document.getElementById('discStatusBtn').style.display = isClosed ? 'none' : 'inline-block';
    document.getElementById('discReopenBtn').style.display = isClosed ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('discUploadZone').style.display = isClosed ? 'none' : 'block';

    document.getElementById('discDetailSaveMessage').innerHTML = '';

    document.getElementById('disciplinaryDetailModal').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

function closeDisciplinaryDetail() {
  document.getElementById('disciplinaryDetailModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
  currentOpenCaseId = null;
}

async function saveDisciplinaryDetails() {
  if (!currentOpenCaseId) return;
  const msg = document.getElementById('discDetailSaveMessage');

  const payload = {
    actionTaken: document.getElementById('discEditAction').value || null,
    hearingDate: document.getElementById('discEditHearingDate').value || null,
    actionDetails: document.getElementById('discEditActionDetails').value.trim() || null,
    hearingNotes: document.getElementById('discEditHearingNotes').value.trim() || null,
    effectiveDate: document.getElementById('discEditEffectiveDate').value || null,
    durationDays: document.getElementById('discEditDuration').value || null,
    outcome: document.getElementById('discEditOutcome').value.trim() || null,
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary/' + currentOpenCaseId, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Details saved</div>';
    setTimeout(() => { msg.innerHTML = ''; }, 1500);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

function renderCaseTimeline(logs) {
  const el = document.getElementById('discDetailTimeline');
  if (!logs || logs.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">No status history yet</p>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = logs.map(log =>
    '<div class="tl-item">' +
    '<span class="tl-dot"></span>' +
    '<span><strong>' + log.newStatus.toUpperCase() + '</strong> - ' +
    escapeHtml(log.changedBy) + ' - ' + fmtDateTime(log.timestamp) + '</span>' +
    (log.notes ? '<div class="muted" style="margin-left:16px;">' + escapeHtml(log.notes) + '</div>' : '') +
    '</div>'
  ).join('');
}

// ============================================================
// LABOUR RELATIONS - ATTACHMENTS
// ============================================================
function renderAttachments(attachments) {
  const el = document.getElementById('discAttachList');
  document.getElementById('discAttachCount').textContent = attachments.length;

  if (attachments.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="margin-bottom:12px;">No attachments yet</p>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = attachments.map(a => {
    const sizeKb = Math.round(a.sizeBytes / 1024);
    return '<div class="disc-attach-item">' +
      '<div style="flex:1;">' +
      '<div class="disc-attach-name">' + escapeHtml(a.originalName) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="disc-attach-meta">' + sizeKb + ' KB - ' + escapeHtml(a.uploadedBy) + ' - ' + fmtDate(a.uploadedAt) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="disc-attach-actions">' +
      '<a class="pill-btn" href="/api/disciplinary/' + currentOpenCaseId + '/attachments/' + a.id + '?token=' + encodeURIComponent(token()) + '" target="_blank">View</a>' +
      '<button class="danger-btn" style="padding:6px 12px; font-size:12px;" onclick="deleteAttachment(' + a.id + ')">Delete</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function wireDisciplinaryUpload() {
  const input = document.getElementById('discAttachInput');
  if (!input) return;

  input.addEventListener('change', async () => {
    if (!currentOpenCaseId) return;
    if (!input.files || input.files.length === 0) return;

    const msg = document.getElementById('discUploadMessage');
    msg.innerHTML = 'Uploading...';

    const formData = new FormData();
    for (const file of input.files) {
      formData.append('files', file);
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary/' + currentOpenCaseId + '/attachments', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
        body: formData,
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

      msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--success);">' + data.message + '</span>';
      input.value = '';
      await openDisciplinaryDetail(currentOpenCaseId);
    } catch (e) {
      msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--error);">' + e.message + '</span>';
    }
  });
}

async function deleteAttachment(attachmentId) {
  if (!currentOpenCaseId) return;
  if (!confirm('Delete this attachment?')) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/disciplinary/' + currentOpenCaseId + '/attachments/' + attachmentId, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    await openDisciplinaryDetail(currentOpenCaseId);
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

async function loadEstablishmentMetadata() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/establishment/metadata', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    establishmentMetadata = await res.json();

    const reasonSel = document.getElementById('estResignationReason');
    if (reasonSel && establishmentMetadata.resignationReasons) {
      reasonSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose reason --</option>' +
        establishmentMetadata.resignationReasons.map(r => '<option value="' + escapeHtml(r) + '">' + escapeHtml(r) + '</option>').join('');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ESTABLISHMENT - ATOMIC SUMMARY
// Single state object, parallel fetch, in-flight dedupe, one render.
// ============================================================
function renderEstSummary() {
  const set = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
  set('estSummaryTotal',        estSummaryState.total);
  set('estSummaryTransfers',    estSummaryState.transfers);
  set('estSummaryRetirements',  estSummaryState.retirements);
  set('estSummaryResignations', estSummaryState.resignations);
  set('estSummaryUnder',        estSummaryState.understaffed);
  set('estSummaryOver',         estSummaryState.overstaffed);
}

async function loadEstablishmentSummary() {
  if (estSummaryInFlight) return estSummaryInFlight;

  estSummaryInFlight = (async () => {
    try {
      const [sumRes, headRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/establishment/summary',   { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
        fetch('/api/establishment/headcount', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
      ]);

      const sum  = sumRes.ok  ? await sumRes.json()  : {};
      const head = headRes.ok ? await headRes.json() : [];

      estSummaryState = {
        total:        sum.last30Days || 0,
        transfers:    (sum.byType && sum.byType.transfer)    || 0,
        retirements:  (sum.byType && sum.byType.retirement)  || 0,
        resignations: (sum.byType && sum.byType.resignation) || 0,
        understaffed: head.filter(d => d.status === 'understaffed').length,
        overstaffed:  head.filter(d => d.status === 'overstaffed').length,
      };

      renderEstSummary();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('loadEstablishmentSummary failed:', e);
    } finally {
      estSummaryInFlight = null;
    }
  })();

  return estSummaryInFlight;
}

// ============================================================
// ESTABLISHMENT - MOVEMENTS SEARCH AND RENDER
// ============================================================
function debouncedEstMovementSearch() {
  clearTimeout(estSearchTimer);
  estSearchTimer = setTimeout(runEstMovementSearch, 300);
}

async function runEstMovementSearch() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('estSearchBox').value.trim();
  const type = document.getElementById('estFilterType').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('estFilterDept').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('estFilterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('estFilterTo').value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (type && type !== 'all') params.set('type', type);
  if (department && department !== 'all') params.set('department', department);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/establishment/movements?' + params, {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load movements');
    allEstMovements = await res.json();
    renderEstMovements();
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('estMovementList').innerHTML = '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

function clearEstFilters() {
  document.getElementById('estSearchBox').value = '';
  document.getElementById('estFilterType').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('estFilterDept').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('estFilterFrom').value = '';
  document.getElementById('estFilterTo').value = '';
  runEstMovementSearch();
}

function renderEstMovements() {
  const el = document.getElementById('estMovementList');

  if (!allEstMovements || allEstMovements.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No movements recorded</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table">' +
    '<thead><tr>' +
    '<th>Date</th><th>Employee</th><th>Type</th><th>Details</th><th>Approved By</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
    allEstMovements.map(m => {
      const date = m.effectiveDate || m.actualDate || m.lastWorkingDay || m.resignationDate || m.createdAt;
      const empName = m.employee ? m.employee.name : '-';

      let details = '';
      if (m.movementType === 'transfer') {
        details = (m.fromDepartment || '?') + ' to ' + (m.toDepartment || '?');
      } else if (m.movementType === 'retirement') {
        details = m.yearsOfService ? m.yearsOfService + ' years of service' : 'Retirement';
        if (m.pensionNotes) details += ' - ' + m.pensionNotes;
      } else if (m.movementType === 'resignation') {
        details = m.reason || 'Resignation';
        if (m.lastWorkingDay) details += ' - Last day: ' + fmtDate(m.lastWorkingDay);
      }

      const typeCls = {
        transfer: 'badge-approved',
        retirement: 'badge-ordered',
        resignation: 'badge-awaiting_quotation',
      }[m.movementType] || 'badge-pending';

      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + fmtDate(date) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(empName) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="badge ' + typeCls + '">' + String(m.movementType).toUpperCase() + '</span></td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(details) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(m.approvedBy || '-') + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('') +
    '</tbody></table>';
}

// ============================================================
// PRINT - ESTABLISHMENT MOVEMENTS
// ============================================================
function printMovementsReport() {
  if (!allEstMovements || allEstMovements.length === 0) {
    alert('No movements to print. Adjust filters.');
    return;
  }

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const phone = systemSettings.contactPhone || '';
  const address = systemSettings.contactAddress || '';
  const now = new Date();

  const filterParts = [];
  const search = document.getElementById('estSearchBox').value.trim();
  const type = document.getElementById('estFilterType').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('estFilterDept').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('estFilterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('estFilterTo').value;

  if (search) filterParts.push('Search="' + search + '"');
  if (type && type !== 'all') filterParts.push('Type=' + type);
  if (department && department !== 'all') filterParts.push('Department=' + department);
  if (from) filterParts.push('From=' + from);
  if (to) filterParts.push('To=' + to);

  const filterLine = filterParts.length > 0
    ? 'Filters: ' + filterParts.join(', ')
    : 'Filters: none (all movements)';

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header">';
  html += '<h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1>';
  html += '<h2>Establishment - Movement Report</h2>';
  html += '</div>';

  if (phone || address) {
    html += '<div class="print-contact">';
    if (address) html += '<p>' + escapeHtml(address) + '</p>';
    if (phone) html += '<p>Tel: ' + escapeHtml(phone) + '</p>';
    html += '</div>';
  }

  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Total Movements:</strong> ' + allEstMovements.length + '</p>';
  html += '<p><strong>Report Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '<p style="grid-column: span 2;"><strong>' + escapeHtml(filterLine) + '</strong></p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<table class="print-table">';
  html += '<thead><tr>';
  html += '<th>#</th><th>Date</th><th>Employee</th><th>Type</th><th>Details</th><th>Approved By</th>';
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  allEstMovements.forEach((m, i) => {
    const date = m.effectiveDate || m.actualDate || m.lastWorkingDay || m.resignationDate || m.createdAt;
    const empName = m.employee ? m.employee.name : '-';

    let details = '';
    if (m.movementType === 'transfer') {
      details = (m.fromDepartment || '?') + ' to ' + (m.toDepartment || '?');
    } else if (m.movementType === 'retirement') {
      details = m.yearsOfService ? m.yearsOfService + ' years of service' : 'Retirement';
    } else if (m.movementType === 'resignation') {
      details = m.reason || 'Resignation';
    }

    html += '<tr>';
    html += '<td>' + (i + 1) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + fmtDate(date) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(empName) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + String(m.movementType || '').toUpperCase() + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(details) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(m.approvedBy || '-') + '</td>';
    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table>';
  html += '<div class="print-footer">';
  html += escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now);
  html += '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => window.print(), 200);
}

async function populateEstDropdowns() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/employees', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const employees = await res.json();

    const options = employees.map(e =>
      '<option value="' + e.id + '">' + escapeHtml(e.name) + ' - ' + escapeHtml(e.department) + '</option>'
    ).join('');

    const transferSel = document.getElementById('estTransferEmployee');
    if (transferSel) transferSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose employee --</option>' + options;

    const retirementSel = document.getElementById('estRetirementEmployee');
    if (retirementSel) retirementSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose employee --</option>' + options;

    const resignationSel = document.getElementById('estResignationEmployee');
    if (resignationSel) resignationSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose employee --</option>' + options;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

function onTransferEmployeeChange() {
  const id = parseInt(document.getElementById('estTransferEmployee').value);
  if (!id) {
    document.getElementById('estTransferCurrentInfo').textContent = '';
    return;
  }
  const emp = allEmployees.find(e => e.id === id);
  if (emp) {
    const ward = emp.ward ? emp.ward.name : '-';
    document.getElementById('estTransferCurrentInfo').textContent =
      'Currently: ' + emp.department + ' - ' + (emp.role || '-') + ' - Ward ' + ward;
  }
}

async function submitTransfer() {
  const msg = document.getElementById('estTransferMessage');
  const employeeId = document.getElementById('estTransferEmployee').value;
  const toDepartment = document.getElementById('estTransferToDept').value;
  const toWardId = document.getElementById('estTransferToWard').value;
  const effectiveDate = document.getElementById('estTransferEffectiveDate').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById('estTransferReason').value.trim();
  const notes = document.getElementById('estTransferNotes').value.trim();

  if (!employeeId || !toDepartment || !effectiveDate) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Employee, department, and effective date are required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/establishment/transfer', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        employeeId: parseInt(employeeId),
        toDepartment,
        toWardId: toWardId ? parseInt(toWardId) : null,
        effectiveDate,
        reason: reason || 'Transfer',
        notes,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Transfer recorded</div>';
    setTimeout(() => {
      closeTransferModal();
      loadEstablishmentSummary();
      runEstMovementSearch();
      runStaffSearch();
      populateEstDropdowns();
    }, 900);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

  if (!id) {
    document.getElementById('estRetirementCurrentInfo').textContent = '';
    return;
  }
  const emp = allEmployees.find(e => e.id === id);
  if (emp) {
    const hire = emp.hireDate ? fmtDate(emp.hireDate) : '-';

async function openHeadcountModal() {

  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
  await loadHeadcountSettings();

  document.getElementById('estHeadcountModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
}

async function loadHeadcountSettings() {
  const el = document.getElementById('estHeadcountList');
  if (!el) return;

  try {
    const [targetsRes, headRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch('/api/establishment/targets',   { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
      fetch('/api/establishment/headcount', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
    ]);

    const targets = targetsRes.ok ? await targetsRes.json() : [];
    const headcounts = headRes.ok ? await headRes.json() : [];

    const map = {};
    headcounts.forEach(h => {
      map[h.department] = { current: h.current, status: h.status };
    });
    targets.forEach(t => {
      if (!map[t.department]) map[t.department] = { current: 0, status: 'no_target' };
      map[t.department].min = t.minHeadcount;
      map[t.department].max = t.maxHeadcount;
    });

    const allDepts = ['Medical', 'Nurses', 'Pharmacy', 'Laboratory', 'Admin', 'Support', 'Maintenance', 'Security'];
    allDepts.forEach(d => {
      if (!map[d]) map[d] = { current: 0, status: 'no_target' };
    });

    el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table">' +
      '<thead><tr><th>Department</th><th>Current</th><th>Min</th><th>Max</th><th>Status</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      Object.keys(map).sort().map(dept => {
        const d = map[dept];
        const statusCls = {
          understaffed: 'status-critical',
          overstaffed: 'status-low',
          adequate: 'status-ok',
          no_target: 'status-terminated',
        }[d.status] || 'status-terminated';

        const minVal = d.min !== undefined ? d.min : '';
        const maxVal = (d.max !== undefined && d.max !== null) ? d.max : '';

        return '<tr>' +
          '<td>' + escapeHtml(dept) + '</td>' +
          '<td><strong>' + d.current + '</strong></td>' +
          '<td><input type="number" id="hc-min-' + dept + '" value="' + minVal + '" style="width:80px; min-height:32px; padding:4px 8px;" min="0"></td>' +
          '<td><input type="number" id="hc-max-' + dept + '" value="' + maxVal + '" style="width:80px; min-height:32px; padding:4px 8px;" min="0"></td>' +
          '<td><span class="status-pill ' + statusCls + '">' + escapeHtml(d.status.replace('_', ' ')) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><button class="pill-btn" onclick="saveHeadcountTarget(\'' + dept + '\')">Save</button></td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('') +
      '</tbody></table>';
  } catch (e) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

async function saveHeadcountTarget(department) {
  const minInput = document.getElementById('hc-min-' + department);
  const maxInput = document.getElementById('hc-max-' + department);

  const minHeadcount = minInput ? minInput.value : '';
  const maxHeadcount = maxInput ? maxInput.value : '';

  if (minHeadcount === '' || isNaN(parseInt(minHeadcount))) {
    alert('Minimum headcount is required');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/establishment/targets/' + encodeURIComponent(department), {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        minHeadcount: parseInt(minHeadcount),
        maxHeadcount: maxHeadcount ? parseInt(maxHeadcount) : null,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    await loadHeadcountSettings();
    await loadEstablishmentSummary();
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

let allUsers = [];
let allTenders = [];
let tenderFilter = 'all';

async function init_it() {
  await loadSystemStatus();
  await loadUserList();
  await loadMyTenders();
  window.onOrderUpdated = (payload) => {
    const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();
    const sub = String(payload?.department || '').toLowerCase();
    const orig = String(payload?.originator || '').toLowerCase();
    if (sub === myDept || orig === myDept) loadMyTenders();
  };
}

// ============================================================
// TENDER SUBMISSION (FIX)
// ============================================================
async function submitITTender() {
  const originatorDepartment = document.getElementById('it-reqOriginator').value;
  const itemName = document.getElementById('it-reqItemName').value.trim();
  const quantity = document.getElementById('it-reqQuantity').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById('it-reqReason').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById('it-requestMessage');

  if (!itemName || !quantity || !reason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--error);">All fields required</span>';
    return;
  }

  const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="submitITTender()"]');
  if (btn && btn.disabled) return;
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Submitting...'; }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/request', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ itemName, quantity: parseInt(quantity), reason, originatorDepartment }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--success);">Request submitted</span>';
    document.getElementById('it-reqItemName').value = '';
    document.getElementById('it-reqQuantity').value = '';
    document.getElementById('it-reqReason').value = '';
    await loadMyTenders();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--error);">' + e.message + '</span>';
  } finally {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Request'; }
  }
}

async function createUser() {
  const username = document.getElementById('it-newUsername').value.trim();
  const fullName = document.getElementById('it-newUserFullName').value.trim();
  const department = document.getElementById('it-newUserDept').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('it-createUserMessage');

  if (!username || !fullName) { msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">All fields required</div>'; return; }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/admin/create-user', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ username, fullName, department }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">User <strong>' + escapeHtml(data.user.username) + '</strong> created<br>Temp Password: <code>' + data.tempPassword + '</code></div>';
    document.getElementById('it-newUsername').value = '';
    document.getElementById('it-newUserFullName').value = '';
    await loadUserList();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

async function loadUserList() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/admin/users', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed');
    allUsers = await res.json();
    renderUserList();
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('it-userList').innerHTML = '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

function renderUserList() {
  const el = document.getElementById('it-userList');
  const q = (document.getElementById('it-userSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  const filtered = q ? allUsers.filter(u => u.username.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(q) || u.department.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : allUsers;

  if (filtered.length === 0) { el.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">No users</p>'; return; }

  el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Username</th><th>Full Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Role</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    filtered.map(u => '<tr><td>' + escapeHtml(u.username) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(u.fullName) + '</td><td><span class="dept-pill">' + escapeHtml(u.department) + '</span></td><td>' + escapeHtml(u.role) + '</td><td><button class="pill-btn" onclick="resetUserPassword(' + u.id + ', \'' + u.username + '\')">Reset Password</button></td></tr>').join('') +
    '</tbody></table>';
}

function filterUserList() { renderUserList(); }

async function resetUserPassword(userId, username) {
  if (!confirm('Reset password for "' + username + '"?')) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/admin/reset-password', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ userId }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);
    alert('New temporary password:\n' + data.tempPassword);
  } catch (e) {
    alert('Error: ' + e.message);
  }
}

async function loadSystemStatus() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/system-status', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();
    document.getElementById('it-totalUsers').textContent = data.totalUsers;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function renderTenderTracker() {
  const el = document.getElementById('it-tenderTrackerList');
  if (allTenders.length === 0) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Tenders</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = allTenders.map(t => {
    return '<div class="tender-card"><div class="tender-head"><div><strong>#' + t.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</strong><div class="muted">Requested by: ' + escapeHtml(t.requestingBy || '-') + '</div></div><div>' + statusBadge(t.status) + '</div></div><div class="tender-body"><p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.reason) + '</p></div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function printMyTenders() {
  if (allTenders.length === 0) { alert('No tenders to print.'); return; }
  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const now = new Date();
  let html = '<div class="print-page a4"><div class="print-header"><h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1><h2>IT Department Tenders</h2></div>';
  html += '<div class="print-meta"><p><strong>Total:</strong> ' + allTenders.length + '</p><p><strong>Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p></div>';
  html += '<table class="print-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  allTenders.forEach((t, i) => {
    html += '<tr><td>' + (i + 1) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + '</td><td>' + t.quantity + '</td><td>' + String(t.status).toUpperCase() + '</td><td>' + fmtDate(t.createdAt) + '</td></tr>';
  });
  html += '</tbody></table><div class="print-footer">' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</div></div>';
  printContent(html);
}

let allPatients = [];
let allTenders = [];

let patientToPrint = null;

  await loadWards();
  await runPatientSearch();

  await loadDischargeRecords();
  registerNursesSocketHandlers();
  await checkFollowups();

}

// ============================================================
// TENDER SUBMISSION
// ============================================================
async function submitNursesTender() {
  const originatorDepartment = document.getElementById('nurses-reqOriginator').value;
  const itemName = document.getElementById('nurses-reqItemName').value.trim();
  const quantity = document.getElementById('nurses-reqQuantity').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById('nurses-reqReason').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById('nurses-requestMessage');

  if (!itemName || !quantity || !reason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--error);">All fields required</span>';
    return;
  }

  const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="submitNursesTender()"]');
  if (btn && btn.disabled) return;
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Submitting...'; }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/request', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ itemName, quantity: parseInt(quantity), reason, originatorDepartment }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--success);">Request submitted</span>';
    document.getElementById('nurses-reqItemName').value = '';
    document.getElementById('nurses-reqQuantity').value = '';
    document.getElementById('nurses-reqReason').value = '';
    await loadMyTenders();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--error);">' + e.message + '</span>';
  } finally {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Request'; }
  }
}

async function loadWards() {
  const res = await fetch('/api/wards', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
  if (!res.ok) return;
  const wards = await res.json();

  const wardSelect = document.getElementById('nurses-wardSelect');
  if (wardSelect) {
    wardSelect.innerHTML = wards.map(w => '<option value="' + w.id + '">' + escapeHtml(w.name) + '</option>').join('');
  }

  const filterWard = document.getElementById('nurses-filterWard');
  if (filterWard) {
    filterWard.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All</option>' + wards.map(w => '<option value="' + w.id + '">' + escapeHtml(w.name) + '</option>').join('');
  }
}

function debouncedPatientSearch() {
  clearTimeout(patientSearchTimer);
  patientSearchTimer = setTimeout(runPatientSearch, 300);
}

function toggleAdvancedPatientFilters() {
  const el = document.getElementById('nurses-advancedFilters');
  el.style.display = el.style.display === 'none' ? 'flex' : 'none';
}

function updatePatientFilters() {
  let count = 0;
  if (document.getElementById('nurses-filterStatus').value !== 'all') count++;
  if (document.getElementById('nurses-filterWard').value !== 'all') count++;
  if (document.getElementById('nurses-filterDiagnosis').value.trim() !== '') count++;
  if (document.getElementById('nurses-filterFrom').value !== '') count++;
  if (document.getElementById('nurses-filterTo').value !== '') count++;

  const btn = document.getElementById('nurses-filterToggleBtn');
  if (btn) {
    btn.textContent = 'Filters (' + count + ')';
    if (count > 0) {
      btn.classList.remove('ghost-btn');
      btn.classList.add('pill-btn');
    } else {
      btn.classList.remove('pill-btn');
      btn.classList.add('ghost-btn');
    }
  }
  runPatientSearch();
}

async function runPatientSearch() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSearch').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('nurses-filterStatus').value;
  const ward = document.getElementById('nurses-filterWard').value;
  const diagnosis = document.getElementById('nurses-filterDiagnosis').value.trim();
  const from = document.getElementById('nurses-filterFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('nurses-filterTo').value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (status && status !== 'all') params.set('status', status);
  if (ward && ward !== 'all') params.set('ward', ward);
  if (diagnosis) params.set('diagnosis', diagnosis);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/patients?' + params, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    allPatients = await res.json();
    renderPatientSelect();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

function renderPatientSelect() {
  const countEl = document.getElementById('nurses-resultCount');
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '(' + allPatients.length + ' found)';

  const sel = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSelect');
  if (sel) {
    sel.innerHTML = allPatients.map(p => '<option value="' + p.id + '">' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</option>').join('');
  }

  const tbody = document.getElementById('nurses-patientTableBody');
  if (!tbody) return;

  if (allPatients.length === 0) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;">No patients match</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = allPatients.map(p => {
    const wardName = p.ward ? p.ward.name : '-';
    const isSelected = sel && sel.value === String(p.id);
    const rowStyle = isSelected ? 'background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff;' : '';
    const textStyle = isSelected ? 'style="color: #ffffff !important;"' : '';
    
    return '<tr style="cursor:pointer; ' + rowStyle + '" onclick="selectPatientRow(' + p.id + ', this)">' +
      '<td ' + textStyle + '><strong ' + textStyle + '>' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</strong></td>' +
      '<td ' + textStyle + '>' + escapeHtml(wardName) + '</td>' +
      '<td ' + textStyle + '>' + p.status.toUpperCase() + '</td>' +
      '<td ' + textStyle + '>' + escapeHtml(p.diagnosis || '-') + '</td>' +
      '<td><button class="pill-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); selectPatientRow(' + p.id + ', this.closest(\'tr\'))" style="' + (isSelected ? 'background:#fff; color:#4f46e5;' : '') + '">Select</button></td>' +
      '</tr>';
  }).join('');

  if (!sel.value && allPatients.length > 0) {
    selectPatientRow(allPatients[0].id, tbody.firstElementChild);
  }
}

window.selectPatientRow = function(id, rowEl) {
  const sel = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSelect');
  sel.value = id;

  const tbody = document.getElementById('nurses-patientTableBody');
  Array.from(tbody.children).forEach(tr => {
    tr.style.background = '';
    tr.style.color = '';
    tr.querySelectorAll('td, strong').forEach(cell => cell.style.color = '');
    const btn = tr.querySelector('.pill-btn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.style.background = '';
      btn.style.color = '';
    }
  });

  if (rowEl) {
    rowEl.style.background = '#4f46e5';
    rowEl.style.color = '#ffffff';
    rowEl.querySelectorAll('td, strong').forEach(cell => cell.style.color = '#ffffff');
    const btn = rowEl.querySelector('.pill-btn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.style.background = '#ffffff';
      btn.style.color = '#4f46e5';
    }
  }
};

function clearPatientFilters() {
  document.getElementById('nurses-patientSearch').value = '';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterStatus').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterWard').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterDiagnosis').value = '';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterFrom').value = '';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterTo').value = '';
  updatePatientFilters();
}

async function registerPatient() {
  const name = document.getElementById('nurses-patientName').value.trim();
  const nationalId = document.getElementById('nurses-patientID').value.trim();
  const phone = document.getElementById('nurses-patientPhone').value.trim();
  const bloodGroup = document.getElementById('nurses-patientBlood').value;
  const diagnosis = document.getElementById('nurses-patientDiagnosis').value.trim();
  const symptoms = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSymptoms').value.trim();
  const wardId = document.getElementById('nurses-wardSelect').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('nurses-patientMessage');

  if (!name || !wardId) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Name and ward required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/patients', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, nationalId, phone, bloodGroup, diagnosis, symptoms, wardId: parseInt(wardId), status: 'admitted' }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Patient registered</div>';
    ['nurses-patientName', 'nurses-patientID', 'nurses-patientPhone', 'nurses-patientDiagnosis', 'nurses-patientSymptoms'].forEach(id => {
      document.getElementById(id).value = '';
    });
    await runPatientSearch();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

async function changePatientStatus() {
  const patientId = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSelect').value;
  const status = document.getElementById('nurses-newStatus').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('nurses-updateMessage');

  if (!patientId) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Select a patient</div>';
    return;
  }

  const body = { status };
  if (status === 'deceased') {
    const cause = prompt('Cause of death:');
    if (cause) body.causeOfDeath = cause;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/patients/' + patientId + '/status', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Status updated</div>';
    await runPatientSearch();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// DISCHARGE
// ============================================================
function openDischargeModal() {
  const patientId = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSelect').value;
  if (!patientId) {
    alert('Select a patient first');
    return;
  }
  const p = allPatients.find(x => x.id === parseInt(patientId));
  if (!p) return;

  selectedPatientIdForDischarge = p.id;
  document.getElementById('dischargePatientName').textContent = p.name;

  const wardName = p.ward ? p.ward.name : '-';
  document.getElementById('dischargePatientMeta').textContent = '#' + p.id + ' - Ward: ' + wardName + ' - Admitted: ' + fmtDate(p.admissionDate) + (p.diagnosis ? ' - ' + p.diagnosis : '');

  ['dischargeFinalDiagnosis', 'dischargeTreatment', 'dischargeNotes', 'dischargeInstructions', 'dischargeReviewDate'].forEach(id => {
    document.getElementById(id).value = '';
  });
  document.getElementById('dischargeOutcome').value = 'Recovered';
  document.getElementById('dischargeMessage').innerHTML = '';

  document.getElementById('dischargeModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

function closeDischargeModal() {
  document.getElementById('dischargeModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
  selectedPatientIdForDischarge = null;
}

async function confirmDischarge() {
  if (!selectedPatientIdForDischarge) return;
  const msg = document.getElementById('dischargeMessage');

  const payload = {
    finalDiagnosis: document.getElementById('dischargeFinalDiagnosis').value.trim(),
    treatmentSummary: document.getElementById('dischargeTreatment').value.trim(),
    outcome: document.getElementById('dischargeOutcome').value,
    dischargeNotes: document.getElementById('dischargeNotes').value.trim(),
    nextReviewDate: document.getElementById('dischargeReviewDate').value || null,
    reviewDepartment: document.getElementById('dischargeReviewDept').value,
    patientInstructions: document.getElementById('dischargeInstructions').value.trim(),
  };

  if (!payload.finalDiagnosis) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Final diagnosis is required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/patients/' + selectedPatientIdForDischarge + '/discharge', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    patientToPrint = data;
    closeDischargeModal();
    await runPatientSearch();
    await loadDischargeRecords();

    document.getElementById('printPatientLabel').textContent = data.name + ' (#' + data.id + ') - Discharged ' + fmtDate(data.dischargeDate);
    document.getElementById('printOptionsModal').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

function debouncedDischargeSearch() {
  clearTimeout(dischargeSearchTimer);
  dischargeSearchTimer = setTimeout(loadDischargeRecords, 300);
}

async function loadDischargeRecords() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('nurses-dischargeSearch').value.trim();
  const outcome = document.getElementById('nurses-dischargeOutcome').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('nurses-dischargeFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('nurses-dischargeTo').value;
  const reviewFrom = document.getElementById('nurses-reviewFrom')?.value;
  const reviewTo = document.getElementById('nurses-reviewTo')?.value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (outcome && outcome !== 'all') params.set('outcome', outcome);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);
  if (reviewFrom) params.set('reviewFrom', reviewFrom);
  if (reviewTo) params.set('reviewTo', reviewTo);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/patients/discharges?' + params, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    allDischarges = await res.json();
    renderDischargeRecords();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

function renderDischargeRecords() {
  const el = document.getElementById('nurses-dischargeList');
  if (allDischarges.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No discharge records</div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>Ward</th><th>Final Diagnosis</th><th>Outcome</th><th>Discharged</th><th>Review</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    allDischarges.map(d => {
      const wardName = d.ward ? d.ward.name : '-';
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + d.id + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(d.name) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(wardName) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(d.finalDiagnosis || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(d.outcome || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtDate(d.dischargeDate) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtDate(d.nextReviewDate) + '</td>' +
        '<td><button class="pill-btn" onclick="reprintDischarge(' + d.id + ')">Re-print</button></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
}

async function reprintDischarge(id) {
  const rec = allDischarges.find(d => d.id === id);
  if (!rec) return;
  patientToPrint = rec;
  document.getElementById('printPatientLabel').textContent = rec.name + ' (#' + rec.id + ') - Discharged ' + fmtDate(rec.dischargeDate);
  document.getElementById('printOptionsModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

async function loadMyTenders() {
  const res = await fetch('/api/orders/my', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
  if (!res.ok) return;
  allTenders = await res.json();
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function setTenderFilter(btn) {
  const parent = btn.closest('.filter-bar');
  if (parent) {
    parent.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  }
  btn.classList.add('active');
  tenderFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function filterTenders() { renderTenderTracker(); }

function renderTenderTracker() {
  const el = document.getElementById('nurses-tenderTrackerList');
  const q = (document.getElementById('nurses-tenderSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  let list = allTenders;
  if (tenderFilter !== 'all') list = list.filter(t => t.status === tenderFilter);
  if (q) list = list.filter(t => String(t.itemName).toLowerCase().includes(q));

  if (list.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Tenders</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = list.map(t => {
    const supplier = t.procurementOrder && t.procurementOrder.supplierName ? '<p><em>Supplier:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.procurementOrder.supplierName) + '</p>' : '';
    return '<div class="tender-card"><div class="tender-head"><div><strong>#' + t.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</strong></div><div>' + statusBadge(t.status) + '</div></div><div class="tender-body"><p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.reason) + '</p>' + supplier + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function printMyTenders() {
  if (allTenders.length === 0) { alert('No tenders to print.'); return; }
  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const now = new Date();
  let html = '<div class="print-page a4"><div class="print-header"><h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1><h2>Department Tenders</h2></div>';
  html += '<div class="print-meta"><p><strong>Total:</strong> ' + allTenders.length + '</p><p><strong>Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p></div>';
  html += '<table class="print-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Status</th><th>Supplier</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  allTenders.forEach((t, i) => {
    const supplier = t.procurementOrder ? t.procurementOrder.supplierName : '-';
    html += '<tr><td>' + (i + 1) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + '</td><td>' + t.quantity + '</td><td>' + String(t.status).toUpperCase() + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(supplier) + '</td><td>' + fmtDate(t.createdAt) + '</td></tr>';
  });
  html += '</tbody></table><div class="print-footer">' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</div></div>';
  printContent(html);
}

// ============================================================
// FOLLOW-UP ALERTS
// ============================================================
async function checkFollowups() {
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const today = now.getFullYear() + '-' + String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const res = await fetch('/api/patients/today-summary?from=' + today + '&to=' + today);
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();
    const count = data.followUpsDueToday || 0;
    
    const alertBox = document.getElementById('nurses-followupAlert');
    const countSpan = document.getElementById('nurses-followupCount');
    
    if (alertBox && countSpan) {
      if (count > 0) {
        countSpan.textContent = count;
        alertBox.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
      } else {
        alertBox.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      }
    }
  } catch (e) { console.error('Failed to check follow-ups', e); }
}

function filterTodayFollowups() {
  document.getElementById('nurses-patientSearch').value = '';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterWard').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('nurses-filterDiagnosis').value = '';
  
  const now = new Date();
  const today = now.getFullYear() + '-' + String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  params.set('category', 'followups');
  params.set('from', today);
  params.set('to', today);

  fetch('/api/patients/detail-public?' + params)
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(rows => {
      allPatients = rows.map(r => ({
        id: r.id,
        name: 'Case #' + r.id,
        status: r.status,
        ward: r.ward,
        diagnosis: 'Follow-up due',
        admissionDate: r.updatedAt
      }));
      renderPatientSelect();
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        const card = document.getElementById('nurses-patientSearch').closest('.card');
        if (card) {
          card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          card.style.transition = 'box-shadow 0.5s ease, border-color 0.5s ease';
          card.style.boxShadow = '0 0 20px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4)';
          card.style.borderColor = '#dc2626';
          setTimeout(() => {
            card.style.boxShadow = '';
            card.style.borderColor = '';
          }, 2000);
        }
      }, 100);
    })
    .catch(e => console.error('Failed to fetch followups:', e));
}

// ============================================================
// DISCHARGE PRINT OPTIONS

function closePrintOptions() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('printOptionsModal');
  const backdrop = document.getElementById('modalBackdrop');
  if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
  if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.remove('active');
  patientToPrint = null;
}

function doPrintDischarge() {
  if (!patientToPrint) return;
  
  const paperSizeEl = document.querySelector('input[name="paperSize"]:checked');
  const copiesEl = document.querySelector('input[name="copies"]:checked');
  
  const paperSize = paperSizeEl ? paperSizeEl.value : 'A4';
  const copies = copiesEl ? copiesEl.value : '1';
  
  const html = buildDischargePrintHTML(patientToPrint, paperSize, copies);
  
  const printArea = document.getElementById('printArea');
  if (printArea) printArea.innerHTML = html;
  
  closePrintOptions();
  setTimeout(() => window.print(), 200);
}

function buildDischargePrintHTML(p, paperSize, copies) {
  const pageClass = paperSize === 'A5' ? 'a5' : 'a4';
  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const phone = systemSettings.contactPhone || '';
  const address = systemSettings.contactAddress || '';

  function singleCopy(label) {
    const wardName = p.ward ? p.ward.name : '-';
    let html = '<div class="print-page ' + pageClass + '">';
    if (label) html += '<div class="copy-label">' + label + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="print-header"><h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1><h2>Discharge Summary</h2></div>';
    if (phone || address) {
      html += '<div class="print-contact">';
      if (address) html += '<p>' + escapeHtml(address) + '</p>';
      if (phone) html += '<p>Tel: ' + escapeHtml(phone) + '</p>';
      html += '</div>';
    }
    html += '<div class="print-meta">' +
      '<p><strong>Patient:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.name) + ' (#' + p.id + ')</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Ward:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(wardName) + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Admitted:</strong> ' + fmtDate(p.admissionDate) + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Discharged:</strong> ' + fmtDate(p.dischargeDate) + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Outcome:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.outcome || '-') + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Discharged By:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.dischargedBy || '-') + '</p>' +
      '</div>';
    html += '<div class="print-section"><h3>Clinical Summary</h3>' +
      '<p><strong>Admission Diagnosis:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.diagnosis || '-') + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Final Diagnosis:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.finalDiagnosis || '-') + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Treatment:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.treatmentSummary || '-') + '</p>' +
      '</div>';
    if (p.dischargeNotes) html += '<div class="print-section"><h3>Notes</h3><p>' + escapeHtml(p.dischargeNotes) + '</p></div>';
    if (p.patientInstructions) html += '<div class="print-section"><h3>Instructions to Patient</h3><p>' + escapeHtml(p.patientInstructions) + '</p></div>';
    html += '<div class="print-section"><h3>Follow-up</h3>' +
      '<p><strong>Review Date:</strong> ' + (p.nextReviewDate ? fmtDate(p.nextReviewDate) : '-') + '</p>' +
      '<p><strong>Review Department:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(p.reviewDepartment || '-') + '</p>' +
      '</div>';
    html += '<div class="print-signatures"><div><span>Nurse Signature</span><div class="sig-line"></div></div><div><span>Patient / Guardian Signature</span><div class="sig-line"></div></div></div>';
    html += '<div class="print-footer">' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(new Date()) + '</div></div>';
    return html;
  }

  if (copies === '2') {
    return singleCopy('PATIENT COPY') + '<div class="page-break"></div>' + singleCopy('HOSPITAL COPY');
  }
  return singleCopy('');
}

function registerNursesSocketHandlers() {
  window.onPatientUpdated = () => { runPatientSearch(); checkFollowups(); };
  window.onPatientCreated = () => { runPatientSearch(); checkFollowups(); };
  window.onOrderUpdated = (payload) => {
    const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();
    const sub = String(payload?.department || '').toLowerCase();
    const orig = String(payload?.originator || '').toLowerCase();
    if (sub === myDept || orig === myDept) loadMyTenders();
  };
}

let allProcurementOrders = [];
let allTenders = [];
let tenderFilter = 'all';
let procActiveFilter = 'pending';
let historySearchTimer = null;

async function init_proc() {
  await loadProcurementDashboard();
  await loadMyTenders();
  window.onOrderUpdated = (payload) => {
    loadProcurementDashboard();
    if (document.getElementById('procTabHistory')?.classList.contains('active')) {
      loadHistorySummary();
      loadTenderHistory();
    }
    const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();
    const sub = String(payload?.department || '').toLowerCase();
    const orig = String(payload?.originator || '').toLowerCase();
    if (sub === myDept || orig === myDept) loadMyTenders();
  };
  window.onOrderCreated = () => loadProcurementDashboard();
}

function switchProcTab(btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dept-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');

  const tab = btn.dataset.tab;
  document.querySelectorAll('.proc-tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(tab === 'history' ? 'procTabHistory' : 'procTabActive').classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'history') {
    const deptEl = document.getElementById('histDept');
    if (deptEl) deptEl.value = 'all';
    loadHistorySummary();
    loadTenderHistory();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ACTIVE BOARD
// ============================================================
async function loadProcurementDashboard() {
  try {
    const [reqRes, sumRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch('/api/orders/requests', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
      fetch('/api/orders/summary', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
    ]);

    allProcurementOrders = await reqRes.json();
    const summary = await sumRes.json();

    renderProcurementOrders();

    document.getElementById('proc-procPending').textContent = summary.pending;
    document.getElementById('proc-procOrdered').textContent = summary.ordered;
    document.getElementById('proc-procInStorage').textContent = summary.received;

    const awaitEl = document.getElementById('proc-procAwaiting');
    if (awaitEl) awaitEl.textContent = summary.awaitingQuotation ?? 0;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

function setProcActiveFilter(btn) {
  const bar = btn.closest('.filter-bar, .tender-filters');
  if (bar) bar.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  procActiveFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
  renderProcurementOrders();
}

function renderProcurementOrders() {
  const el = document.getElementById('proc-pendingOrdersList');
  if (!el) return;

  const q = (document.getElementById('proc-pendingSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();

  let list = allProcurementOrders;
  if (procActiveFilter !== 'all') list = list.filter(o => o.status === procActiveFilter);
  if (q) {
    list = list.filter(o =>
      String(o.itemName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      String(o.requestingDepartment || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      String(o.originatorDepartment || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      String(o.requestingBy || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      String(o.id).includes(q));
  }

  if (list.length === 0) {
    const label = procActiveFilter === 'all' ? '' : procActiveFilter.toUpperCase() + ' ';
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No ' + label + 'Tenders</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = list.map(o => {
    const submitter = o.requestingDepartment || '';
    const originator = o.originatorDepartment || submitter;
    let originatorLine = '';
    if (submitter.toLowerCase() !== originator.toLowerCase()) {
      originatorLine = ' <span class="muted">(submitted by ' + escapeHtml(submitter) + ' for ' + escapeHtml(originator) + ')</span>';
    }

    const supplier = o.procurementOrder && o.procurementOrder.supplierName
      ? '<p><em>Supplier:</em> ' + escapeHtml(o.procurementOrder.supplierName) + '</p>'
      : '';
    const actions = renderProcOrderActions(o);

    return '<div class="tender-card">' +
      '<div class="tender-head">' +
      '<div>' +
      '<strong>#' + o.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(o.itemName) + ' x' + o.quantity + '</strong>' +
      '<div class="muted"><span class="dept-pill">' + escapeHtml(originator) + '</span>' +
      originatorLine + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div>' + statusBadge(o.status) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="tender-body">' +
      '<p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(o.reason) + '</p>' +
      supplier +
      '</div>' +
      (actions ? '<div class="order-actions">' + actions + '</div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderProcOrderActions(o) {
  if (o.status === 'pending' || o.status === 'awaiting_quotation') {
    return '<button class="success-btn" onclick="openApproveModal(' + o.id + ')">Approve and Send</button>' +
           '<button class="ghost-btn" onclick="openAwaitQuotationModal(' + o.id + ')">Waiting for Quotation</button>';
  }
  return '';
}

function filterProcurementOrders() { renderProcurementOrders(); }

// ============================================================
// APPROVE MODAL
// ============================================================
function openApproveModal(orderId) {
  const o = allProcurementOrders.find(x => x.id === orderId);
  if (!o) return;

  if (!document.getElementById('approveOrderId')) {
    const f = document.createElement('input');
    f.type = 'hidden';
    f.id = 'approveOrderId';
    document.body.appendChild(f);
  }

  document.getElementById('approveOrderId').value = orderId;
  document.getElementById('approveOrderLabel').textContent =
    '#' + o.id + ' - ' + o.itemName + ' x' + o.quantity +
    ' (for ' + (o.originatorDepartment || o.requestingDepartment) + ')';
  document.getElementById('approveSupplierName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('approveExpectedDate').value = '';
  document.getElementById('approveNotes').value = '';
  document.getElementById('approveMessage').innerHTML = '';

  document.getElementById('approveModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

function closeApproveModal() {
  document.getElementById('approveModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
}

async function confirmApprove() {
  const id = document.getElementById('approveOrderId').value;
  const supplierName = document.getElementById('approveSupplierName').value.trim();
  const expectedDeliveryDate = document.getElementById('approveExpectedDate').value;
  const approvalNotes = document.getElementById('approveNotes').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById('approveMessage');

  if (!supplierName) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Supplier name is required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/requests/' + id + '/approve', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ supplierName, expectedDeliveryDate, approvalNotes }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    closeApproveModal();
    await loadProcurementDashboard();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

function openAwaitQuotationModal(orderId) {
  const o = allProcurementOrders.find(x => x.id === orderId);
  if (!o) return;

  if (!document.getElementById('awaitOrderId')) {
    const f = document.createElement('input');
    f.type = 'hidden';
    f.id = 'awaitOrderId';
    document.body.appendChild(f);
  }

  document.getElementById('awaitOrderId').value = orderId;
  document.getElementById('awaitOrderLabel').textContent =
    '#' + o.id + ' - ' + o.itemName + ' x' + o.quantity;
  document.getElementById('awaitNote').value = '';
  document.getElementById('awaitMessage').innerHTML = '';

  document.getElementById('awaitModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

function closeAwaitModal() {
  document.getElementById('awaitModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
}

async function confirmAwaitQuotation() {
  const id = document.getElementById('awaitOrderId').value;
  const note = document.getElementById('awaitNote').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById('awaitMessage');

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/requests/' + id + '/await-quotation', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ note }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    closeAwaitModal();
    await loadProcurementDashboard();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}
