function debouncedHistorySearch() {
  clearTimeout(historySearchTimer);
  historySearchTimer = setTimeout(loadTenderHistory, 300);
}

async function loadHistorySummary() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/history/summary', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const s = await res.json();

    document.getElementById('hTotal').textContent = s.total;
    document.getElementById('hPending').textContent = s.byStatus.pending || 0;
    document.getElementById('hApproved').textContent = s.byStatus.ordered || 0;
    document.getElementById('hRejected').textContent = s.byStatus.awaiting_quotation || 0;
    document.getElementById('hReceived').textContent =
      (s.byStatus.received || 0) + (s.byStatus.in_storage || 0);
    document.getElementById('hRecent').textContent = s.last30Days;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

async function loadTenderHistory() {
  const el = document.getElementById('proc-tenderHistoryList');
  const search = document.getElementById('histSearch').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('histStatus').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('histDept')?.value || 'all';
  const from = document.getElementById('histFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('histTo').value;

  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (status !== 'all') params.set('status', status);
  if (department !== 'all') params.set('department', department);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);

  el.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">Loading...</p>';

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/history?' + params, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load history');
    const tenders = await res.json();

    const countEl = document.getElementById('histCount');
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '(' + tenders.length + ' tenders)';

    if (tenders.length === 0) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Matching Tenders</div>';
      return;
    }

    el.innerHTML = tenders.map(t => {
      const submitter = t.requestingDepartment || '';
      const originator = t.originatorDepartment || submitter;
      const supplier = t.procurementOrder && t.procurementOrder.supplierName
        ? '<p><em>Supplier:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.procurementOrder.supplierName) + '</p>'
        : '';
      const timeline = (t.statusLogs || []).length > 0
        ? '<details><summary class="muted">Timeline (' + t.statusLogs.length + ' events)</summary>' +
          '<div class="tender-timeline">' +
          t.statusLogs.slice().reverse().map(log =>
            '<div class="tl-item"><span class="tl-dot"></span>' +
            '<span><strong>' + log.newStatus.toUpperCase() + '</strong> - ' +
            escapeHtml(log.changedBy) + ' - ' + fmtDateTime(log.timestamp) + '</span>' +
            (log.notes ? '<div class="muted">' + escapeHtml(log.notes) + '</div>' : '') +
            '</div>'
          ).join('') +
          '</div></details>'
        : '';

      return '<div class="tender-card">' +
        '<div class="tender-head">' +
        '<div>' +
        '<strong>#' + t.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</strong>' +
        '<div class="muted"><span class="dept-pill">' + escapeHtml(originator) + '</span>' +
        (submitter !== originator ? ' (submitted by ' + escapeHtml(submitter) + ')' : '') +
        ' by ' + escapeHtml(t.requestingBy) + ' - ' + fmtDate(t.createdAt) + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div>' + statusBadge(t.status) + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="tender-body">' +
        '<p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.reason) + '</p>' +
        supplier +
        '</div>' +
        timeline +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

function clearHistoryFilters() {
  document.getElementById('histSearch').value = '';
  document.getElementById('histStatus').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('histDept').value = 'all';
  document.getElementById('histFrom').value = '';
  document.getElementById('histTo').value = '';
  loadTenderHistory();
}

// ============================================================
// MY TENDERS
// ============================================================
async function submitTenderRequest(deptKey) {
  const originatorDepartment = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqOriginator')?.value || currentDeptName;
  const itemName = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqItemName').value.trim();
  const quantity = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqQuantity').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqReason').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-requestMessage');

  if (!itemName || !quantity || !reason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">All fields required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/request', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ itemName, quantity: parseInt(quantity), reason, originatorDepartment }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Request submitted</div>';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqItemName').value = '';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqQuantity').value = '';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqReason').value = '';
    await loadMyTenders();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

async function loadMyTenders() {
  const res = await fetch('/api/orders/my', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
  if (!res.ok) return;
  allTenders = await res.json();
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function setTenderFilter(btn) {
  const bar = btn.closest('.filter-bar, .tender-filters');
  if (bar) bar.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  tenderFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function filterTenders() { renderTenderTracker(); }

function renderTenderTracker() {
  const el = document.getElementById('proc-tenderTrackerList');
  const q = (document.getElementById('proc-tenderSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();

  let list = allTenders;
  if (tenderFilter !== 'all') list = list.filter(t => t.status === tenderFilter);
  if (q) list = list.filter(t => String(t.itemName).toLowerCase().includes(q));

  if (list.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Tenders</div>';
    return;
  }

  const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();

  el.innerHTML = list.map(t => {
    const submitter = t.requestingDepartment || '';
    const originator = t.originatorDepartment || submitter;
    const submittedByMe = String(submitter).toLowerCase() === myDept;
    const submittedForMe = String(originator).toLowerCase() === myDept;

    let meta = 'Requested by: ' + escapeHtml(submitter);
    if (!submittedByMe && submittedForMe) {
      meta = 'Requested FOR your department by ' + escapeHtml(submitter);
    } else if (submittedByMe && originator !== submitter) {
      meta = 'Submitted by you FOR ' + escapeHtml(originator);
    }

    return '<div class="tender-card">' +
      '<div class="tender-head">' +
      '<div>' +
      '<strong>#' + t.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</strong>' +
      '<div class="muted">' + meta + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div>' + statusBadge(t.status) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="tender-body"><p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.reason) + '</p></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

=================== ./public/js/projects.js ===================
// Project tracker. Auto-injects the projects card into the current portal.
// Loaded by core.js after the portal fragment is injected.

let allProjects = [];
let projectSearchTimer = null;
let currentOpenProjectId = null;

// Insert projects card, load summary, run initial search, wire forms.
async function init_projects() {
  const portalContainer = document.getElementById('portalContainer');
  if (!portalContainer) return;

  // Skip if card already injected.
  if (document.getElementById('projectsCard')) {
    await loadProjectsSummary();
    await runProjectSearch();
    wireProjectForms();
    return;
  }

  // Inject the card HTML.
  try {
    const res = await fetch('portals/projects.html');
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const html = await res.text();

    const targetPortal = portalContainer.querySelector('.portal.active');
    if (!targetPortal) return;

    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.innerHTML = html.trim();
    const card = wrapper.firstElementChild;
    if (card) {
      card.dataset.dept = currentDeptName || '';
      targetPortal.appendChild(card);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to inject projects card:', e);
    return;
  }

  await loadProjectsSummary();
  await runProjectSearch();
  wireProjectForms();

  window.onProjectUpdated = () => {
    loadProjectsSummary();
    runProjectSearch();
  };
}

function debouncedProjectSearch() {
  clearTimeout(projectSearchTimer);
  projectSearchTimer = setTimeout(runProjectSearch, 300);
}

// Fetch projects matching filters.
async function runProjectSearch() {
  const el = document.getElementById('projectsList');
  if (!el) return;

  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('projectsSearchBox').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('projectsStatusFilter').value;
  const scope = document.getElementById('projectsScopeFilter').value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (status && status !== 'all') params.set('status', status);
  params.set('scope', scope);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/projects?' + params, {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load projects');
    allProjects = await res.json();
    renderProjects();
  } catch (e) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="error">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

// Summary counts for the header.
async function loadProjectsSummary() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/projects/summary', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const s = await res.json();

    const totalEl = document.getElementById('projectsSummaryTotal');
    const ongoingEl = document.getElementById('projectsSummaryOngoing');
    const pendingEl = document.getElementById('projectsSummaryPending');
    const completedEl = document.getElementById('projectsSummaryCompleted');

    if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = s.total || 0;
    if (ongoingEl) ongoingEl.textContent = (s.byStatus && s.byStatus.ongoing) || 0;
    if (pendingEl) pendingEl.textContent = (s.byStatus && s.byStatus.pending) || 0;
    if (completedEl) completedEl.textContent = (s.byStatus && s.byStatus.completed) || 0;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

// Status pill for project rows.
function projectStatusPill(status) {
  const map = {
    ongoing: 'badge-approved',
    pending: 'badge-rejected',
    completed: 'badge-received',
  };
  const cls = map[status] || 'badge-pending';
  return '<span class="badge ' + cls + '">' + String(status).toUpperCase() + '</span>';
}

// Render project list.
function renderProjects() {
  const el = document.getElementById('projectsList');
  if (!el) return;

  if (!allProjects || allProjects.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No projects</div>';
    return;
  }

  const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();

  el.innerHTML = allProjects.map(p => {
    const latestUpdate = p.updates && p.updates[0];
    const isOwn = String(p.department || '').toLowerCase() === myDept;

    let updateLine = '';
    if (latestUpdate) {
      updateLine = '<p class="muted" style="margin:6px 0 0 0;"><em>Latest:</em> ' +
        escapeHtml(latestUpdate.note) + ' - ' +
        escapeHtml(latestUpdate.updatedBy) + ' - ' +
        fmtDateTime(latestUpdate.timestamp) + '</p>';
    }

    let obstacleLine = '';
    if (p.status === 'pending' && p.obstacleReason) {
      obstacleLine = '<p style="margin:6px 0 0 0; color:var(--error);"><strong>Blocked:</strong> ' +
        escapeHtml(p.obstacleReason) + '</p>';
    }

    return '<div class="tender-card">' +
      '<div class="tender-head">' +
      '<div>' +
      '<strong>' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</strong>' +
      '<div class="muted">' +
      '<span class="dept-pill">' + escapeHtml(p.department) + '</span>' +
      'Head: ' + escapeHtml(p.projectHead) +
      '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div>' + projectStatusPill(p.status) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="tender-body">' +
      '<p style="margin:0;">' + escapeHtml(p.description) + '</p>' +
      obstacleLine +
      updateLine +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="order-actions">' +
      (isOwn ? '<button class="pill-btn" onclick="openProjectUpdateModal(' + p.id + ')">Add Update</button>' : '') +
      '<button class="ghost-btn" onclick="openProjectDetail(' + p.id + ')">View History</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

// Open project history detail modal.
async function openProjectDetail(projectId) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/projects/' + projectId, {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load project');
    const p = await res.json();

    currentOpenProjectId = projectId;

    document.getElementById('projectDetailTitle').textContent = p.name;
    document.getElementById('projectDetailMeta').textContent =
      p.department + ' - Head: ' + p.projectHead + ' - Status: ' + p.status.toUpperCase();

    const updatesHtml = (p.updates || []).map(u => {
      let blockLine = '';
      if (u.statusAtUpdate === 'pending' && u.obstacleReason) {
        blockLine = '<div class="muted" style="color:var(--error);">Blocked: ' + escapeHtml(u.obstacleReason) + '</div>';
      }
      let actionLine = '';
      if (u.actionTaken) {
        actionLine = '<div class="muted">Action: ' + escapeHtml(u.actionTaken) + '</div>';
      }
      return '<div class="tl-item">' +
        '<span class="tl-dot"></span>' +
        '<span><strong>' + u.statusAtUpdate.toUpperCase() + '</strong> - ' +
        escapeHtml(u.updatedBy) + ' - ' + fmtDateTime(u.timestamp) + '</span>' +
        '<div style="margin-left:16px;">' + escapeHtml(u.note) + '</div>' +
        blockLine +
        actionLine +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');

    document.getElementById('projectDetailTimeline').innerHTML =
      updatesHtml || '<p class="muted">No updates yet</p>';

    document.getElementById('projectDetailModal').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

function closeProjectDetail() {
  document.getElementById('projectDetailModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
  currentOpenProjectId = null;
}

// ============================================================
// NEW PROJECT MODAL
// ============================================================
function openProjectNewModal() {
  ['projectNewName', 'projectNewDescription', 'projectNewHead', 'projectNewStart',
   'projectNewTarget', 'projectNewNote', 'projectNewObstacle'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.value = '';
  });
  document.getElementById('projectNewStatus').value = 'ongoing';
  document.getElementById('projectNewMessage').innerHTML = '';
  toggleProjectNewObstacle();

  document.getElementById('projectNewModal').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}

function closeProjectNewModal() {
  document.getElementById('projectNewModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('active');
}

// Show/hide obstacle field based on status.
function toggleProjectNewObstacle() {
  const status = document.getElementById('projectNewStatus').value;
  const row = document.getElementById('projectNewObstacleRow');
  const noteLabel = document.getElementById('projectNewNoteLabel');
  if (!row) return;

  if (status === 'pending') {
    row.style.display = 'block';
    noteLabel.textContent = "What's happening";
  } else if (status === 'completed') {
    row.style.display = 'none';
    noteLabel.textContent = 'What was completed';
  } else {
    row.style.display = 'none';
    noteLabel.textContent = "What's happening";
  }
}

async function submitProjectNew() {
  const msg = document.getElementById('projectNewMessage');
  const name = document.getElementById('projectNewName').value.trim();
  const description = document.getElementById('projectNewDescription').value.trim();
  const projectHead = document.getElementById('projectNewHead').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('projectNewStatus').value;
  const startDate = document.getElementById('projectNewStart').value;
  const targetDate = document.getElementById('projectNewTarget').value;
  const note = document.getElementById('projectNewNote').value.trim();
  const obstacleReason = document.getElementById('projectNewObstacle').value.trim();

  if (!name || !description || !projectHead) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Name, description, and project head are required</div>';
    return;
  }
  if (!note) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Please describe what is happening</div>';
    return;
  }
  if (status === 'pending' && !obstacleReason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Obstacle reason is required when status is pending</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/projects', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name, description, projectHead, status,
        startDate: startDate || null,
        targetDate: targetDate || null,
        note,
        obstacleReason: status === 'pending' ? obstacleReason : null,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Project created</div>';
    setTimeout(() => {
      closeProjectNewModal();
      loadProjectsSummary();
      runProjectSearch();
    }, 700);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

async function submitProjectUpdate() {
  if (!currentOpenProjectId) return;

  const msg = document.getElementById('projectUpdateMessage');
  const status = document.getElementById('projectUpdateStatus').value;
  const note = document.getElementById('projectUpdateNote').value.trim();
  const obstacleReason = document.getElementById('projectUpdateObstacle').value.trim();
  const actionTaken = document.getElementById('projectUpdateAction').value.trim();

  if (!note) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Please describe what is happening</div>';
    return;
  }
  if (status === 'pending' && !obstacleReason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Obstacle reason is required when status is pending</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/projects/' + currentOpenProjectId + '/updates', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        note,
        status,
        obstacleReason: status === 'pending' ? obstacleReason : null,
        actionTaken: actionTaken || null,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Update added</div>';
    setTimeout(() => {
      closeProjectUpdateModal();
      loadProjectsSummary();
      runProjectSearch();
    }, 700);
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// PRINT PROJECTS
// ============================================================
function printProjects() {
  if (!allProjects || allProjects.length === 0) {
    alert('No projects to print.');
    return;
  }

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const phone = systemSettings.contactPhone || '';
  const address = systemSettings.contactAddress || '';
  const now = new Date();

  const filterParts = [];
  const search = document.getElementById('projectsSearchBox').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('projectsStatusFilter').value;
  const scope = document.getElementById('projectsScopeFilter').value;

  if (search) filterParts.push('Search="' + search + '"');
  if (status && status !== 'all') filterParts.push('Status=' + status);
  if (scope === 'own') filterParts.push('Scope=My Department');
  else filterParts.push('Scope=All Departments');

  const filterLine = 'Filters: ' + filterParts.join(', ');

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header">';
  html += '<h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1>';
  html += '<h2>Projects Report</h2>';
  html += '</div>';

  if (phone || address) {
    html += '<div class="print-contact">';
    if (address) html += '<p>' + escapeHtml(address) + '</p>';
    if (phone) html += '<p>Tel: ' + escapeHtml(phone) + '</p>';
    html += '</div>';
  }

  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Total Projects:</strong> ' + allProjects.length + '</p>';
  html += '<p><strong>Report Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '<p style="grid-column: span 2;"><strong>' + escapeHtml(filterLine) + '</strong></p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<table class="print-table">';
  html += '<thead><tr>';
  html += '<th>#</th><th>Project</th><th>Department</th><th>Head</th><th>Status</th><th>Latest Update</th>';
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  allProjects.forEach((p, i) => {
    const latest = p.updates && p.updates[0];
    const latestText = latest ? latest.note : 'No updates';
    html += '<tr>';
    html += '<td>' + (i + 1) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(p.name) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(p.department) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(p.projectHead) + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + String(p.status).toUpperCase() + '</td>';
    html += '<td>' + escapeHtml(latestText) + '</td>';
    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table>';
  html += '<div class="print-footer">';
  html += escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now);
  html += '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => window.print(), 200);
}

// ============================================================
// FORM WIRING
// ============================================================
function wireProjectForms() {
  const newStatus = document.getElementById('projectNewStatus');
  if (newStatus && !newStatus.dataset.wired) {
    newStatus.addEventListener('change', toggleProjectNewObstacle);
    newStatus.dataset.wired = '1';
  }

  const updateStatus = document.getElementById('projectUpdateStatus');
  if (updateStatus && !updateStatus.dataset.wired) {
    updateStatus.addEventListener('change', toggleProjectUpdateObstacle);
    updateStatus.dataset.wired = '1';
  }
}
// OVERRIDE submitProjectNew to prevent double submissions
const originalSubmitProjectNew = window.submitProjectNew;
window.submitProjectNew = async function() {
  const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="submitProjectNew()"]');
  const msg = document.getElementById('projectNewMessage');
  
  // 1. If the button is already disabled, ignore the click
  if (btn && btn.disabled) return;
  
  // 2. Disable the button and show a loading state
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.dataset.originalText = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = 'Creating...';
  }
  
  try {
    // Run the original logic
    await originalSubmitProjectNew();
  } finally {
    // 3. Re-enable the button after the request finishes (success or fail)
    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = btn.dataset.originalText || 'Create Project';
    }
  }
};

// OVERRIDE submitProjectUpdate to prevent double submissions
const originalSubmitProjectUpdate = window.submitProjectUpdate;
window.submitProjectUpdate = async function() {
  const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="submitProjectUpdate()"]');
  
  if (btn && btn.disabled) return;
  
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.dataset.originalText = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = 'Saving...';
  }
  
  try {
    await originalSubmitProjectUpdate();
  } finally {
    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = btn.dataset.originalText || 'Add Update';
    }
  }
};

// ============================================================
// Sally Mugabe Central Hospital - Stores Department
// ============================================================

let allInventory = [];
let allApprovedForStores = [];
let allTenders = [];
let tenderFilter = 'all';

async function init_stores() {
  await loadStoresInventory();
  await loadApprovedOrdersForStores();
  await loadMyTenders();
  window.onOrderUpdated = (payload) => {
    loadApprovedOrdersForStores();
    const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();
    const sub = String(payload?.department || '').toLowerCase();
    const orig = String(payload?.originator || '').toLowerCase();
    if (sub === myDept || orig === myDept) loadMyTenders();
  };
  window.onInventoryUpdated = () => loadStoresInventory();
}

// ============================================================
// INVENTORY
// ============================================================
async function loadStoresInventory() {
  try {
    const [invRes, sumRes, histRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch('/api/inventory', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
      fetch('/api/inventory/summary', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
      fetch('/api/inventory/receive-history', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } }),
    ]);

    allInventory = await invRes.json();
    const summary = await sumRes.json();
    const history = await histRes.json();

    renderInventory();

    document.getElementById('stores-invCritical').textContent = summary.critical;
    document.getElementById('stores-invLow').textContent = summary.low;
    document.getElementById('stores-invAdequate').textContent = summary.adequate;
    document.getElementById('stores-invTotal').textContent = summary.totalItems;

    renderReceiveHistory(history);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

function renderInventory() {
  const el = document.getElementById('stores-inventoryList');
  const q = (document.getElementById('stores-invSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();

  const list = q
    ? allInventory.filter(i => i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    : allInventory;

  if (list.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Inventory</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table">' +
    '<thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Unit</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    list.map(i => {
      let label = 'Adequate';
      let cls = 'status-ok';
      if (i.quantity < 10) { label = 'Critical'; cls = 'status-critical'; }
      else if (i.quantity < 50) { label = 'Low'; cls = 'status-low'; }

      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(i.name) + '</td>' +
        '<td><strong>' + i.quantity + '</strong></td>' +
        '<td>' + escapeHtml(i.unit) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="status-pill ' + cls + '">' + label + '</span></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('') +
    '</tbody></table>';
}

function filterInventory() { renderInventory(); }

function renderReceiveHistory(history) {
  const el = document.getElementById('stores-receiveHistory');
  if (history.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No receipts yet</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = history.slice(0, 15).map(r =>
    '<div class="mini-item">' +
    '<strong>' + escapeHtml(r.inventoryItem.name) + ' x' + r.quantityReceived + '</strong>' +
    '<span class="muted"> - ' + escapeHtml(r.receivedBy) + ' - ' + fmtDateTime(r.receivedAt) + '</span>' +
    '</div>'
  ).join('');
}


// ============================================================
// APPROVED ORDERS
// ============================================================
async function loadApprovedOrdersForStores() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/inventory/approved-orders', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    allApprovedForStores = await res.json();
    renderApprovedForStores();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

function renderApprovedForStores() {
  const el = document.getElementById('stores-approvedOrders');
  const q = (document.getElementById('stores-approvedSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();

  const list = q
    ? allApprovedForStores.filter(o =>
        o.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        o.requestingDepartment.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(o.id).includes(q))
    : allApprovedForStores;

  if (list.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Approved Tenders Waiting</div>';
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = list.map(o => {
    const originator = o.originatorDepartment || o.requestingDepartment;
    return '<div class="order-card-mini">' +
      '<div><strong>#' + o.id + '</strong> ' + escapeHtml(o.itemName) + ' x' + o.quantity + '</div>' +
      '<div class="muted">' + escapeHtml(originator) + ' - ' + statusBadge(o.status) + '</div>' +
      '<button class="pill-btn" onclick="prefillReceive(' + o.id + ', \'' +
      o.itemName.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\', ' + o.quantity + ')">Receive This</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function filterApprovedForStores() { renderApprovedForStores(); }

function prefillReceive(orderId, itemName, qty) {
  document.getElementById('stores-receiveOrderId').value = orderId;
  document.getElementById('stores-receiveItemName').value = itemName;
  document.getElementById('stores-receiveQty').value = qty;
  document.getElementById('stores-receiveQty').focus();
}

// ============================================================
// RECEIVE
// ============================================================
async function receiveItems() {
  const orderRequestId = document.getElementById('stores-receiveOrderId').value;
  const itemName = document.getElementById('stores-receiveItemName').value.trim();
  const quantityReceived = document.getElementById('stores-receiveQty').value;
  const notes = document.getElementById('stores-receiveNotes').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('stores-receiveMessage');

  if (!orderRequestId || !itemName || !quantityReceived) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Order ID, item name, and quantity required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/inventory/receive', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        orderRequestId: parseInt(orderRequestId),
        itemName,
        quantityReceived: parseInt(quantityReceived),
        notes,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Items received and inventory updated</div>';
    document.getElementById('stores-receiveOrderId').value = '';
    document.getElementById('stores-receiveItemName').value = '';
    document.getElementById('stores-receiveQty').value = '';
    document.getElementById('stores-receiveNotes').value = '';

    await loadStoresInventory();
    await loadApprovedOrdersForStores();
    await loadMyTenders();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// TENDERS
// ============================================================
async function submitTenderRequest(deptKey) {
  const originatorDepartment = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqOriginator')?.value || currentDeptName;
  const itemName = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqItemName').value.trim();
  const quantity = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqQuantity').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqReason').value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById(deptKey + '-requestMessage');

  if (!itemName || !quantity || !reason) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">All fields required</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/orders/request', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
      body: JSON.stringify({ itemName, quantity: parseInt(quantity), reason, originatorDepartment }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="success">Request submitted</div>';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqItemName').value = '';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqQuantity').value = '';
    document.getElementById(deptKey + '-reqReason').value = '';
    await loadMyTenders();
  } catch (e) {
    msg.innerHTML = '<div class="error">' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

async function loadMyTenders() {
  const res = await fetch('/api/orders/my', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } });
  if (!res.ok) return;
  allTenders = await res.json();
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function setTenderFilter(btn) {
  const parent = btn.closest('.filter-bar');
  if (parent) {
    parent.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  }
  btn.classList.add('active');
  tenderFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
  renderTenderTracker();
}

function filterTenders() { renderTenderTracker(); }

function renderTenderTracker() {
  const el = document.getElementById('stores-tenderTrackerList');
  const q = (document.getElementById('stores-tenderSearch')?.value || '').toLowerCase();

  let list = allTenders;
  if (tenderFilter !== 'all') list = list.filter(t => t.status === tenderFilter);
  if (q) list = list.filter(t => String(t.itemName).toLowerCase().includes(q));

  if (list.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No Tenders</div>';
    return;
  }

  const myDept = String(currentDeptName || '').toLowerCase();

  el.innerHTML = list.map(t => {
    const submitter = t.requestingDepartment || '';
    const originator = t.originatorDepartment || submitter;
    const submittedByMe = String(submitter).toLowerCase() === myDept;
    const submittedForMe = String(originator).toLowerCase() === myDept;

    let meta = 'Requested by: ' + escapeHtml(submitter);
    if (!submittedByMe && submittedForMe) {
      meta = 'Requested FOR your department by ' + escapeHtml(submitter);
    } else if (submittedByMe && originator.toLowerCase() !== submitter.toLowerCase()) {
      meta = 'Submitted by you FOR ' + escapeHtml(originator);
    }

    return '<div class="tender-card">' +
      '<div class="tender-head">' +
      '<div>' +
      '<strong>#' + t.id + ' - ' + escapeHtml(t.itemName) + ' x' + t.quantity + '</strong>' +
      '<div class="muted">' + meta + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div>' + statusBadge(t.status) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="tender-body"><p><em>Reason:</em> ' + escapeHtml(t.reason) + '</p></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function printInventory() {
  if (!allInventory || allInventory.length === 0) {
    alert('No inventory to print.');
    return;
  }

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const now = new Date();

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header"><h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1><h2>Inventory Report</h2></div>';
  
  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Total Items:</strong> ' + allInventory.length + '</p>';
  html += '<p><strong>Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<table class="print-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Item</th><th>Category</th><th>Quantity</th><th>Unit</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

  allInventory.forEach((i, idx) => {
    let statusLabel = 'Adequate';
    if (i.quantity < 10) statusLabel = 'Critical';
    else if (i.quantity < 50) statusLabel = 'Low';

    html += '<tr><td>' + (idx + 1) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(i.name) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(i.category || '-') + '</td><td>' + i.quantity + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(i.unit) + '</td><td>' + statusLabel + '</td></tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table>';
  html += '<div class="print-footer">' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  printContent(html);
}
function printInventory() {
  if (allInventory.length === 0) { alert('No inventory to print.'); return; }
  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const now = new Date();
  let html = '<div class="print-page a4"><div class="print-header"><h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1><h2>Inventory Report</h2></div>';
  html += '<div class="print-meta"><p><strong>Total Items:</strong> ' + allInventory.length + '</p><p><strong>Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p></div>';
  html += '<table class="print-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Item</th><th>Category</th><th>Qty</th><th>Unit</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  allInventory.forEach((i, idx) => {
    let statusLabel = i.quantity < 10 ? 'Critical' : i.quantity < 50 ? 'Low' : 'Adequate';
    html += '<tr><td>' + (idx + 1) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(i.name) + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(i.category || '-') + '</td><td>' + i.quantity + '</td><td>' + escapeHtml(i.unit) + '</td><td>' + statusLabel + '</td></tr>';
  });
  html += '</tbody></table><div class="print-footer">' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</div></div>';
  printContent(html);
}

function printMyTenders() {
  if (allTenders.length === 0) { alert('No tenders to print.'); return; }
  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const now = new Date();
  let html = '<div class="print-page a4"><div class="print-header"><h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1><h2>Stores Department Tenders</h2></div>';

async function init_super() {
  await refreshSuperAdminSettings();
  await initAudit();
}

async function refreshSuperAdminSettings() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/settings/public');
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById('saHospitalName').textContent = data.hospitalName || '-';
    document.getElementById('saSubtitle').textContent = data.hospitalSubtitle || '-';
    document.getElementById('saPhone').textContent = data.contactPhone || '(not set)';
    document.getElementById('saAddress').textContent = data.contactAddress || '(not set)';

    systemSettings.hospitalName = data.hospitalName || systemSettings.hospitalName;
    systemSettings.hospitalSubtitle = data.hospitalSubtitle || systemSettings.hospitalSubtitle;
    applySettingsToShell();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// AUDIT LOG
// ============================================================

let auditPage = 1;
let auditPageSize = 100;

async function initAudit() {
  const section = document.getElementById('auditSection');
  if (!section) return;
  await loadAuditFilters();
  await loadAudit(1);
}

async function loadAuditFilters() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/audit/filters', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const f = await res.json();

    const fill = (id, items, getVal, getLabel) => {
      const sel = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!sel) return;
      const first = sel.options[0] ? sel.options[0].outerHTML : '';
      sel.innerHTML = first +
        items.map(it => '<option value="' + escapeHtml(getVal(it)) + '">' + escapeHtml(getLabel(it)) + '</option>').join('');
    };

    fill('auditFilterAction', f.actions,     a => a, a => a);
    fill('auditFilterEntity', f.entities,    e => e, e => e);
    fill('auditFilterUser',   f.users,       u => u.username, u => u.fullName + ' (' + u.username + ')');
    fill('auditFilterDept',   f.departments, d => d, d => d);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
}

async function loadAudit(page = 1) {
  auditPage = page;
  const el = document.getElementById('auditTableWrap');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('auditCount');
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = '<p class="muted" style="padding:16px;">Loading...</p>';

  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const search = document.getElementById('auditSearch').value.trim();
  const action = document.getElementById('auditFilterAction').value;
  const entity = document.getElementById('auditFilterEntity').value;
  const username = document.getElementById('auditFilterUser').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('auditFilterDept').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('auditFrom').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('auditTo').value;

  if (search) params.set('search', search);
  if (action) params.set('action', action);
  if (entity) params.set('entity', entity);
  if (username) params.set('username', username);
  if (department) params.set('department', department);
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);
  params.set('page', page);
  params.set('pageSize', auditPageSize);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/audit?' + params, {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load audit log');
    const data = await res.json();

    countEl.textContent = data.total + ' entries — page ' + data.page + ' of ' + data.pages;

    if (data.rows.length === 0) {
      el.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-state" style="padding:16px;">No audit entries match filters</p>';
      document.getElementById('auditPager').innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    el.innerHTML = '<table class="data-table" style="margin:0; border:none;">' +
      '<thead style="position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--bg-color); z-index:1;">' +
      '<tr>' +
      '<th>Time</th><th>User</th><th>Dept</th><th>Action</th><th>Entity</th><th>Summary</th><th>Device</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
      data.rows.map(r => {
        const actionCls = {
          create:       'badge-approved',
          update:       'badge-pending',
          delete:       'badge-rejected',
          login:        'badge-received',
          login_failed: 'badge-rejected',
          upload:       'badge-ordered',
        }[r.action] || 'badge-pending';

        return '<tr title="' + escapeHtml(r.userAgent || '') + '">' +
          '<td style="white-space:nowrap;">' + fmtDateTime(r.timestamp) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + escapeHtml(r.fullName) + '<br><span class="muted" style="font-size:11px;">' + escapeHtml(r.username) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><span class="dept-pill">' + escapeHtml(r.department) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><span class="badge ' + actionCls + '">' + escapeHtml(String(r.action).toUpperCase()) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td>' + escapeHtml(r.entity) + (r.entityId ? ' #' + escapeHtml(r.entityId) : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + escapeHtml(r.summary) + '</td>' +
          '<td><span class="muted" style="font-size:11px;">' + escapeHtml((r.ipAddress || '') + ' / ' + (r.deviceTag || '').slice(0, 30)) + '</span></td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('') +
      '</tbody></table>';

    const pager = document.getElementById('auditPager');
    pager.innerHTML =
      '<button class="ghost-btn" ' + (data.page <= 1 ? 'disabled' : '') + ' onclick="loadAudit(' + (data.page - 1) + ')">‹ Prev</button>' +
      '<span class="muted">Page ' + data.page + ' / ' + data.pages + '</span>' +
      '<button class="ghost-btn" ' + (data.page >= data.pages ? 'disabled' : '') + ' onclick="loadAudit(' + (data.page + 1) + ')">Next ›</button>';
  } catch (e) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="error" style="padding:16px;">' + e.message + '</p>';
  }
}

function clearAuditFilters() {
  document.getElementById('auditSearch').value = '';
  document.getElementById('auditFilterAction').value = '';
  document.getElementById('auditFilterEntity').value = '';
  document.getElementById('auditFilterUser').value = '';
  document.getElementById('auditFilterDept').value = '';
  document.getElementById('auditFrom').value = '';
  document.getElementById('auditTo').value = '';
  loadAudit(1);
}

async function printAuditLog() {
  const tableWrap = document.getElementById('auditTableWrap');
  if (!tableWrap || !tableWrap.innerHTML.trim()) return;

  // Extract the table HTML from the wrapper
  const tableHtml = tableWrap.innerHTML;
  
  // Extract current filters for the header
  const search = document.getElementById('auditSearch').value.trim();
  const action = document.getElementById('auditFilterAction').value;
  const department = document.getElementById('auditFilterDept').value;
  
  let filterParts = [];
  if (search) filterParts.push('Search="' + search + '"');
  if (action) filterParts.push('Action=' + action);
  if (department) filterParts.push('Dept=' + department);
  const filterLine = filterParts.length > 0 ? 'Filters: ' + filterParts.join(', ') : 'Filters: none (all entries)';

  const hospitalName = (systemSettings.hospitalName || 'Sally Mugabe Central Hospital').toUpperCase();
  const now = new Date();

  let html = '<div class="print-page a4">';
  html += '<div class="print-header">';
  html += '<h1>' + escapeHtml(hospitalName) + '</h1>';
  html += '<h2>System Audit Log</h2>';
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<div class="print-meta">';
  html += '<p><strong>Report Generated:</strong> ' + fmtDateTime(now) + '</p>';
  html += '<p style="grid-column: span 2;"><strong>' + escapeHtml(filterLine) + '</strong></p>';
  html += '</div>';

  // We wrap the table in the print-table class to style it for paper
  html += '<div style="margin-top:20px;" class="print-table-wrapper">';
  html += tableHtml;
  html += '</div>';

  html += '<div class="print-footer">';
  html += escapeHtml(hospitalName) + ' - Generated ' + fmtDateTime(now);
  html += '</div>';
  html += '</div>';

  // Trigger the print
  document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = html;
  setTimeout(() => {
    window.print();
    setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('printArea').innerHTML = ''; }, 500);
  }, 200);
}

=================== ./public/sw.js ===================
const CACHE_NAME = 'mushamumwe-v2';
const ASSETS = [
  '/',
  '/Dashboard',
  '/style.css',
  '/js/core.js',
  '/logo.jpg'
];

self.addEventListener('install', (e) => {
  self.skipWaiting();
  e.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.addAll(ASSETS))
  );
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (e) => {
  e.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((keyList) => {
      return Promise.all(keyList.map((key) => {
        if (key !== CACHE_NAME) return caches.delete(key);
      }));
    })
  );
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', (e) => {
  // Don't intercept API calls
  if (e.request.url.includes('/api/')) return;
  
  e.respondWith(
    caches.match(e.request).then((response) => {
      return response || fetch(e.request);
    })
  );
});
=================== ./setup.sh ===================
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "🚀 MushaMumwe Setup — One Command"
echo ""

if ! command -v psql &> /dev/null; then
  echo "📦 Installing PostgreSQL..."
  sudo apt update
  sudo apt install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib
fi

echo "🗄️  Starting PostgreSQL..."
sudo systemctl start postgresql
sudo systemctl enable postgresql

echo "🔐 Creating database and user..."
sudo -u postgres psql <<SQL
  DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS mushamumwe_test;
  DROP USER IF EXISTS dashboard_user;
  CREATE DATABASE mushamumwe_test;
  CREATE USER dashboard_user WITH PASSWORD 'testpass123';
  ALTER ROLE dashboard_user WITH CREATEDB;
  GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE mushamumwe_test TO dashboard_user;
SQL

echo "⚙️  Creating .env..."
cat > .env <<ENV
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://dashboard_user:testpass123@localhost:5432/mushamumwe_test?schema=public"
PORT=4000
JWT_SECRET="$(node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))")"
ENV

echo "📊 Creating database tables..."
npx prisma migrate dev --name init --skip-generate

echo "🔧 Generating Prisma client..."
npm run prisma:generate

echo "🌱 Seeding test data..."
npm run seed

echo ""
echo "✅ Setup complete! Test credentials:"
echo ""
echo "  Nurses:   nurse1 / nurse123"
echo "  Records:  records1 / records123"
echo "  Accounts: accounts1 / accounts123"
echo "  IT/Admin: it1 / it123"
echo ""
echo "🌐 Starting server on http://localhost:4000..."
npm run dev

=================== ./sql/trigger.sql ===================
-- Run this once against the hospital's Postgres database.
-- It fires a NOTIFY every time a row in "Patient" changes,
-- so the dashboard updates instantly even if the change came
-- from the hospital's existing records system, not just this app.

-- IMPORTANT: this payload is what gets broadcast live to every connected
-- dashboard over the LAN. Deliberately excludes name/dob/nationalId so PII
-- never leaves the database, even transiently over the socket connection.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION notify_patient_update() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_notify(
    'patient_updates',
    json_build_object(
      'id', NEW.id,
      'status', NEW.status,
      'wardId', NEW."wardId",
      'updatedAt', NEW."updatedAt"
    )::text
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS patient_update_trigger ON "Patient";

CREATE TRIGGER patient_update_trigger
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON "Patient"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_patient_update();

-- Suggested scoped role for the dashboard app (adjust table name/case to match real schema):
-- CREATE ROLE dashboard_user WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'change_me';
-- GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO dashboard_user;
-- GRANT UPDATE (status, "updatedAt") ON "Patient" TO dashboard_user;
-- GRANT INSERT ON "StatusLog" TO dashboard_user;

=================== ./src/audit.js ===================
// Audit log helper + middleware.
// Every mutating request calls audit() to record what happened.

const prisma = require('./prismaClient');

// ============================================================
// DEVICE TAG — short fingerprint of client (IP + UA prefix)
// ============================================================
function deviceTag(req) {
  const ip = req.clientIp || clientIp(req);
  const ua = (req.headers['user-agent'] || '').slice(0, 40);
  return (ip + '|' + ua).slice(0, 100);
}

function clientIp(req) {
  const fwd = req.headers['x-forwarded-for'];
  if (fwd) return String(fwd).split(',')[0].trim();
  return req.ip || req.socket?.remoteAddress || req.connection?.remoteAddress || 'unknown';
}

// ============================================================
// audit() — fire-and-forget logging (never throws, never blocks)
// ============================================================
async function audit(req, {
  action,
  entity,
  entityId = null,
  summary,
  before = null,
  after = null,
}) {
  try {
    const user = req.user || {};
    await prisma.auditLog.create({
      data: {
        userId:     typeof user.id === 'number' ? user.id : null,
        username:   user.username || 'anonymous',
        fullName:   user.fullName || 'Anonymous',
        department: user.department || 'unknown',
        role:       user.role || 'anonymous',
        action:     String(action || '').slice(0, 50),
        entity:     String(entity || '').slice(0, 50),
        entityId:   entityId != null ? String(entityId).slice(0, 100) : null,
        summary:    String(summary || '').slice(0, 500),
        before:     before ? JSON.stringify(before).slice(0, 4000) : null,
        after:      after  ? JSON.stringify(after).slice(0, 4000)  : null,
        ipAddress:  clientIp(req),
        userAgent:  (req.headers['user-agent'] || '').slice(0, 300),
        deviceTag:  deviceTag(req),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    // Never let audit failure break the actual operation.
    console.error('[audit] failed:', e.message);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// auditLogin() — special-case for login (no req.user yet)
// ============================================================
async function auditLogin(req, user, success = true) {
  try {
    await prisma.auditLog.create({
      data: {
        userId:     typeof user?.id === 'number' ? user.id : null,
        username:   user?.username || 'unknown',
        fullName:   user?.fullName || 'Unknown',
        department: user?.department || 'unknown',
        role:       user?.role || 'unknown',
        action:     success ? 'login' : 'login_failed',
        entity:     'auth',
        entityId:   null,
        summary:    success
          ? (user?.fullName || user?.username || 'Unknown') + ' logged in'
          : 'Failed login attempt for ' + (user?.username || 'unknown'),
        before:     null,
        after:      null,
        ipAddress:  clientIp(req),
        userAgent:  (req.headers['user-agent'] || '').slice(0, 300),
        deviceTag:  deviceTag(req),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[audit] login log failed:', e.message);
  }
}

module.exports = { audit, auditLogin, clientIp, deviceTag };
=================== ./src/auth.js ===================
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');

function normDept(d) {
  if (!d) return '';
  return String(d).trim().toLowerCase();
}

function canonicalDept(d) {
  const s = normDept(d);
  const map = {
    nurses: 'Nurses',
    it: 'IT',
    procurement: 'Procurement',
    stores: 'Stores',
    hr: 'HR',
    superadmin: 'SuperAdmin',
  };
  return map[s] || d;
}

function requireAuth(req, res, next) {
  const header = req.headers.authorization;
  if (!header) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Missing token' });
  const token = header.replace('Bearer ', '');
  try {
    req.user = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
    next();
  } catch {
    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid or expired token' });
  }
}

function requireRole(allowedRoles) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user || !allowedRoles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' });
    }
    next();
  };
}

function requireDepartment(allowedDepartments) {
  const allowed = allowedDepartments.map(normDept);
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Not authenticated' });
    }
    // Super Admin bypasses all department checks
    if (normDept(req.user.department) === 'superadmin') {
      return next();
    }
    if (!allowed.includes(normDept(req.user.department))) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: 'Not authorized. Requires one of: ' + allowedDepartments.join(', '),
      });
    }
    next();
  };
}

// Convenience: is the current user a Super Admin?
function isSuperAdmin(req) {
  return req.user && normDept(req.user.department) === 'superadmin';
}

// Convenience: is the current user IT or Super Admin?
function isITOrSuperAdmin(req) {
  if (!req.user) return false;
  const d = normDept(req.user.department);
  return d === 'it' || d === 'superadmin';
}

module.exports = {
  requireAuth,
  requireRole,
  requireDepartment,
  normDept,
  canonicalDept,
  isSuperAdmin,
  isITOrSuperAdmin,
};

=================== ./src/pgListener.js ===================
const { Client } = require("pg");

// Opens a dedicated, long-lived Postgres connection just for LISTEN.
// Any INSERT/UPDATE on Patient (from this app OR the hospital's existing
// system) fires the trigger in sql/trigger.sql, which lands here.
function startPgListener(io) {
  const client = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

  client.connect().then(() => {
    client.query("LISTEN patient_updates");
    console.log("Listening for patient_updates on Postgres...");
  });

  client.on("notification", (msg) => {
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(msg.payload);
      io.emit("patient:updated", payload);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to parse pg_notify payload:", err);
    }
  });

  client.on("error", (err) => {
    console.error("Postgres listener error, retrying in 5s:", err.message);
    setTimeout(() => startPgListener(io), 5000);
  });
}

module.exports = { startPgListener };

=================== ./src/routes/audit.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, isSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

// ============================================================
// LIST audit log — Super Admin only, filterable, paginated
// ============================================================
router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Super Admin only' });
  }

  try {
    const {
      search, username, department, action, entity,
      from, to, page = 1, pageSize = 100,
    } = req.query;

    const take = Math.min(parseInt(pageSize) || 100, 500);
    const skip = ((parseInt(page) || 1) - 1) * take;

    const where = {};

    if (username)   where.username   = username;
    if (department) where.department = department;
    if (action)     where.action     = action;
    if (entity)     where.entity     = entity;

    if (from || to) {
      where.timestamp = {};
      if (from) where.timestamp.gte = new Date(from);
      if (to) {
        const toDate = new Date(to);
        toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.timestamp.lte = toDate;
      }
    }

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { summary:    { contains: search } },
        { username:   { contains: search } },
        { fullName:   { contains: search } },
        { entityId:   { contains: search } },
        { ipAddress:  { contains: search } },
      ];
    }

    const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.auditLog.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },
        take,
        skip,
      }),
      prisma.auditLog.count({ where }),
    ]);

    res.json({
      rows,
      total,
      page:     parseInt(page) || 1,
      pageSize: take,
      pages:    Math.ceil(total / take) || 1,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// DISTINCT filter values (for dropdowns)
// ============================================================
router.get('/filters', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Super Admin only' });
  }

  try {
    const [actions, entities, users, depts] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.auditLog.findMany({ distinct: ['action'],     select: { action: true } }),
      prisma.auditLog.findMany({ distinct: ['entity'],     select: { entity: true } }),
      prisma.auditLog.findMany({ distinct: ['username'],   select: { username: true, fullName: true } }),
      prisma.auditLog.findMany({ distinct: ['department'], select: { department: true } }),
    ]);

    res.json({
      actions:     actions.map(a => a.action).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      entities:    entities.map(e => e.entity).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      users:       users.filter(u => u.username),
      departments: depts.map(d => d.department).filter(Boolean).sort(),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

=================== ./src/routes/auth.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, isITOrSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');
const { audit, auditLogin } = require('../audit');

const router = express.Router();

// ============================================================
// LOGIN
// ============================================================
router.post('/login', async (req, res) => {
  const { username, password, department } = req.body;

  if (!username || !password) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Username and password required' });
  }

  const saUser = process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME || 'Admin';
  const saHash = process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH || '';

  if (username === saUser && saHash) {
    let superAdminValid = false;
    try {
      superAdminValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, saHash);
    } catch (e) {
      superAdminValid = false;
    }

    if (superAdminValid) {
      const userObj = {
        id: 0,
        username: saUser,
        fullName: 'Super Admin',
        department: 'SuperAdmin',
        role: 'superadmin',
        wardId: null,
      };
      const token = jwt.sign(userObj, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '12h' });
      auditLogin(req, userObj, true);
      return res.json({ token, user: userObj });
    }

    auditLogin(req, { username, fullName: 'Unknown', department: 'unknown', role: 'unknown' }, false);
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid credentials' });
  }

  if (!department || !department.trim()) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Please select a department' });
  }

  const deptNormalized = String(department).trim();

  try {
    const anyUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username } });

    if (!anyUser) {
      auditLogin(req, { username, fullName: 'Unknown', department: deptNormalized, role: 'unknown' }, false);
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid credentials' });
    }

    if (String(anyUser.department).trim().toLowerCase() !== deptNormalized.toLowerCase()) {
      auditLogin(req, {
        id: anyUser.id, username: anyUser.username,
        fullName: anyUser.fullName, department: anyUser.department, role: anyUser.role,
      }, false);
      return res.status(401).json({
        error: 'This username belongs to the ' + anyUser.department +
               ' department. Please select the correct department.'
      });
    }

    const valid = await bcrypt.compare(password, anyUser.passwordHash);
    if (!valid) {
      auditLogin(req, {
        id: anyUser.id, username: anyUser.username,
        fullName: anyUser.fullName, department: anyUser.department, role: anyUser.role,
      }, false);
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid credentials' });
    }

    const token = jwt.sign(
      {
        id: anyUser.id,
        username: anyUser.username,
        fullName: anyUser.fullName,
        department: anyUser.department,
        role: anyUser.role,
        wardId: anyUser.wardId,
      },
      process.env.JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '12h' }
    );

    auditLogin(req, {
      id: anyUser.id, username: anyUser.username,
      fullName: anyUser.fullName, department: anyUser.department, role: anyUser.role,
    }, true);

    res.json({
      token,
      user: {
        id: anyUser.id,
        username: anyUser.username,
        fullName: anyUser.fullName,
        department: anyUser.department,
        role: anyUser.role,
        wardId: anyUser.wardId,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

    });

  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// CHANGE OWN PASSWORD
// ============================================================
router.post('/change-password', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (req.user.department === 'SuperAdmin') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Super Admin password is managed in server configuration' });
  }

  const { currentPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
  if (!currentPassword || !newPassword) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Current and new passwords required' });
  }
  if (newPassword.length < 6) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'New password must be at least 6 characters' });
  }

  try {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: req.user.id } });
    if (!user) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'User not found' });

    const valid = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
    if (!valid) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Current password is incorrect' });

    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { passwordHash: hash } });

    audit(req, {
      action: 'update',
      entity: 'user',
      entityId: user.id,
      summary: 'Changed own password',
    });

    res.json({ message: 'Password updated successfully' });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// CREATE USER (IT or Super Admin only)
// ============================================================
router.post('/admin/create-user', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only IT can create users' });
  }

  const { username, fullName, department, role } = req.body;
  if (!username || !fullName || !department) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'username, fullName, and department are required' });
  }

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username } });
    if (existing) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Username already exists' });

    const tempPassword = crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(tempPassword, 10);
    const user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: { username, passwordHash: hash, fullName, department, role: role || 'staff' },
    });

    audit(req, {
      action: 'create',
      entity: 'user',
      entityId: user.id,
      summary: 'Created user ' + user.username + ' (' + user.department + ')',
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      message: 'User created',
      user: {
        id: user.id, username: user.username, fullName: user.fullName,
        department: user.department, role: user.role,
      },
      tempPassword,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// RESET PASSWORD (IT or Super Admin only)
// ============================================================
router.post('/admin/reset-password', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only IT can reset passwords' });
  }

  const { userId, username } = req.body;
  if (!userId && !username) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'userId or username required' });
  }

  try {
    const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({
      where: userId ? { id: parseInt(userId) } : { username },
    });
    if (!user) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'User not found' });

    const tempPassword = crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
    const hash = await bcrypt.hash(tempPassword, 10);
    await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { passwordHash: hash } });

    audit(req, {
      action: 'update',
      entity: 'user',
      entityId: user.id,
      summary: 'Reset password for ' + user.username,
    });

    res.json({
      message: 'Password reset for ' + user.username,
      user: { id: user.id, username: user.username, fullName: user.fullName },
      tempPassword,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

=================== ./src/routes/disciplinary.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const multer = require('multer');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

const UPLOAD_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'public', 'uploads', 'disciplinary');
const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_FILES_PER_CASE = 5;
const ALLOWED_MIMES = ['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png'];

if (!fs.existsSync(UPLOAD_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(UPLOAD_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  destination: (req, file, cb) => cb(null, UPLOAD_DIR),
  filename: (req, file, cb) => {
    const caseId = req.params.id || 'case';
    const ts = Date.now();
    const rand = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();
    cb(null, 'case-' + caseId + '-' + ts + '-' + rand + ext);
  },
});

const upload = multer({
  storage,
  limits: { fileSize: MAX_FILE_SIZE },
  fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => {
    if (!ALLOWED_MIMES.includes(file.mimetype)) {
      return cb(new Error('Only PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG files allowed'));
    }
    cb(null, true);
  },
});

function requireHRorIT(req, res, next) {
  if (!req.user) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Not authenticated' });
  const dept = String(req.user.department || '').toLowerCase();
  if (dept !== 'hr' && dept !== 'it' && dept !== 'superadmin') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only HR and IT can access labour relations' });
  }
  next();
}

const VALID_STATUSES = ['open', 'under_investigation', 'resolved', 'dismissed'];
const VALID_OFFENSES = [
  'Absenteeism', 'Late arrival', 'Insubordination', 'Negligence', 'Misconduct',
  'Theft', 'Substance abuse', 'Harassment', 'Patient mistreatment',
  'Breach of confidentiality', 'Falsification of records', 'Other',
];
const VALID_ACTIONS = [
  'Verbal warning', 'Written warning', 'Final written warning',
  'Suspension', 'Demotion', 'Termination', 'Reinstatement',
  'No action', 'Counselling', 'Referred to authority',
];

async function generateCaseNumber() {
  const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  const prefix = 'DISC-' + year + '-';
  const latest = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findFirst({
    where: { caseNumber: { startsWith: prefix } },
    orderBy: { caseNumber: 'desc' },
  });

  let nextSeq = 1;
  if (latest) {
    const parts = latest.caseNumber.split('-');
    const lastSeq = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
    if (!isNaN(lastSeq)) nextSeq = lastSeq + 1;
  }

  return prefix + String(nextSeq).padStart(4, '0');
}

// Public summary for Live Board widget.
router.get('/summary-public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    let from, to;
    if (req.query.from) {
      from = new Date(req.query.from);
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else {
      from = new Date();
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (req.query.to) {
      to = new Date(req.query.to);
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else {
      to = new Date();
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    }

    const search = (req.query.search || '').toLowerCase();

    const casesInRange = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findMany({
      where: { reportedDate: { gte: from, lte: to } },
      select: {
        id: true,
        caseNumber: true,
        offenseType: true,
        status: true,
        reportedDate: true,
        description: true,
      },
      orderBy: { reportedDate: 'desc' },
    });

    let filtered = casesInRange;
    if (search) {
      filtered = casesInRange.filter(c =>
        String(c.caseNumber || '').toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
        String(c.offenseType || '').toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
        String(c.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(search)
      );
    }

    const byStatus = { open: 0, under_investigation: 0, resolved: 0, dismissed: 0 };
    filtered.forEach(c => { byStatus[c.status] = (byStatus[c.status] || 0) + 1; });

    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);
    const last30Days = casesInRange.filter(c => new Date(c.reportedDate) >= thirtyDaysAgo).length;

    const recent = filtered.slice(0, 5).map(c => ({
      id: c.id,
      caseNumber: c.caseNumber,
      offenseType: c.offenseType,
      status: c.status,
      reportedDate: c.reportedDate,
    }));

    res.json({
      from: from.toISOString(),
      to: to.toISOString(),
      total: filtered.length,
      byStatus,
      last30Days,
      recent,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// Detail list for a single case status. Public. PII stripped.
router.get('/detail-public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { category } = req.query;

    let from, to;
    if (req.query.from) {
      from = new Date(req.query.from);
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else {
      from = new Date();
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (req.query.to) {
      to = new Date(req.query.to);
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else {
      to = new Date();
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    }

    const validCategories = ['open', 'under_investigation', 'resolved', 'dismissed', 'total'];
    if (!validCategories.includes(category)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid category' });
    }

    const where = { reportedDate: { gte: from, lte: to } };
    if (category !== 'total') {
      where.status = category;
    }

    const cases = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        id: true,
        caseNumber: true,
        offenseType: true,
        status: true,
        reportedDate: true,
        employee: { select: { department: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { reportedDate: 'desc' },
      take: 200,
    });

    res.json(cases);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

    actions: VALID_ACTIONS,
    statuses: VALID_STATUSES,
  });
});

router.get('/', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { search, status, offense, department, from, to } = req.query;

    const where = {};
    if (status && status !== 'all') where.status = status;
    if (offense && offense !== 'all') where.offenseType = offense;

    if (from || to) {
      where.reportedDate = {};
      if (from) where.reportedDate.gte = new Date(from);
      if (to) {
        const toDate = new Date(to);
        toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.reportedDate.lte = toDate;
      }
    }

    if (department && department !== 'all') {
      where.employee = { department };
    }

    if (search) {
      const q = search;
      where.OR = [
        { caseNumber: { contains: q } },
        { offenseType: { contains: q } },
        { description: { contains: q } },
        { reportedBy: { contains: q } },
        { employee: { name: { contains: q } } },
        { employee: { department: { contains: q } } },
      ];
    }

    const cases = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        employee: { select: { id: true, name: true, department: true, role: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json(cases);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/summary', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const all = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findMany({
      select: { status: true, offenseType: true, reportedDate: true },
    });

    const byStatus = { open: 0, under_investigation: 0, resolved: 0, dismissed: 0 };
    all.forEach(c => { byStatus[c.status] = (byStatus[c.status] || 0) + 1; });

    const byOffense = {};
    all.forEach(c => {
      byOffense[c.offenseType] = (byOffense[c.offenseType] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);
    const recentCount = all.filter(c => new Date(c.reportedDate) >= thirtyDaysAgo).length;

    res.json({
      total: all.length,
      byStatus,
      byOffense,
      last30Days: recentCount,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});
