router.post('/', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const { employeeId, offenseType, description, reportedBy, reportedDate, witnesses } = req.body;

  if (!employeeId || !offenseType || !description || !reportedBy || !reportedDate) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      error: 'employeeId, offenseType, description, reportedBy, and reportedDate are required',
    });
  }

  if (!VALID_OFFENSES.includes(offenseType)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid offense type' });
  }

  try {
    const employee = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) } });
    if (!employee) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });

    const caseNumber = await generateCaseNumber();

    const record = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.create({
      data: {
        caseNumber,
        employeeId: parseInt(employeeId),
        offenseType,
        description,
        reportedBy,
        reportedDate: new Date(reportedDate),
        witnesses: witnesses || null,
        status: 'open',
      },
    });

    await prisma.disciplinaryStatusLog.create({
      data: {
        caseId: record.id,
        oldStatus: 'new',
        newStatus: 'open',
        changedBy: req.user.fullName,
        notes: 'Case filed',
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('disciplinary:created', { id: record.id, caseNumber: record.caseNumber });

    res.status(201).json(record);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/:id', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const {
    offenseType, description, reportedBy, reportedDate, witnesses,
    actionTaken, actionDetails, outcome,
    hearingDate, hearingNotes, effectiveDate, durationDays,
  } = req.body;

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });

    if (existing.status === 'resolved' || existing.status === 'dismissed') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Cannot edit a closed case. Reopen it first.' });
    }

    if (offenseType && !VALID_OFFENSES.includes(offenseType)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid offense type' });
    }
    if (actionTaken && !VALID_ACTIONS.includes(actionTaken)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid action type' });
    }

    const updateData = {};
    if (offenseType !== undefined) updateData.offenseType = offenseType;
    if (description !== undefined) updateData.description = description;
    if (reportedBy !== undefined) updateData.reportedBy = reportedBy;
    if (reportedDate !== undefined) updateData.reportedDate = new Date(reportedDate);
    if (witnesses !== undefined) updateData.witnesses = witnesses || null;
    if (actionTaken !== undefined) updateData.actionTaken = actionTaken || null;
    if (actionDetails !== undefined) updateData.actionDetails = actionDetails || null;
    if (outcome !== undefined) updateData.outcome = outcome || null;
    if (hearingDate !== undefined) updateData.hearingDate = hearingDate ? new Date(hearingDate) : null;
    if (hearingNotes !== undefined) updateData.hearingNotes = hearingNotes || null;
    if (effectiveDate !== undefined) updateData.effectiveDate = effectiveDate ? new Date(effectiveDate) : null;
    if (durationDays !== undefined) updateData.durationDays = durationDays ? parseInt(durationDays) : null;

    const updated = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.update({ where: { id }, data: updateData });
    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/:id/status', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const { newStatus, notes } = req.body;

  if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(newStatus)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid status. Allowed: ' + VALID_STATUSES.join(', ') });
  }

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });

    const updateData = { status: newStatus };
    if (newStatus === 'resolved' || newStatus === 'dismissed') {
      updateData.closedBy = req.user.fullName;
      updateData.closedDate = new Date();
    }

    const updated = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.update({ where: { id }, data: updateData });

    await prisma.disciplinaryStatusLog.create({
      data: {
        caseId: id,
        oldStatus: existing.status,
        newStatus,
        changedBy: req.user.fullName,
        notes: notes || null,
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('disciplinary:updated', { id: updated.id, status: updated.status });

    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.post('/:id/reopen', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const { reason, newStatus } = req.body;

  if (!reason) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Reason for reopening is required' });
  }

  const targetStatus = newStatus || 'under_investigation';
  if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(targetStatus)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid target status' });
  }

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });

    if (existing.status !== 'resolved' && existing.status !== 'dismissed') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Only closed cases can be reopened' });
    }

    const updated = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: targetStatus,
        reopenedBy: req.user.fullName,
        reopenedDate: new Date(),
        reopenReason: reason,
        closedBy: null,
        closedDate: null,
      },
    });

    await prisma.disciplinaryStatusLog.create({
      data: {
        caseId: id,
        oldStatus: existing.status,
        newStatus: targetStatus,
        changedBy: req.user.fullName,
        notes: 'Reopened: ' + reason,
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('disciplinary:updated', { id: updated.id, status: updated.status });

    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.post('/:id/attachments', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, upload.array('files', MAX_FILES_PER_CASE), async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.disciplinaryCase.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { attachments: true },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      (req.files || []).forEach(f => {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(f.path); } catch (e) {}
      });
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Case not found' });
    }

    const currentCount = existing.attachments.length;
    const incoming = (req.files || []).length;

    if (currentCount + incoming > MAX_FILES_PER_CASE) {
      (req.files || []).forEach(f => {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(f.path); } catch (e) {}
      });
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Maximum ' + MAX_FILES_PER_CASE + ' attachments per case (has ' + currentCount + ', tried to add ' + incoming + ')',
      });
    }

    const created = [];
    for (const file of (req.files || [])) {
      const att = await prisma.disciplinaryAttachment.create({
        data: {
          caseId: id,
          originalName: file.originalname,
          storedName: file.filename,
          mimeType: file.mimetype,
          sizeBytes: file.size,
          uploadedBy: req.user.fullName,
        },
      });
      created.push(att);
    }

    res.status(201).json({ message: 'Uploaded ' + created.length + ' file(s)', attachments: created });
  } catch (e) {
    (req.files || []).forEach(f => {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(f.path); } catch (err) {}
    });
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/:id/attachments/:attachmentId', async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const attachmentId = parseInt(req.params.attachmentId);

  try {
    const att = await prisma.disciplinaryAttachment.findFirst({
      where: { id: attachmentId, caseId: id },
    });
    if (!att) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Attachment not found' });

    const filePath = path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, att.storedName);
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'File missing on disk' });
    }

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', att.mimeType);
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', 'inline; filename="' + att.originalName + '"');
    fs.createReadStream(filePath).pipe(res);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.delete('/:id/attachments/:attachmentId', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const attachmentId = parseInt(req.params.attachmentId);

  try {
    const att = await prisma.disciplinaryAttachment.findFirst({
      where: { id: attachmentId, caseId: id },
    });
    if (!att) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Attachment not found' });

    const filePath = path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, att.storedName);
    if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (e) {}
    }

    await prisma.disciplinaryAttachment.delete({ where: { id: attachmentId } });

    res.json({ message: 'Attachment deleted' });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;

const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, isSuperAdmin, isITOrSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

// ============================================================
// LIST employees with filters
// ============================================================
router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req) && req.user.department !== 'HR') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  }
  try {
    const { search, department, status, role, from, to } = req.query;
    const where = {};

    if (department && department !== 'all') where.department = department;
    if (status && status !== 'all') where.status = status;
    if (role && role !== 'all') where.role = role;
    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: search } },
        { department: { contains: search } },
        { role: { contains: search } },
      ];
    }
    if (from) where.hireDate = { gte: new Date(from) };
    if (to) {
      const toDate = new Date(to); toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      where.hireDate = { ...(where.hireDate || {}), lte: toDate };
    }

    const employees = await prisma.employee.findMany({
      where,
      include: { ward: true, statusLogs: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' }, take: 1 } },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
    res.json(employees);
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

// ============================================================
// PUBLIC SUMMARY - for the Live Board
// ============================================================
router.get('/summary', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const counts = await prisma.employee.groupBy({ by: ['status'], _count: true });
    const summary = {
      active: counts.find(c => c.status === 'active')?._count || 0,
      on_leave: counts.find(c => c.status === 'on_leave')?._count || 0,
      sick: counts.find(c => c.status === 'sick')?._count || 0,
      terminated: counts.find(c => c.status === 'terminated')?._count || 0,
      total: counts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c._count, 0),
    };
    const byDept = await prisma.employee.groupBy({
      by: ['department'], _count: true, where: { status: { not: 'terminated' } },
    });
    summary.byDepartment = byDept.map(d => ({ department: d.department, count: d._count }));
    res.json(summary);
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req) && req.user.department !== 'HR') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  }
  const { id } = req.params;
  const { status } = req.body;

  try {
    const employee = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(id) } });
    if (!employee) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });

    const oldStatus = employee.status;
    const updateData = { status };
    if (status === 'terminated') updateData.terminationDate = new Date();

    const updated = await prisma.employee.update({
      where: { id: parseInt(id) }, data: updateData, include: { ward: true },
    });
    await prisma.employeeStatusLog.create({
      data: { employeeId: parseInt(id), oldStatus, newStatus: status, changedBy: req.user.fullName },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('employee:updated', { id: updated.id, name: updated.name, status: updated.status });
    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req) && req.user.department !== 'HR') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  }
  const { id } = req.params;
  try {
    const employee = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(id) } });
    if (!employee) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });

    const updated = await prisma.employee.update({
      where: { id: parseInt(id) },
      data: { status: 'terminated', terminationDate: new Date() },
    });
    await prisma.employeeStatusLog.create({
      data: { employeeId: parseInt(id), oldStatus: employee.status, newStatus: 'terminated', changedBy: req.user.fullName },
    });
    res.json({ message: 'Employee terminated', employee: updated });
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

=================== ./src/routes/establishment.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

function requireHRorIT(req, res, next) {
  if (!req.user) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Not authenticated' });
  const dept = String(req.user.department || '').toLowerCase();
  if (dept !== 'hr' && dept !== 'it' && dept !== 'superadmin') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only HR and IT can access establishment' });
  }
  next();
}

const MOVEMENT_TYPES = ['transfer', 'retirement', 'resignation'];
const RESIGNATION_REASONS = [
  'Better opportunity elsewhere',
  'Relocation',
  'Health reasons',
  'Family reasons',
  'Further studies',
  'Salary dissatisfaction',
  'Retirement',
  'Other',
];

function calcYearsOfService(hireDate, endDate) {
  if (!hireDate || !endDate) return null;
  const years = (new Date(endDate) - new Date(hireDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 365.25);
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(years));
}

router.get('/movements', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { search, type, department, from, to } = req.query;

    const where = {};
    if (type && type !== 'all') where.movementType = type;

    if (department && department !== 'all') {
      where.OR = [
        { fromDepartment: department },
        { toDepartment: department },
      ];
    }

    if (from || to) {
      where.effectiveDate = {};
      if (from) where.effectiveDate.gte = new Date(from);
      if (to) {
        const toDate = new Date(to);
        toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.effectiveDate.lte = toDate;
      }
    }

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { employee: { name: { contains: search } } },
        { fromDepartment: { contains: search } },
        { toDepartment: { contains: search } },
        { reason: { contains: search } },
        { notes: { contains: search } },
      ];
    }

    const movements = await prisma.employeeMovement.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        employee: { select: { id: true, name: true, department: true, role: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json(movements);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/movements/:id', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
    const movement = await prisma.employeeMovement.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        employee: { select: { id: true, name: true, department: true, role: true, hireDate: true, status: true } },
      },
    });
    if (!movement) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Movement not found' });
    res.json(movement);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.post('/transfer', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const { employeeId, toDepartment, toWardId, effectiveDate, reason, approvedBy, notes } = req.body;

  if (!employeeId || !toDepartment || !effectiveDate) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'employeeId, toDepartment, and effectiveDate are required' });
  }

  try {
    const employee = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) } });
    if (!employee) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });

    const movement = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const m = await tx.employeeMovement.create({
        data: {
          employeeId: parseInt(employeeId),
          movementType: 'transfer',
          fromDepartment: employee.department,
          fromWardId: employee.wardId,
          toDepartment,
          toWardId: toWardId ? parseInt(toWardId) : null,
          effectiveDate: new Date(effectiveDate),
          reason: reason || 'Transfer',
          approvedBy: approvedBy || req.user.fullName,
          notes: notes || null,
        },
      });

      await tx.employee.update({
        where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) },
        data: {
          department: toDepartment,
          wardId: toWardId ? parseInt(toWardId) : null,
        },
      });

      return m;
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('employee:updated', { id: employee.id, name: employee.name });
    req.app.locals.emit('establishment:updated', { id: movement.id, type: 'transfer' });

    res.status(201).json(movement);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.post('/retirement', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const { employeeId, plannedDate, actualDate, pensionNotes, notes, approvedBy } = req.body;

  if (!employeeId) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'employeeId is required' });
  }

  try {
    const employee = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) } });
    if (!employee) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });

    const endDate = actualDate ? new Date(actualDate) : (plannedDate ? new Date(plannedDate) : new Date());
    const yearsOfService = calcYearsOfService(employee.hireDate, endDate);

    const movement = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const m = await tx.employeeMovement.create({
        data: {
          employeeId: parseInt(employeeId),
          movementType: 'retirement',
          plannedDate: plannedDate ? new Date(plannedDate) : null,
          actualDate: actualDate ? new Date(actualDate) : null,
          yearsOfService,
          pensionNotes: pensionNotes || null,
          effectiveDate: actualDate ? new Date(actualDate) : null,
          notes: notes || null,
          approvedBy: approvedBy || req.user.fullName,
        },
      });

      if (actualDate) {
        await tx.employee.update({
          where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) },
          data: {
            status: 'retired',
            terminationDate: new Date(actualDate),
          },
        });
      }

      return m;
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('employee:updated', { id: employee.id, name: employee.name });
    req.app.locals.emit('establishment:updated', { id: movement.id, type: 'retirement' });

    res.status(201).json(movement);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.post('/resignation', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const {
    employeeId, resignationDate, lastWorkingDay,
    noticePeriodDays, reason, exitInterviewDone, eligibleForRehire,
    notes, approvedBy,
  } = req.body;

  if (!employeeId || !resignationDate || !lastWorkingDay) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'employeeId, resignationDate, and lastWorkingDay are required' });
  }

  try {
    const employee = await prisma.employee.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) } });
    if (!employee) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Employee not found' });

    const movement = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const m = await tx.employeeMovement.create({
        data: {
          employeeId: parseInt(employeeId),
          movementType: 'resignation',
          resignationDate: new Date(resignationDate),
          lastWorkingDay: new Date(lastWorkingDay),
          noticePeriodDays: noticePeriodDays ? parseInt(noticePeriodDays) : null,
          reason: reason || null,
          exitInterviewDone: exitInterviewDone === true || exitInterviewDone === 'true',
          eligibleForRehire: eligibleForRehire === true || eligibleForRehire === 'true',
          effectiveDate: new Date(lastWorkingDay),
          notes: notes || null,
          approvedBy: approvedBy || req.user.fullName,
        },
      });

      if (new Date(lastWorkingDay) <= new Date()) {
        await tx.employee.update({
          where: { id: parseInt(employeeId) },
          data: {
            status: 'resigned',
            terminationDate: new Date(lastWorkingDay),
          },
        });
      }

      return m;
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('employee:updated', { id: employee.id, name: employee.name });
    req.app.locals.emit('establishment:updated', { id: movement.id, type: 'resignation' });

    res.status(201).json(movement);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/movements/:id', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const { notes, plannedDate, actualDate, pensionNotes } = req.body;

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.employeeMovement.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Movement not found' });

    const updateData = {};
    if (notes !== undefined) updateData.notes = notes;
    if (plannedDate !== undefined) updateData.plannedDate = plannedDate ? new Date(plannedDate) : null;
    if (actualDate !== undefined) updateData.actualDate = actualDate ? new Date(actualDate) : null;
    if (pensionNotes !== undefined) updateData.pensionNotes = pensionNotes;

    const updated = await prisma.employeeMovement.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateData,
    });

    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

      byType,
    });

  }
});

router.get('/headcount', requireAuth, requireHRorIT, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const departments = await prisma.employee.groupBy({
      by: ['department'],
      _count: true,
      where: { status: { in: ['active', 'on_leave', 'sick'] } },
    });

    const targets = await prisma.establishmentTarget.findMany();

    const map = {};
    departments.forEach(d => {
      map[d.department] = { department: d.department, current: d._count };
    });

    targets.forEach(t => {
      if (!map[t.department]) {
        map[t.department] = { department: t.department, current: 0 };
      }
      map[t.department].min = t.minHeadcount;
      map[t.department].max = t.maxHeadcount;
    });

    const list = Object.values(map).map(d => {
      let status = 'no_target';
      if (d.min !== undefined) {
        if (d.current < d.min) status = 'understaffed';
        else if (d.max && d.current > d.max) status = 'overstaffed';
        else status = 'adequate';
      }
      return { ...d, status };
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => a.department.localeCompare(b.department));

    res.json(list);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// Public summary for Live Board widget.
router.get('/summary-public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    let from, to;
    if (req.query.from) {
      from = new Date(req.query.from);
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else {
      from = new Date();
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (req.query.to) {
      to = new Date(req.query.to);
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else {
      to = new Date();
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    }

    const inRange = await prisma.employeeMovement.findMany({
      where: { createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },
      select: { movementType: true },
    });

    const byType = { transfer: 0, retirement: 0, resignation: 0 };
    inRange.forEach(m => { byType[m.movementType] = (byType[m.movementType] || 0) + 1; });

    const departments = await prisma.employee.groupBy({
      by: ['department'],
      _count: true,
      where: { status: { in: ['active', 'on_leave', 'sick'] } },
    });

    const targets = await prisma.establishmentTarget.findMany();
    const currentMap = {};
    departments.forEach(d => { currentMap[d.department] = d._count; });

    let understaffed = 0;
    let overstaffed = 0;
    targets.forEach(t => {
      const cur = currentMap[t.department] || 0;
      if (cur < t.minHeadcount) understaffed++;
      else if (t.maxHeadcount && cur > t.maxHeadcount) overstaffed++;
    });

    res.json({
      from: from.toISOString(),
      to: to.toISOString(),
      transfers: byType.transfer,
      retirements: byType.retirement,
      resignations: byType.resignation,
      total: inRange.length,
      understaffed,
      overstaffed,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// Detail list for establishment widgets. Public. PII stripped.
router.get('/detail-public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { category } = req.query;

    let from, to;
    if (req.query.from) {
      from = new Date(req.query.from);
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else {
      from = new Date();
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (req.query.to) {
      to = new Date(req.query.to);
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else {
      to = new Date();
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    }

    const validCategories = ['transfer', 'retirement', 'resignation', 'understaffed', 'overstaffed'];
    if (!validCategories.includes(category)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid category' });
    }

    if (category === 'understaffed' || category === 'overstaffed') {
      const departments = await prisma.employee.groupBy({
        by: ['department'],
        _count: true,
        where: { status: { in: ['active', 'on_leave', 'sick'] } },
      });

      const targets = await prisma.establishmentTarget.findMany();

      const currentMap = {};
      departments.forEach(d => { currentMap[d.department] = d._count; });

      const list = targets
        .map(t => ({
          department: t.department,
          current: currentMap[t.department] || 0,
          min: t.minHeadcount,
          max: t.maxHeadcount,
        }))
        .filter(d => {
          if (category === 'understaffed') return d.current < d.min;
          if (category === 'overstaffed') return d.max && d.current > d.max;
          return false;
        });

      return res.json(list);
    }

    const movements = await prisma.employeeMovement.findMany({
      where: {
        movementType: category,
        createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to },
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        movementType: true,
        fromDepartment: true,
        toDepartment: true,
        reason: true,
        effectiveDate: true,
        createdAt: true,
        employee: { select: { department: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 200,
    });

    res.json(movements);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, isSuperAdmin, isITOrSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

// ============================================================
// LIST inventory
// ============================================================
router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { search, category, from, to, lowStock } = req.query;
    const where = {};

    if (category && category !== 'all') where.category = category;
    if (search) where.name = { contains: search };
    if (lowStock === 'true') where.quantity = { lt: 10 };
    if (from || to) {
      where.lastReceived = {};
      if (from) where.lastReceived.gte = new Date(from);
      if (to) {
        const toDate = new Date(to); toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.lastReceived.lte = toDate;
      }
    }

    const items = await prisma.inventoryItem.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      include: { itemReceives: { orderBy: { receivedAt: 'desc' }, take: 3 } },
    });
    res.json(items);
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

// SUMMARY
// ============================================================
router.get('/summary', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const items = await prisma.inventoryItem.findMany({ select: { name: true, quantity: true, unit: true } });
    const critical = items.filter(i => i.quantity < 10).length;
    const low = items.filter(i => i.quantity >= 10 && i.quantity < 50).length;
    const adequate = items.filter(i => i.quantity >= 50).length;
    res.json({ totalItems: items.length, critical, low, adequate, items });
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

router.post('/receive', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req) && req.user.department !== 'Stores') {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only Stores can receive items' });
  }

  const { procurementOrderId, orderRequestId, itemName, quantityReceived, notes } = req.body;
  if (!itemName || !quantityReceived) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'itemName and quantityReceived required' });
  }

  try {
    let procOrder = null;
    if (procurementOrderId) {
      procOrder = await prisma.procurementOrder.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(procurementOrderId) } });
    } else if (orderRequestId) {
      procOrder = await prisma.procurementOrder.findUnique({ where: { orderRequestId: parseInt(orderRequestId) } });
    }
    if (!procOrder) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Procurement order not found' });

    let inventoryItem = await prisma.inventoryItem.findUnique({ where: { name: itemName } });
    if (!inventoryItem) {
      inventoryItem = await prisma.inventoryItem.create({
        data: { name: itemName, quantity: 0, unit: 'units' },
      });
    }

    const updated = await prisma.inventoryItem.update({
      where: { id: inventoryItem.id },
      data: { quantity: inventoryItem.quantity + parseInt(quantityReceived), lastReceived: new Date() },
    });

    const itemReceive = await prisma.itemReceive.create({
      data: {
        procurementOrderId: procOrder.id, inventoryItemId: inventoryItem.id,
        quantityReceived: parseInt(quantityReceived), receivedBy: req.user.fullName, notes: notes || '',
      },
    });

    const orderRequest = await prisma.orderRequest.findUnique({ where: { id: procOrder.orderRequestId } });
    if (orderRequest && orderRequest.status !== 'received') {
      await prisma.orderRequest.update({ where: { id: orderRequest.id }, data: { status: 'received' } });
      await prisma.orderRequestStatusLog.create({
        data: {
          orderRequestId: orderRequest.id, oldStatus: orderRequest.status, newStatus: 'received',
          changedBy: req.user.fullName,
          notes: 'Received ' + itemName + ' x' + quantityReceived,
        },
      });
      req.app.locals.emit('order:updated', { id: orderRequest.id, status: 'received', department: orderRequest.requestingDepartment });
    }

    req.app.locals.emit('inventory:updated', { itemId: updated.id, name: updated.name, quantity: updated.quantity });
    res.json({ message: 'Items received', itemReceive, inventoryItem: updated });
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

});

=================== ./src/routes/orders.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, canonicalDept, isITOrSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

function parseRange(query) {
  let from, to;

  if (query.from) {
    from = new Date(query.from);
    from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  } else {
    from = new Date();
    from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  }

  if (query.to) {
    to = new Date(query.to);
    to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  } else {
    to = new Date();
    to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  }

  return { from, to };
}

router.post('/request', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  const { itemName, quantity, reason, urgency, category, originatorDepartment } = req.body;
  if (!itemName || !quantity || !reason) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'itemName, quantity, and reason are required' });
  }

  try {
    const submitterDept = canonicalDept(req.user.department);
    const originatorDept = originatorDepartment
      ? canonicalDept(originatorDepartment)
      : submitterDept;

    const orderRequest = await prisma.orderRequest.create({
      data: {
        requestingDepartment: submitterDept,
        originatorDepartment: originatorDept,
        requestingBy: req.user.fullName,
        itemName,
        quantity: parseInt(quantity),
        reason,
        status: 'pending',
        urgency: urgency || 'normal',
        category: category || null,
      },
    });

    await prisma.orderRequestStatusLog.create({
      data: {
        orderRequestId: orderRequest.id,
        oldStatus: 'created',
        newStatus: 'pending',
        changedBy: req.user.fullName,
        notes: submitterDept === originatorDept
          ? 'Order request created'
          : 'Created by ' + submitterDept + ' for ' + originatorDept,
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('order:created', {
      id: orderRequest.id,
      department: orderRequest.requestingDepartment,
      originator: orderRequest.originatorDepartment,
      itemName: orderRequest.itemName,
    });

    res.status(201).json(orderRequest);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/requests', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const where = {};
    if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req) && req.user.department !== 'Procurement') {
      where.requestingDepartment = req.user.department;
    }
    const requests = await prisma.orderRequest.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        statusLogs: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' } },
        procurementOrder: { include: { itemReceives: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
    res.json(requests);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/my', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const myDept = String(req.headers['x-acting-dept'] || req.user.department || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const all = await prisma.orderRequest.findMany({
      include: {
        statusLogs: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' } },
        procurementOrder: { include: { itemReceives: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
    const mine = all.filter(r => {
      const submitter = String(r.requestingDepartment || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const originator = String(r.originatorDepartment || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      return submitter === myDept || originator === myDept;
    });
    res.json(mine);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/history', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (req.user.department !== 'Procurement' && !isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only Procurement can view tender history' });
  }
  try {
    const { search, status, department, from, to } = req.query;

    const where = {};

    if (status && status !== 'all') {
      if (status === 'received') {
        where.status = { in: ['received', 'in_storage'] };
      } else {
        where.status = status;
      }
    }

    if (department && department !== 'all') {
      where.OR = [
        { requestingDepartment: department },
        { originatorDepartment: department },
      ];
    }

    if (from || to) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (from) where.createdAt.gte = new Date(from);
      if (to) {
        const toDate = new Date(to);
        toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.createdAt.lte = toDate;
      }
    }

    let filtered = await prisma.orderRequest.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        statusLogs: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' } },
        procurementOrder: { include: { itemReceives: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(r =>
        String(r.itemName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.requestingBy || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.requestingDepartment || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.originatorDepartment || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.reason || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.id) === q
      );
    }

    res.json(filtered);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/history/summary', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (req.user.department !== 'Procurement' && !isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only Procurement can view tender history' });
  }
  try {
    const all = await prisma.orderRequest.findMany({
      select: { status: true, requestingDepartment: true, originatorDepartment: true, createdAt: true },
    });
    const statuses = ['pending', 'awaiting_quotation', 'ordered', 'received', 'in_storage'];
    const byStatus = {};
    statuses.forEach(s => byStatus[s] = 0);
    all.forEach(r => { byStatus[r.status] = (byStatus[r.status] || 0) + 1; });

    const byDept = {};
    all.forEach(r => {
      const d = r.originatorDepartment || r.requestingDepartment || 'Unknown';
      byDept[d] = (byDept[d] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);
    const recent = all.filter(r => new Date(r.createdAt) >= thirtyDaysAgo).length;

    res.json({ total: all.length, byStatus, byDepartment: byDept, last30Days: recent });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/requests/:id/approve', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (req.user.department !== 'Procurement' && !isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only Procurement can approve' });
  }
  const { supplierName, expectedDeliveryDate, approvalNotes } = req.body;

  try {
    const request = await prisma.orderRequest.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(req.params.id) } });
    if (!request) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Request not found' });
    if (!['pending', 'awaiting_quotation'].includes(request.status)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Cannot approve request in status ' + request.status });
    }
    if (!supplierName) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Supplier name is required' });

    const updated = await prisma.orderRequest.update({
      where: { id: request.id },
      data: { status: 'ordered' },
    });

    await prisma.orderRequestStatusLog.create({
      data: {
        orderRequestId: request.id,
        oldStatus: request.status,
        newStatus: 'ordered',
        changedBy: req.user.fullName,
        notes: 'Approved and sent. Supplier: ' + supplierName,
      },
    });

    const existingPO = await prisma.procurementOrder.findUnique({ where: { orderRequestId: request.id } });
    const poData = {
      supplierName,
      expectedDeliveryDate: expectedDeliveryDate ? new Date(expectedDeliveryDate) : null,
      approvalNotes: approvalNotes || null,
      status: 'ordered',
    };

    if (!existingPO) {
      await prisma.procurementOrder.create({
        data: { orderRequestId: request.id, ...poData },
      });
    } else {
      await prisma.procurementOrder.update({
        where: { id: existingPO.id },
        data: poData,
      });
    }

    req.app.locals.emit('order:updated', {
      id: updated.id,
      status: 'ordered',
      department: updated.requestingDepartment,
      originator: updated.originatorDepartment,
    });

    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/requests/:id/await-quotation', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (req.user.department !== 'Procurement' && !isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only Procurement can mark awaiting quotation' });
  }
  const { note } = req.body;

  try {
    const request = await prisma.orderRequest.findUnique({ where: { id: parseInt(req.params.id) } });
    if (!request) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Request not found' });
    if (request.status === 'ordered' || request.status === 'received') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Cannot pause a tender already ' + request.status });
    }

    const updated = await prisma.orderRequest.update({
      where: { id: request.id },
      data: { status: 'awaiting_quotation' },
    });

    await prisma.orderRequestStatusLog.create({
      data: {
        orderRequestId: request.id,
        oldStatus: request.status,
        newStatus: 'awaiting_quotation',
        changedBy: req.user.fullName,
        notes: note ? 'Waiting for quotation: ' + note : 'Waiting for quotation from supplier',
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('order:updated', {
      id: updated.id,
      status: 'awaiting_quotation',
      department: updated.requestingDepartment,
      originator: updated.originatorDepartment,
    });

    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

      ordered: counts.ordered,
      received: counts.received + counts.in_storage,

  } catch (e) {

  }
});

    });
    const awaitingQuotation = await prisma.orderRequest.count({
      where: { status: 'awaiting_quotation', createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },
    });
    const ordered = await prisma.orderRequest.count({
      where: { status: 'ordered', createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },
    });
    const received = await prisma.orderRequest.count({
      where: { status: { in: ['received', 'in_storage'] }, createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },
    });

    res.json({
      from: from.toISOString(),
      to: to.toISOString(),
      pending,
      awaitingQuotation,
      ordered,
      received,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

  try {
    const { category } = req.query;
    const { from, to } = parseRange(req.query);

    const validCategories = ['pending', 'awaiting_quotation', 'ordered', 'received'];
    if (!validCategories.includes(category)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid category' });
    }

    let statuses = [category];
    if (category === 'received') {
      statuses = ['received', 'in_storage'];
    }

    const tenders = await prisma.orderRequest.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: statuses },
        createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to },
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        itemName: true,
        quantity: true,
        requestingDepartment: true,
        originatorDepartment: true,
        status: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 200,
    });

    res.json(tenders);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

=================== ./src/routes/patients.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, requireDepartment, isSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

const VALID_STATUSES = ['admitted', 'treatment', 'in_treatment', 'discharged', 'deceased'];

function normalizeStatus(s) {
  if (s === 'in_treatment') return 'treatment';
  return s;
}

function parseRange(query) {
  let from, to;

  if (query.from) {
    from = new Date(query.from + 'T00:00:00');
  } else {
    from = new Date();
    from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  }

  if (query.to) {
    to = new Date(query.to + 'T23:59:59.999');
  } else {
    to = new Date();
    to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  }

  return { from, to };
}

router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { search, status, ward, diagnosis, from, to } = req.query;
    const where = {};

    if (status && status !== 'all') where.status = normalizeStatus(status);
    if (ward && ward !== 'all') where.wardId = Number(ward);
    if (diagnosis) where.diagnosis = { contains: diagnosis };
    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: search } },
        { nationalId: { contains: search } },
        { phone: { contains: search } },
        { diagnosis: { contains: search } },
        { symptoms: { contains: search } },
        { causeOfDeath: { contains: search } },
      ];
    }
    if (from) where.admissionDate = { gte: new Date(from) };
    if (to) {
      const toDate = new Date(to);
      toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      where.admissionDate = { ...(where.admissionDate || {}), lte: toDate };
    }

    const patients = await prisma.patient.findMany({
      where,
      include: { ward: true },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
    });
    res.json(patients);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

        ward: { select: { name: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
    });
    res.json(patients);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/summary', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const statuses = ['admitted', 'treatment', 'discharged', 'deceased'];
    const counts = {};
    for (const s of statuses) {
      counts[s] = await prisma.patient.count({ where: { status: s } });
    }
    const total = Object.values(counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const percentages = {};
    for (const s of statuses) {
      percentages[s] = total === 0 ? 0 : +((counts[s] / total) * 100).toFixed(1);
    }
    res.json({ counts, percentages, total });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

      from: from.toISOString(),
      to: to.toISOString(),
      admittedToday: admittedCount,
      dischargedToday: dischargedCount,
      followUpsDueToday: followUpsCount,
      deathsToday: deathsCount,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/detail-public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { category } = req.query;
    const { from, to } = parseRange(req.query);

    const validCategories = ['admitted', 'treatment', 'discharged', 'deceased', 'followups'];
    if (!validCategories.includes(category)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid category' });
    }

    let where = {};
    if (category === 'admitted') {
      where = { status: 'admitted' };
    } else if (category === 'treatment') {
      where = { status: 'treatment' };
    } else if (category === 'discharged') {
      where = {
        status: 'discharged',
        dischargeDate: { gte: from, lte: to },
      };
    } else if (category === 'deceased') {
      where = {
        status: 'deceased',
        updatedAt: { gte: from, lte: to },
      };
    } else if (category === 'followups') {
      where = {
        nextReviewDate: { gte: from, lte: to },
      };
    }

    const patients = await prisma.patient.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        id: true,
        status: true,
        updatedAt: true,
        ward: { select: { name: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
      take: 200,
    });

    res.json(patients);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/discharges', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { search, outcome, ward, from, to, reviewFrom, reviewTo } = req.query;
    const where = { status: 'discharged' };

    if (outcome && outcome !== 'all') where.outcome = outcome;
    if (ward && ward !== 'all') where.wardId = Number(ward);
    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: search } },
        { nationalId: { contains: search } },
        { finalDiagnosis: { contains: search } },
        { diagnosis: { contains: search } },
      ];
    }
    if (from) where.dischargeDate = { gte: new Date(from) };
    if (reviewFrom && reviewFrom.trim() !== '') where.nextReviewDate = { gte: new Date(reviewFrom) };
    if (to) {
      const toDate = new Date(to);
      toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      where.dischargeDate = { ...(where.dischargeDate || {}), lte: toDate };
    }
    if (reviewTo && reviewTo.trim() !== '') {
      const rToDate = new Date(reviewTo); rToDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      where.nextReviewDate = { ...(where.nextReviewDate || {}), lte: rToDate };
    }

    const records = await prisma.patient.findMany({
      where,
      include: { ward: true },
      orderBy: { dischargeDate: 'desc' },
    });
    res.json(records);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});



router.post('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req) && !['nurses', 'it'].includes(String(req.user.department).toLowerCase())) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Not authorized' });
  }

  const { name, nationalId, wardId, status, gender, diagnosis, symptoms, phone, bloodGroup } = req.body;
  if (!name) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Name is required' });

  const finalStatus = normalizeStatus(status || 'admitted');
  if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(finalStatus)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid status' });
  }

  try {
    const patient = await prisma.patient.create({
      data: {
        name,
        nationalId: nationalId || undefined,
        gender: gender || undefined,
        wardId: wardId ? parseInt(wardId) : undefined,
        status: finalStatus,
        diagnosis: diagnosis || undefined,
        symptoms: symptoms || undefined,
        phone: phone || undefined,
        bloodGroup: bloodGroup || undefined,
      },
      include: { ward: true },
    });

    await prisma.statusLog.create({
      data: {
        patientId: patient.id,
        oldStatus: 'new',
        newStatus: patient.status,
        changedBy: req.user.username,
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('patient:created', { id: patient.id, status: patient.status });
    res.status(201).json(patient);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/:id/status', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req) && !['nurses', 'it'].includes(String(req.user.department).toLowerCase())) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Not authorized' });
  }

  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  const raw = req.body.status || req.body.newStatus;
  const newStatus = normalizeStatus(raw);
  const { causeOfDeath } = req.body;

  if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(newStatus)) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid status. Allowed: ' + VALID_STATUSES.join(', ') });
  }

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.patient.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Patient not found' });

    const updateData = { status: newStatus };
    if (newStatus === 'deceased' && causeOfDeath) updateData.causeOfDeath = causeOfDeath;

    const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const p = await tx.patient.update({
        where: { id },
        data: updateData,
        include: { ward: true },
      });
      await tx.statusLog.create({
        data: { patientId: id, oldStatus: existing.status, newStatus, changedBy: req.user.username },
      });
      return p;
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('patient:updated', { id: updated.id, status: updated.status });
    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.patch('/:id/discharge', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req) && !['nurses', 'it'].includes(String(req.user.department).toLowerCase())) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Not authorized' });
  }

  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  const {
    finalDiagnosis, treatmentSummary, outcome, dischargeNotes,
    nextReviewDate, reviewDepartment, patientInstructions,
  } = req.body;

  if (!finalDiagnosis) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Final diagnosis is required' });
  }

  try {
    const existing = await prisma.patient.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Patient not found' });
    if (existing.status === 'discharged') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Patient already discharged' });
    }

    const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const p = await tx.patient.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          status: 'discharged',
          finalDiagnosis,
          treatmentSummary: treatmentSummary || null,
          outcome: outcome || 'Recovered',
          dischargeNotes: dischargeNotes || null,
          dischargeDate: new Date(),
          dischargedBy: req.user.fullName,
          nextReviewDate: nextReviewDate ? new Date(nextReviewDate) : null,
          reviewDepartment: reviewDepartment || null,
          patientInstructions: patientInstructions || null,
        },
        include: { ward: true },
      });
      await tx.statusLog.create({
        data: { patientId: id, oldStatus: existing.status, newStatus: 'discharged', changedBy: req.user.username },
      });
      return p;
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('patient:updated', { id: updated.id, status: 'discharged' });
    res.json(updated);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

  try {
    const patient = await prisma.patient.findUnique({
      where: { id: Number(req.params.id) },
      include: { ward: true, statusLogs: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' } } },
    });

    res.json(patient);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

=================== ./src/routes/projects.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, canonicalDept, isITOrSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

const VALID_STATUSES = ['ongoing', 'pending', 'completed'];

// Status rules:
// ongoing   - note required (what's happening)
// pending   - note and obstacleReason required
// completed - note required
function validateStatusUpdate(status, note, obstacleReason) {
  if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
    return 'Invalid status. Allowed: ' + VALID_STATUSES.join(', ');
  }
  if (!note || !note.trim()) {
    return 'A note describing the current state is required';
  }
  if (status === 'pending' && (!obstacleReason || !obstacleReason.trim())) {
    return 'Obstacle reason is required when status is pending';
  }
  return null;
}

router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { search, status, department, scope } = req.query;

    const where = {};
    if (status && status !== 'all') where.status = status;

    if (scope === 'own') {
      where.department = canonicalDept(req.user.department);
    } else if (department && department !== 'all') {
      where.department = canonicalDept(department);
    }

    let projects = await prisma.project.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        updates: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' }, take: 3 },
      },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      projects = projects.filter(p =>
        String(p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(p.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(p.projectHead || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(p.department || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }

    res.json(projects);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.get('/summary', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const all = await prisma.project.findMany({
      select: { status: true, department: true, updatedAt: true },
    });

    const byStatus = { ongoing: 0, pending: 0, completed: 0 };
    all.forEach(p => { byStatus[p.status] = (byStatus[p.status] || 0) + 1; });

    const byDept = {};
    all.forEach(p => {
      byDept[p.department] = (byDept[p.department] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);
    const recent = all.filter(p => new Date(p.updatedAt) >= thirtyDaysAgo).length;

    res.json({
      total: all.length,
      byStatus,
      byDepartment: byDept,
      last30Days: recent,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// Public summary for Live Board widget. No auth.
// byStatus is global. recent returns 10 most recently updated with obstacle reasons.
// blocked returns all pending projects with their obstacle reasons.
router.get('/summary-public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    let from, to;
    if (req.query.from) {
      from = new Date(req.query.from);
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else {
      from = new Date();
      from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    if (req.query.to) {
      to = new Date(req.query.to);
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else {
      to = new Date();
      to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    }

    const recentProjects = await prisma.project.findMany({
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        status: true,
        department: true,
        projectHead: true,
        obstacleReason: true,
        updatedAt: true,
      },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
      take: 10,
    });

    const blockedProjects = await prisma.project.findMany({
      where: { status: 'pending' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        department: true,
        projectHead: true,
        obstacleReason: true,
        updatedAt: true,
      },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    const all = await prisma.project.findMany({
      select: { status: true },
    });

    const byStatus = { ongoing: 0, pending: 0, completed: 0 };
    all.forEach(p => { byStatus[p.status] = (byStatus[p.status] || 0) + 1; });

    res.json({
      from: from.toISOString(),
      to: to.toISOString(),
      total: recentProjects.length,
      byStatus,
      recent: recentProjects,
      blocked: blockedProjects,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

        updates: { orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' } },
      },
    });

router.post('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  const {
    name,
    description,
    projectHead,
    status,
    startDate,
    targetDate,
    note,
    obstacleReason,
  } = req.body;

  if (!name || !description || !projectHead) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      error: 'name, description, and projectHead are required',
    });
  }

  const finalStatus = status || 'ongoing';
  const finalNote = note && note.trim() ? note : 'Project created';
  const validationError = validateStatusUpdate(finalStatus, finalNote, obstacleReason);
  if (validationError) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: validationError });
  }

  try {
    // Anti-duplicate check: Look for an identical project created in the last 5 seconds
    const recentDuplicate = await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        name: name,
        department: canonicalDept(req.user.department),
        createdAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 5000) }
      }
    });

    if (recentDuplicate) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'This project was just created. Please check the list before trying again.' });
    }

    const project = await prisma.project.create({
      data: {
        name,
        description,
        department: canonicalDept(req.user.department),
        projectHead,
        status: finalStatus,
        startDate: startDate ? new Date(startDate) : null,
        targetDate: targetDate ? new Date(targetDate) : null,
        obstacleReason: finalStatus === 'pending' ? obstacleReason : null,
        createdBy: req.user.fullName,
      },
    });

    await prisma.projectUpdate.create({
      data: {
        projectId: project.id,
        note: finalNote,
        statusAtUpdate: finalStatus,
        obstacleReason: finalStatus === 'pending' ? obstacleReason : null,
        updatedBy: req.user.fullName,
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('project:created', { id: project.id, department: project.department });
    req.app.locals.emit('project:updated', { id: project.id, department: project.department });

    res.status(201).json(project);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.post('/:id/updates', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
  const { note, status, obstacleReason, actionTaken } = req.body;

  try {
    const project = await prisma.project.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!project) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Project not found' });

    const userDept = canonicalDept(req.user.department);
    if (userDept !== project.department && !isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: 'Only the owning department can update this project',
      });
    }

    const finalStatus = status || project.status;
    const validationError = validateStatusUpdate(finalStatus, note, obstacleReason);
    if (validationError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: validationError });
    }

    const update = await prisma.projectUpdate.create({
      data: {
        projectId: id,
        note,
        statusAtUpdate: finalStatus,
        obstacleReason: finalStatus === 'pending' ? obstacleReason : null,
        actionTaken: actionTaken || null,
        updatedBy: req.user.fullName,
      },
    });

    await prisma.project.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: finalStatus,
        obstacleReason: finalStatus === 'pending' ? obstacleReason : null,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    req.app.locals.emit('project:updated', { id: project.id, department: project.department });

    res.status(201).json(update);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

router.delete('/:id', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isITOrSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only IT can delete projects' });
  }

  const id = parseInt(req.params.id);

  try {
    const project = await prisma.project.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!project) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Project not found' });

    await prisma.projectUpdate.deleteMany({ where: { projectId: id } });
    await prisma.project.delete({ where: { id } });

    req.app.locals.emit('project:deleted', { id, department: project.department });

    res.json({ message: 'Project deleted' });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;
=================== ./src/routes/settings.js ===================
const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth, isSuperAdmin } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

// ============================================================
// PUBLIC - Get display settings (name, subtitle, contact)
// Anyone (including the Live Board) can read these.
// ============================================================
router.get('/public', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const rows = await prisma.systemSettings.findMany();
    const map = {};
    rows.forEach(r => { map[r.key] = r.value; });
    res.json({
      hospitalName: map.hospital_name || 'Hospital',
      hospitalSubtitle: map.hospital_subtitle || 'Department Dashboard',
      contactPhone: map.contact_phone || '',
      contactAddress: map.contact_address || '',
    });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// SUPER ADMIN - Get all settings
// ============================================================
router.get('/admin', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Super Admin access required' });
  }

  try {
    const rows = await prisma.systemSettings.findMany();
    const map = {};
    rows.forEach(r => { map[r.key] = r.value; });
    res.json(map);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// SUPER ADMIN - Update settings
// ============================================================
router.put('/admin', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSuperAdmin(req)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Super Admin access required' });
  }

  const { hospital_name, hospital_subtitle, contact_phone, contact_address } = req.body;

  const updates = [
    { key: 'hospital_name', value: hospital_name },
    { key: 'hospital_subtitle', value: hospital_subtitle },
    { key: 'contact_phone', value: contact_phone },
    { key: 'contact_address', value: contact_address },
  ].filter(u => typeof u.value === 'string');

  try {
    for (const u of updates) {
      await prisma.systemSettings.upsert({
        where: { key: u.key },
        update: { value: u.value },
        create: u,
      });
    }

    res.json({ message: 'Settings updated' });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;

const express = require('express');
const prisma = require('../prismaClient');
const { requireAuth } = require('../auth');

const router = express.Router();

router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const wards = await prisma.ward.findMany({ orderBy: { name: 'asc' } });
    res.json(wards);
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;
